zh: 今天下午，一位男演員和一位女演員來學校和我們聊藝術。男演員很有表演天分，也能在舞臺上邊唱邊演。女演員演了一小段戲。老師問：「她在戲裡做了哪些動作？」我們回答了問題，老師把答案寫在黑板上。
en: This afternoon, an actor and an actress came to our school and talked with us about art. The actor has a real ability to act, and he is also able to sing and act on stage. The actress acted in a short play. The teacher asked, "What actions did she do in the play?" We answered the question, and the teacher wrote the answers on the blackboard.

zh: 今天上午七點，我和阿姨已經在機場了。我們幾乎錯過第一班飛機。兩小時後，我們抵達另一個機場。我第一次到國外旅行，離家好遠！下飛機後，我到外面呼吸新鮮空氣。
en: At seven a.m. today, my aunt and I were already at the airport. We almost missed the first airplane. Two hours later, we arrived at another airport. It was my first trip abroad, and I was so far away from home! After getting off the plane, I went outside to breathe some fresh air.

zh: 傍晚，我沿著河邊散步，走過一座橋。幾隻鳥從我頭上飛過。我又繞著公園走了一圈。這一帶有很多動物，一隻螞蟻正在搬一小塊蘋果。
en: In the evening, I walked along the river and across a bridge. Some birds flew above my head. Then I walked around the park again. There are many animals in this area. An ant was carrying a small piece of apple.

zh: 三年前，我阿姨搬進一間公寓。昨天，一個和我同年紀的男孩出現在她家門口。他拿著他家狗的照片，說：「狗老得真快！」
en: Three years ago, my aunt moved into an apartment. Yesterday, a boy my age appeared at her door. He was holding a photo of his dog and said, "Dogs get old so fast!"

zh: 阿姨問：「有人認識門口那個人嗎？」接著，她問那個人：「你需要什麼嗎？」他搖搖頭，說：「有其他住戶在家嗎？我來找另一位住戶。」
en: My aunt asked, "Does anybody know the person at the door?" Then she asked him, "Do you need anything?" He shook his head and said, "Are any other people at home? I am looking for another person who lives here."

zh: 下午，我們一起做餅乾。阿姨讓我自己加糖。我打翻了碗，只好重來一次。這次我把材料全部拌好，差一點又打翻了碗。
en: In the afternoon, we made cookies together. My aunt allowed me to add the sugar by myself. I knocked over the bowl, so I had to do it again. This time I mixed everything well, and I almost knocked over the bowl again.

zh: 回家路上，一隻生氣的狗想攻擊我們。主人立刻採取行動，抓住了牠的項圈。雖然這次攻擊讓我們很害怕，狗沒有咬傷任何人。
en: On the way home, an angry dog tried to attack us. Its owner took action right away and grabbed its collar. Although the attack made us afraid, the dog did not bite anyone.

zh: 雖然我們想去的地方不同，最後大家都同意週末去海邊。我們也約好八點集合。我們總是遵守約定。
en: Although we wanted to go to different places, in the end we all agreed to go to the beach on the weekend. We also made an agreement to meet at eight. We always keep our agreements.

zh: 身為班長，我每天七點半到校。老師允許我們在課前聊天約十分鐘。對功課有任何問題，也可以在那時候問。
en: As the class leader, I arrive at school at seven thirty every day. Our teacher allows us to chat for about ten minutes before class. If we have any questions about our homework, we can also ask then.

zh: 放學後，我們沿著街道走去戲院。朋友的手臂有點痠，我替他拿了書包。戲院門口有一張電影海報，海報上的士兵正拿起劍武裝自己，保護這一帶的居民。戲院離我們家只有一條街。
en: After school, we walked along the street to the theater. My friend's arm was a little sore, so I carried his schoolbag for him. There was a movie poster at the door of the theater. On the poster, a soldier was picking up a sword to arm himself and protect the people in the area. The theater is only one block away from our homes.

zh: 媽媽用嬰兒車推著寶寶走出水果店。她的袋子還在店裡。她回去拿袋子，把裡面的香蕉放進嬰兒車下方的籃子。
en: Mom pushed the baby out of the fruit store in a stroller. Her bag was still in the store. She went back for the bag and put the bananas from it into the basket below the stroller.

zh: 天氣很差，棒球比賽提前結束了。我們離場前，我幫教練收起球棒，弟弟去撿最後一顆球。
en: The weather was bad, so the baseball game ended early. Before we left, I helped the coach put away the bats, and my brother went to pick up the last ball.

zh: 一個樂團在銀行門口演出。最後一首歌唱完，四個人一起向觀眾鞠躬。
en: A band played in front of the bank. When the last song was over, the four of them bowed to the audience together.

zh: 長椅後面有一顆籃球。你看，隊徽下方寫著小美的名字，這顆球屬於她。
en: There is a basketball behind the bench. Look, Xiao-Mei's name is written below the team logo. This ball belongs to her.

zh: 弟弟在浴室洗了個澡。他回到臥室，小貓已經睡在他的床上了。
en: My brother took a bath in the bathroom. When he went back to his bedroom, the kitten was already sleeping on his bed.

zh: 這是我最喜歡的小屋，因為它就在海灘旁邊。傍晚的海很漂亮，這裡是看夕陽最好的地方。
en: This is my favorite cabin because it is right beside the beach. The sea is beautiful in the evening, and this is the best place to watch the sunset.

zh: 午休時，我和老闆一起去吃飯。我點了一碗牛肉麵，老闆點了一碟豆子。
en: At lunch break, I went to eat with my boss. I ordered a bowl of beef noodles, and my boss ordered a plate of beans.

zh: 那個男孩指著泥地上的腳印說：「這是熊的腳印。」沒有人相信他。他很勇敢，但他還是先去找大人幫忙。
en: The boy pointed at the footprints in the mud and said, "These are a bear's footprints." Nobody believed him. He was brave, but he still went to get help from an adult first.

zh: 我指著葉子上一隻棕色的小蟲。妹妹問：「牠會變成蜜蜂嗎？」爸爸說：「不會，這是毛毛蟲。牠會變成蝴蝶。」
en: I pointed at a small brown bug on a leaf. My sister asked, "Will it become a bee?" Dad said, "No, this is a caterpillar. It will become a butterfly."

zh: 休息時間開始了。弟弟沒帶水壺，我就在上課鈴響前從隔壁教室拿水來給他。
en: Break time began. My brother did not bring his water bottle, so I brought him some water from the classroom next door before the bell rang.

zh: 那件黑色戲服太大了。姐姐幫我扣上鈕扣，再用腰帶把衣服繫緊。
en: The black costume was too big. My sister helped me do up the buttons and then pulled it tight with a belt.

zh: 一輛腳踏車停在樹和牆之間，擋住了人行道。車主把車推走，讓一位盲人安全通過。
en: A bicycle was parked between a tree and a wall, and it blocked the sidewalk. The owner moved the bike away so a blind man could pass by safely.

zh: 小鳥的身體一直在發抖。我伸手想抱牠，牠咬了我的手指一下。
en: The little bird's body kept shaking. I reached out to hold it, and it bit my finger.

zh: 橋下有一艘藍色的小船。一個小女孩坐在船上。一陣風吹走了她的帽子。
en: There was a small blue boat under the bridge. A little girl was sitting in the boat. The wind blew her hat away.

zh: 候車室裡的電視節目很無趣，我坐在那裡覺得很無聊。我向朋友借了一本書。我剛讀完第一頁，公車就來了。
en: The TV show in the waiting room was boring, and I felt bored sitting there. I borrowed a book from my friend. I had just finished the first page when the bus came.

zh: 我們兩個都在台南出生。媽媽從箱子底部拿出兩個小瓶子。一個瓶子上有我的名字和生日，另一個上面有你的。
en: Both of us were born in Tainan. Mom took two small bottles from the bottom of the box. One bottle has my name and birthday on it, and the other has yours.

zh: 爸爸早餐吃麵包，上面塗了奶油。但是媽媽喜歡直接吃剛烤好的麵包。
en: Dad has bread with butter on it for breakfast. But Mom likes to eat freshly baked bread just as it is.

zh: 市府在河上蓋了一座橋，橋上的燈很明亮。現在我們晚上也能搭公車過河。
en: The city built a bridge over the river, and the lights on the bridge are very bright. Now we can cross the river by bus at night, too.

zh: 媽媽的花店生意很好。放學後我到店裡，她正忙。我留下來幫忙，一位客人向我買了三朵花。
en: Business at Mom's flower shop is good. After school I went to the shop, and she was busy. I stayed to help, and a customer came to buy three flowers from me.

zh: 我們做了一個巧克力蛋糕，幫奶奶慶祝生日。她打開卡片，認出了我的字。
en: We made a chocolate cake to celebrate Grandma's birthday. She opened the card and knew it was my handwriting.

zh: 我用手機打電話給爸爸，問他：「你有看到我的相機嗎？」他叫我先檢查桌上的黑色相機盒。相機果然在裡面。
en: I called Dad on my cellphone and asked him, "Have you seen my camera?" He told me to check the black camera case on the table first. The camera was in it, just as he said.

words.zh: 蜂窩式便攜無線電話、大哥大

zh: 爸爸把車停在營地外。我戴上棒球帽，對他說：「我可以自己把睡袋搬到帳篷裡。」
en: Dad parked the car outside the camp. I put on my baseball cap and said to him, "I can carry my sleeping bag to the tent by myself."

zh: 我幫鄰居照顧小貓。牠想跳起來接球，我把旁邊的水杯移走。鄰居提醒我：「小心，別踩到牠的尾巴。」
en: I helped my neighbor take care of her cat. It wanted to jump up and catch the ball, so I moved the cup of water next to it. My neighbor told me, "Be careful. Don't step on its tail."

zh: 午餐有兩種選擇，雞肉三明治和起司三明治。我選了雞肉的，裡面還夾了胡蘿蔔。
en: There were two choices for lunch, a chicken sandwich and a cheese sandwich. I chose the chicken one, and it had carrots in it, too.

zh: 這枝筆很便宜，只要七十五美分。我付了一美元，店員把找給我的零錢放在我手上。
en: This pen is cheap. It only costs seventy-five cents. I paid one dollar, and the clerk put my change in my hand.

zh: 孩子們把椅子圍成一個圓圈，老師站在圓圈中央。音樂一停，每個人都有機會搶到座位。
en: The children put their chairs in a circle, and the teacher stood in the center of the circle. When the music stops, every child has a chance to get a seat.

zh: 我們爬上高塔，看見了市裡最高的教堂。教堂的大鐘剛好敲了十二下。我很確定現在是中午十二點。
en: We climbed the tall tower and saw the tallest church in the city. The church clock had just struck twelve. I was certain that it was twelve noon.

zh: 今天輪到我們班打掃走廊了。我掃乾淨角落，小安負責關上窗戶。
en: Today it was our class's turn to clean the hallway. I swept the corners clean, and Xiao-An closed the windows.

zh: 早上天氣晴朗，天空只有一朵雲。我帶了幾件衣服上山。下午我覺得冷，就穿上外套。
en: The weather was clear in the morning, and there was only one cloud in the sky. I took some clothes up the mountain. In the afternoon I felt cold, so I put on my coat.

zh: 我加入了一個集郵社。我們喜歡收集各國的郵票。我指著一張郵票上的鳥，新朋友說：「這種鳥在台灣很常見。」我問他：「牠的羽毛是什麼顏色？」
en: I joined a stamp club. We like to collect stamps from different countries. I pointed at the bird on one stamp, and my new friend said, "This kind of bird is common in Taiwan." I asked him, "What color are its feathers?"

zh: 表妹來我家玩，我讓她坐在客廳舒適的沙發上。她喝牛奶，我喝咖啡。
en: My cousin came to my house, and I let her sit on the comfortable couch in the living room. She drank milk, and I drank coffee.

words.zh: 堂兄弟姊妹、表兄弟姊妹

zh: 用圖書館的電腦改作業很方便。我先存一份副本，再把拼錯的字改正。
en: It is convenient to correct my homework on the library computer. I save a copy first and then correct the words I spelled wrong.

zh: 廚師把剛烤好的餅乾放在架上，讓它們冷卻。我數了數，一共有十二片。
en: The cook put the freshly baked cookies on the rack to let them cool. I counted them. There were twelve in all.

zh: 我報名了一門認識亞洲的課程。老師給了我們一張很清楚的地圖，我一下就找到了三個國家。
en: I signed up for a course about Asia. The teacher gave us a very clear map, and I found three countries right away.

zh: 小安對兔子很著迷。她剪下一張可愛的兔子照片，貼在筆記本的封面上。
en: Xiao-An is crazy about rabbits. She cut out a cute picture of a rabbit and stuck it on the cover of her notebook.

zh: 一頭母牛穿過小路，撞倒了弟弟的杯子。牛奶灑了一地，弟弟哭了。
en: A cow crossed the path and knocked over my brother's cup. The milk went all over the ground, and my brother cried.

zh: 女兒穿上新洋裝，把卡片交給我。上面寫著：「親愛的爸爸，請記住這個日期。那天來學校跟我跳舞吧！」
en: My daughter put on her new dress and gave me a card. It said, "Dear Dad, please remember this date. Come to school and dance with me that day!"

zh: 水很深，天也黑了。天黑後游過去很危險，我們決定隔天再來。
en: The water was deep, and it was getting dark. It is dangerous to swim across after dark, so we decided to come back the next day.

zh: 鄰居的狗昨晚死了。我第一次看見死去的動物，心裡很難受。媽媽陪著我。她以前也得面對寵物離世這件事。
en: Our neighbor's dog died last night. It was the first time I saw a dead animal, and I felt very sad. Mom stayed with me. She also had to deal with the death of a pet before.

zh: 老師要我們替一個難懂的字下定義。我的書桌上有兩本字典，兩本對這個字的解釋卻不同。
en: The teacher asked us to define a difficult word. There are two dictionaries on my desk, but they explain this word in different ways.

zh: 夏天到了，鴨子的小池塘乾了。我們幫牠們挖了一個新池子，大家的鞋都髒了。
en: Summer came, and the ducks' small pond went dry. We dug a new pond for them, and everyone's shoes got dirty.

zh: 吃完晚餐，妹妹說：「今天我來洗盤子。」我倒了兩杯水，我們一人喝了一杯。
en: After dinner, my sister said, "I will do the dishes today." I poured two glasses of water, and we each drank one.

zh: 妹妹昨晚做了一個夢。夢裡她是醫生，生病的洋娃娃都來找她。
en: My sister had a dream last night. In her dream she was a doctor, and all the sick dolls came to see her.

words.zh: 洋娃娃、無頭腦的美麗女人

zh: 一打鉛筆賣兩美元，我買了一盒。我想在假期中每天畫一張圖。
en: A dozen pencils cost two dollars, so I bought a box. I want to draw one picture every day during the vacation.

words.zh: 美元、元(加、澳等國貨幣單位)

zh: 公車司機把車開下山坡，在學校前停車。他打開車門，讓學生上車。
en: The bus driver drove down the hill and stopped in front of the school. He opened the door and let the students get on.

zh: 樂團練習期間，屋頂開始漏水。一滴水落在我的鼓上，我趕快把鼓搬開。
en: During band practice, the roof started to leak. A drop of water fell on my drum, so I quickly moved the drum away.

zh: 照片裡有三隻大象，每隻的耳朵都很大。最小的那隻閉著眼睛，靠在媽媽身旁。
en: There are three elephants in the photo, and each one has big ears. The smallest one has its eyes closed and is leaning against its mother.

zh: 老師給我們看地球模型，模型上的地球會轉動。隔天我很早就起床，看太陽從東方升起。到了傍晚，我又畫了一張天空的圖。
en: The teacher showed us a model of the earth, and the earth on the model can turn. The next day I got up early and watched the sun rise in the east. In the evening, I drew a picture of the sky again.

zh: 桌上有一顆蛋和一片吐司，你可以選其中一樣吃。我選了蛋。水煮蛋很容易做，明天我也想自己煮。
en: There is an egg and a piece of toast on the table. You can eat either one. I chose the egg. Boiled eggs are easy to make, and I want to cook one myself tomorrow.

words.zh: (兩者之中)任一的、(兩者之中)各一的

zh: 老師給我們看一座新橋的模型。我們寫了一封電子郵件給橋梁工程師。我在信的結尾問她：「除了橋，妳還設計別的東西嗎？」
en: The teacher showed us a model of a new bridge. We wrote an email to the bridge engineer. At the end of the email I asked her, "What else do you design besides bridges?"

zh: 我很享受現場音樂，可是今晚的票太貴了。我帶的錢不夠買票，只能站在門口看別人進場。
en: I enjoy live music, but tonight's tickets were too expensive. I did not have enough money for a ticket, so I could only stand at the door and watch other people enter.

zh: 我在信封上用鉛筆寫地址，寫完才發現有一個錯誤。我拿橡皮擦把門牌號碼擦掉，重新寫了一次。
en: I wrote the address on the envelope in pencil, and then I found an error. I used an eraser to rub out the house number and wrote it again.

zh: 老師要我向全班解釋偶數。我在黑板上寫了兩個例子，再請同學做習題。我說：「每一道題都要圈出偶數。」
en: The teacher asked me to explain even numbers to the class. I wrote two examples on the blackboard and then asked my classmates to do an exercise. I said, "Circle the even numbers in every question."

zh: 你曾經在海邊過夜嗎？我們上週在海邊露營，天氣非常好。那是一次很棒的經驗。
en: Have you ever spent a night by the sea? We camped by the sea last week, and the weather was excellent. It was a great experience.

zh: 大家都期待一場精彩刺激的比賽。除了守門員以外，每個人都很興奮。他是新隊員，場上的一切對他來說都很陌生。
en: Everyone expected an exciting game. Everybody was excited except the goalkeeper. He was a new player, and everything on the field was new to him.

zh: 妹妹用手指畫了一隻貓，還把藍色顏料抹到臉上。我問她：「妳感覺如何？」她笑著說：「我很好。」
en: My sister painted a cat with her fingers and got blue paint on her face. I asked her, "How do you feel?" She laughed and said, "I am fine."

zh: 我在外公的電腦裡找到一個舊檔案，裡面有一張照片和一段學校的介紹。我讀到一件有趣的事：我們學校以前是一座工廠。
en: I found an old file on my grandfather's computer. It had a photo and a short introduction to the school. I read an interesting fact: our school used to be a factory.

zh: 我先摺好機翼，再畫上星星，就完成了我的紙飛機。第一次試飛失敗了。我把機翼攤平，再試一次。這次它終於飛起來了。
en: First I folded the wings, and then I drew stars on them. My paper plane was finished. The first flight failed. I made the wings flat and tried again. This time it finally flew.

zh: 秋天來了，我家前面的花還開著。今天我去澆花，在花下看見一隻青蛙。
en: Fall has come, and the flowers in front of my house are still open. Today I went to water the flowers and saw a frog under them.

zh: 我父親是農夫，我們全家住在農場。農場離學校很遠，週末同學才有空來玩。
en: My father is a farmer, and my family lives on a farm. The farm is far from school, so my classmates are only free to visit on weekends.

words.zh: 自由的、享受政治權力的

zh: 我和哥哥都是那位知名歌手的歌迷。在音樂節，我們跟著他一起唱歌，玩得很開心。
en: My brother and I are both fans of that famous singer. At the music festival, we sang along with him and had a lot of fun.

zh: 我要去餵魚，弟弟幫我拿食物。池裡那條胖胖的魚游得最快，第一個吃到飼料。
en: I was going to feed the fish, and my brother carried the food for me. The fat fish in the pond swam the fastest and got the food first.

zh: 幾隻小狗為了搶地板上的球打了起來。球滾進房間，牠們又跟著球跑了進去。
en: A few puppies had a fight over a ball on the floor. The ball rolled into the room, and they followed it in.

zh: 爸爸在院子裡生了火，準備煮玉米。他要我把鍋子裝滿水。我端著滿滿的一鍋水，小心走到他身旁。
en: Dad made a fire in the yard to cook corn. He asked me to fill the pot with water. I carried the full pot of water carefully to him.

zh: 弟弟想捉弄我，把一雙滑稽的大拖鞋放在我的床邊。我才把腳伸進一隻拖鞋，鞋頭的小鴨就叫了起來。
en: My brother wanted to fool me, so he put a pair of big funny slippers beside my bed. As soon as I put my foot into one slipper, the little duck on the front made a sound.

zh: 一位外國人在街角看地圖。他指著手機上的外國文字，我只看懂了「車站」這個詞。我替他畫了一張地圖。他很友善，還教我用他的語言說謝謝。
en: A foreigner was looking at a map on the street corner. He pointed at the foreign words on his phone, and I only understood the word "station." I drew a map for him. He was friendly and taught me how to say thank you in his language.

zh: 攤主請我們免費試吃新鮮水果。我忘了拿叉子，只好回去向他要一支。
en: The owner of the stand let us try some fresh fruit for free. I forgot to take a fork, so I had to go back and ask him for one.

words.zh: 自由的、享受政治權力的

zh: 我的朋友從花蓮寄來一封信。他在信裡寫下對未來的計畫：「我長大後想開一間書店。」
en: My friend sent me a letter from Hualien. In the letter he wrote about his plan for the future: "When I grow up, I want to open a bookstore."

zh: 我們玩猜影子的遊戲。牆上出現一個巨大的影子。妹妹猜了一下：「是鬼嗎？」我們打開燈，看到了一隻玩具熊。
en: We played a game of guessing shadows. A giant shadow appeared on the wall. My sister made a guess: "Is it a ghost?" We turned on the light and saw a toy bear.

zh: 爺爺打開花園的柵門，把手套交給我。我們鬆了鬆土，準備在那裡種豆子。
en: Grandpa opened the garden gate and gave me the gloves. We loosened the ground and got ready to grow beans there.

zh: 我旁邊的女孩給了我一個小紙盒。我打開盒子，看到了一把口琴。我一直很想要一把，收到這份禮物好高興。
en: The girl next to me gave me a small paper box. I opened the box and saw a harmonica. I had always wanted one, so I was very glad to get this gift.

zh: 爸爸放下玻璃杯，彎腰看桌子下面。他的眼鏡掉在地上了。
en: Dad put down his glass and bent down to look under the table. His glasses had fallen on the ground.

zh: 放學後我們跟老師道了別，一起去看希臘神話展。弟弟說：「好主意！我想看智慧女神的雕像。」
en: After school we said goodbye to our teacher and went to see a show about Greek myths together. My brother said, "Good idea! I want to see the statue of the goddess of wisdom."

zh: 七年級那年，祖父開始教我彈吉他。祖母最愛坐在旁邊，跟著我們唱歌。
en: When I was in seventh grade, my grandfather started to teach me to play the guitar. My grandmother loved to sit beside us and sing along.

zh: 灰色的兔子蹲在綠色的草上。我把牠畫進筆記本，妹妹看了說：「這是一張很棒的畫！」
en: The gray rabbit sat on the green grass. I drew it in my notebook, and my sister looked at it and said, "This is a great picture!"

zh: 河邊有一群人在唱歌。戴紅帽子的那個男生彈著吉他，大家跟著拍手。
en: A group of people were singing by the river. The guy in the red hat was playing the guitar, and everyone clapped along.

zh: 哥哥有個習慣。他回家第一件事就是把帽子掛在門邊，接著才梳頭髮。
en: My brother has a habit. The first thing he does when he gets home is hang his hat by the door, and then he combs his hair.

zh: 我把火腿三明治加熱，再切成兩半。我把其中一半遞給妹妹。
en: I heated the ham sandwich and then cut it in half. I handed one half to my sister.

zh: 我聽見樓下傳來一陣笑聲，就跑下樓問：「發生什麼事了？」妹妹以前很討厭下雨。今天她穿上新雨鞋，開心地踩著水。我問她：「妳開心嗎？」她笑著點頭。
en: I heard laughing from downstairs, so I ran down and asked, "What happened?" My sister used to hate rain. Today she put on her new rain boots and jumped happily in the water. I asked her, "Are you happy?" She smiled and nodded.

zh: 哥哥摸了摸自己的頭，說：「我頭痛。」他還有一道很難的數學題要做，今天只好先休息。
en: My brother touched his head and said, "I have a headache." He still had a hard math problem to do, but he had to rest today.

zh: 健康課上，老師讓我們用聽診器聽心臟跳動。她問全班：「你們平常怎麼保持健康？」
en: In health class, the teacher let us listen to the heart beating with a stethoscope. She asked the class, "How do you usually keep healthy?"

zh: 海報架很重，同學幫我把它搬進教室。我們量了架子的高度，掛上海報。老師說：「海報掛得太高了，請掛低一點。」
en: The poster stand was heavy, so my classmate helped me carry it into the classroom. We measured the height of the stand and hung up the poster. The teacher said, "The poster is too high. Please hang it lower."

zh: 歷史博物館的志工笑著跟我親切地打了聲招呼。我問他：「這裡有地圖嗎？」他給了我一張很有用的地圖。
en: The volunteer at the history museum smiled and said a friendly hello to me. I asked him, "Do you have a map here?" He gave me a very helpful map.

zh: 舅舅的雞舍在小山丘上。有一隻母雞喜歡躲在門後，我每次都得蹲下來找牠。
en: My uncle's hen house is on a small hill. One hen likes to hide behind the door, so I have to bend down to find it every time.

zh: 打棒球是我的嗜好。假日我在家附近的公園練習。爸爸拿著球棒，把球打得很遠。
en: Playing baseball is my hobby. On holidays I practice in the park near my home. Dad holds the bat and hits the ball very far.

zh: 我的家庭作業寫完了，可是我把它忘在家了。我想對老師說實話。我希望她能再給我一天。
en: I finished my homework. However, I left it at home. I want to be honest with my teacher. I hope she can give me one more day.

words.zh: 家庭作業、家裡做的工作

zh: 我從馬背上摔下來，弄傷了手臂。爸爸帶我去醫院，我們在那裡等了一個小時。
en: I fell off a horse and hurt my arm. Dad took me to the hospital, and we waited there for an hour.

zh: 我起床時肚子很餓。旅館的早餐有熱茶和吐司，我在吐司上塗了蜂蜜。
en: I was very hungry when I got up. The hotel breakfast had hot tea and toast, and I put honey on my toast.

zh: 阿姨是家庭主婦，她和丈夫住在一棟老房子裡。我問她：「這棟房子有幾年了？」她說：「一百年了。」
en: My aunt is a housewife, and she lives with her husband in an old house. I asked her, "How old is this house?" She said, "It is one hundred years old."

zh: 我有個主意。如果你把冰塊放在我的水壺裡，我就能帶冰水去野餐了。
en: I have an idea. If you put ice in my water bottle, I can take ice water to the picnic.

zh: 我打開桌上的紙盒，裡面有一隻昆蟲。牠只有一英吋長，腳卻很長。
en: I opened the paper box on the table, and there was an insect inside. It was only one inch long, but its legs were very long.

zh: 我對攝影很感興趣。為了校刊，我採訪了一位攝影師。我問他：「你是從什麼時候開始對攝影有興趣的？」他的回答很有趣。
en: I am interested in photography. For the school magazine, I interviewed a photographer. I asked him, "When did you first take an interest in photography?" His answer was very interesting.

zh: 老師邀請我們去一座小島淨灘。行前清單上最重要的項目是手套，我先把手套塞進背包裡。
en: Our teacher invited us to clean a beach on a small island. The most important item on the list was gloves, so I put my gloves into my backpack first.

zh: 哥哥剛才換上夾克和牛仔褲。今天是他到書店做新工作的第一天。
en: My brother just changed into a jacket and jeans. Today is the first day of his new job at the bookstore.

zh: 我加入球隊那天，隊友倒了果汁給我，還說了個笑話。教練說：「換你上場了！」我高興得跳了起來。
en: On the day I joined the team, my teammates poured me some juice and told a joke. The coach said, "It is your turn to play!" I jumped for joy.

zh: 媽媽把備用鑰匙收在廚房。今天我忘了帶自己的鑰匙，只好敲門。她放下手上的刀子來幫我開門。
en: Mom keeps the spare key in the kitchen. Today I forgot to bring my own key, so I had to knock on the door. She put down the knife in her hand and came to open the door for me.

zh: 一個小孩在公園放風箏，另一個小孩在踢球。球碰到了我的膝蓋，我就把球踢回去。
en: One kid was flying a kite in the park, and another kid was kicking a ball. The ball hit my knee, so I kicked it back.

zh: 國王很仁慈。他不讓獵人殺那隻鳥。他輕輕親了牠一下，就放牠走了。
en: The king was very kind. He did not let the hunter kill the bird. He gave it a gentle kiss and let it go.

zh: 來測測你的露營知識吧！你知道怎麼安全使用小刀嗎？
en: Let's test your knowledge of camping! Do you know how to use a knife safely?

zh: 天黑了，我們的小船還在一個大湖上。爸爸打開船頭的燈。靠著燈光，我們看到了前方的陸地。
en: It was dark, and our small boat was still on a large lake. Dad turned on the lamp at the front of the boat. By its light, we saw land ahead.

zh: 我想學一門新語言。每堂課我都至少學會講一句新句子，回家就說給妹妹聽。
en: I want to learn a new language. In every lesson I learn to say at least one new sentence, and I say it to my sister when I get home.

zh: 我們很晚才離開球場。十分鐘後，最後一班公車到了。幸好我們搭上了。
en: We left the ballpark very late. Ten minutes later, the last bus came. We were lucky to catch it.

zh: 哥哥在戲裡演律師。我們聽他問：「你怎麼不起來？」那個人說：「我今天太懶了。」大家都笑了。
en: My brother played a lawyer in the play. We listened to him ask, "Why don't you get up?" The man said, "I am too lazy today." Everybody laughed.

zh: 隊長帶我們走左邊的小路。我走到一半腿很痠，他便停下來等我。
en: The leader led us along the path on the left. Halfway there my legs were sore, so he stopped and waited for me.

zh: 姊姊讓我自己做檸檬水。我只擠了一點檸檬汁，糖也放得比上次少。
en: My sister let me make the lemonade by myself. I only added a little lemon juice, and I put in less sugar than last time.

zh: 奶奶給我看一封她年輕時的信。她在信裡寫道：「我現在住在鄉下，有時覺得寂寞。還好生活中有書陪我。我常去圖書館借書，再躺在樹下讀。」
en: Grandma showed me a letter from when she was young. In the letter she wrote, "I live in the country now, and sometimes I feel lonely. Luckily, I have books in my life. I often borrow books from the library and lie under a tree to read them."

zh: 我喜歡畫池塘。老師說：「仔細看看水面。用尺畫一條線，兩端要一樣高。」
en: I like to paint ponds. The teacher said, "Look carefully at the water. Use a ruler to draw a line, and both ends must be on the same level."

zh: 妹妹畫了一隻可愛的小獅子。牠的尾巴很長，嘴唇上還沾著牛奶。
en: My sister drew a lovely little lion. It had a long tail, and there was milk on its lips.

zh: 爸爸很愛做菜。今天他要煮午餐給很多人吃，所以出門前先寫了一張購物清單。
en: Dad loves to cook. Today he is going to cook lunch for a lot of people, so he wrote a shopping list before he left.

zh: 我在操場弄丟了錢包。我真幸運，有人在一道矮牆旁看到了它。我聽到身後傳來一個響亮的聲音：「你的錢包在這裡！」
en: I lost my wallet on the playground. I was really lucky because someone saw it beside a low wall. I heard a loud voice behind me: "Your wallet is here!"

zh: 我們用學校的機器做了很多張明信片。放學後，我想把其中一張寄給外婆。
en: We made many postcards with the school's machine. After school, I want to mail one of them to my grandmother.

zh: 你介意我明天還書嗎？我犯了個錯，把你的書拿回家了。兩本書的封面一模一樣。你別生氣。
en: Do you mind if I return the book tomorrow? I made a mistake and took your book home. The covers of the two books are just the same. Please don't be mad.

zh: 一個男人在街頭表演魔術。他張開嘴巴，一隻玩具猴子就從他的帽子裡跳了出來。
en: A man was doing magic on the street. He opened his mouth, and a toy monkey jumped out of his hat.

zh: 請在地圖中央找到市場，然後在它的主要入口旁畫一顆星。這個記號是說：「明天在這裡集合。」
en: Please find the market in the middle of the map, and then draw a star beside its main gate. This mark means, "Meet here tomorrow."

zh: 林先生是我們的新鄰居。他已經結婚了。林太太就站在他身邊。我們的鄰居陳女士正在和他們聊天。
en: Mr. Lin is our new neighbor. He is married. Mrs. Lin is standing beside him. Our neighbor Ms. Chen is talking with them.

zh: 數學課開始了，我卻找不到尺。小恩說：「你的尺或許在抽屜裡。」抽屜是空的。他把自己的尺借給我：「沒關係。說不定明天就找到了。」
en: Math class started, but I could not find my ruler. Xiao-En said, "Maybe your ruler is in the drawer." The drawer was empty. He lent me his own ruler and said, "It doesn't matter. You may find it tomorrow."

zh: 我看了看菜單，點了一份套餐。套餐裡有肉和飯。我還點了一杯中杯鮮奶。
en: I looked at the menu and ordered a set meal. The meal came with meat and rice. I also ordered a medium milk.

zh: 我在社團的第一次集會上遇見了兩位新成員。他們和我一樣，都對新聞媒體有興趣。
en: At the club's first meeting, I met two new members. Like me, they are both interested in the news media.

zh: 我必須先吃藥，才能進去參觀這座舊煤礦。我跟老師說：「請等我一下。我兩分鐘後就好。」
en: I must take my medicine before I can go in and visit this old coal mine. I said to my teacher, "Please wait a moment. I will be ready in two minutes."

zh: 我們鎮上有一座現代化的博物館。建造這座館花了兩百萬元，這筆錢是居民一起捐的。
en: There is a modern museum in our town. It cost two million dollars to build, and the people of the town gave the money together.

zh: 媽媽這個月在外地工作，我很想念她。我今天又寫了一封信，告訴她更多學校裡的事。
en: My mother is working in another city this month, and I miss her very much. Today I wrote another letter and told her more about school.

zh: 早晨五點，月亮還掛在山的上方。同隊的人多數都還在睡，只有我和爸爸起來看日出。
en: At five in the morning, the moon was still above the mountain. Most of the people on our team were still sleeping. Only Dad and I got up to watch the sunrise.

zh: 這部電影的主角是一隻小老鼠。音樂一開始，牠就隨著節奏動了起來。
en: The main character of this movie is a little mouse. As soon as the music starts, it moves with the beat.

zh: 我的鞋上怎麼有這麼多泥巴？我需要更多的水，才能把鞋洗乾淨。
en: Why is there so much mud on my shoes? I need more water to wash them clean.

zh: 我們家附近有一座國家公園。老師帶我們去觀察大自然，還教我們認識幾種鳥的名字。
en: There is a national park near our home. Our teacher took us there to look at nature and taught us the names of several birds.

zh: 有一張網纏住了那隻水鳥的脖子。牠需要幫忙。我們剪開網子，牠就飛走了。我永遠不會忘記那一刻。
en: A net was caught around the water bird's neck. It needed help. We cut the net open, and it flew away. I will never forget that moment.

zh: 今天的報紙上有一則好消息。新的游泳池下星期就要開放了。我們可以在家附近游泳，真好！
en: There is good news in today's newspaper. The new swimming pool will open next week. We can swim near our home. How nice!

zh: 昨晚我聽到樓梯間傳來噪音。我問爸爸：「外面有人嗎？」他說：「沒有，外面一個人也沒有。是樓下的狗在吵。」
en: Last night I heard a noise from the stairs. I asked Dad, "Is anyone outside?" He said, "No, nobody is out there. The dog downstairs is being noisy."

zh: 便條上寫著：「中午在車站北門集合。」我提早到了，手上什麼也沒拿，便去幫大家搬箱子。
en: The note said, "Meet at the north gate of the station at noon." I got there early with nothing in my hands, so I helped everyone carry the boxes.

zh: 我現在注意到螢幕上的號碼了。是我的！護理師問我：「你的鼻子很痛嗎？」我說：「不太痛，只是有點癢。」
en: Now I notice the number on the screen. It is mine! The nurse asked me, "Does your nose hurt a lot?" I said, "Not much. It is just a little itchy."

zh: 我關了燈。爸爸說：「我們走吧。大家約七點鐘在公園的北門見。」我說：「七點我可以。我來帶路。」
en: I turned off the light. Dad said, "Let's go. Everyone will meet at the north gate of the park at seven o'clock." I said, "Seven is OK for me. I will lead the way."

zh: 我常常去爺爺的辦公室。他的桌上有一張照片，照片裡那位年老的軍官是他的爸爸。
en: I often go to my grandfather's office. There is a photo on his desk. The old officer in the photo is his father.

zh: 我只上過一次線上烹飪課。老師說：「打開油瓶，倒一點油到鍋子裡。」
en: I have taken an online cooking class only once. The teacher said, "Open the bottle of oil and pour a little oil into the pan."

zh: 你想點柳橙汁或蘋果汁？這家店還有其他飲料。
en: Would you like to order orange juice or apple juice? This shop has other drinks, too.

zh: 我帶了自己的球去學校。球飛過圍牆，落在學校外面。我只好從大門走出去撿球。
en: I took my own ball to school. The ball flew over the wall and landed outside the school. I had to walk out through the gate to get it.

zh: 我用紙包好茶杯，把它裝進盒子裡。到了郵局，我付了錢，把包裹寄給外婆。
en: I wrapped the teacup in paper and packed it in a box. At the post office, I paid and sent the package to my grandmother.

zh: 翻到最後一頁，看看那幅海邊的圖畫。我的部分是天空，妹妹負責把海塗成藍色。
en: Turn to the last page and look at the picture of the beach. My part was the sky, and my sister painted the sea blue.

zh: 我看上一條有四個口袋的褲子。這條褲子很漂亮，可是我看了價錢，就把它放回去了。
en: I liked a pair of pants with four pockets. The pants were pretty, but when I saw the price, I put them back.

zh: 我的父母在公園替我辦生日派對。來參加派對的人各自帶了椅子。我們一起在大樹下吃蛋糕。
en: My parents held a birthday party for me in the park. The people who came to the party each brought a chair. We ate cake together under a big tree.

zh: 我喜歡打籃球，今天第一次跟校隊一起練習。一名球員把球傳給我，我投進了第一球。
en: I like to play basketball, and today I practiced with the school team for the first time. A player passed the ball to me, and I made my first shot.

zh: 我找不到看表演的地方，就向警察問路。他們很有禮貌。其中一位說：「走過銀行就到劇場了。」
en: I could not find the place for the show, so I asked the police for directions. They were very polite. One of them said, "Walk past the bank and you will be at the theater."

zh: 我用原子筆寫錯了名字，擦不掉。老師把一枝鉛筆放在我的桌上，給我一張新的紙。
en: I wrote the wrong name with a pen and could not rub it out. The teacher put a pencil on my desk and gave me a new piece of paper.

zh: 照片裡只有一個人，腳邊有一隻狗。那隻狗脖子上有項圈，也許是他的寵物。
en: There is only one person in the photo, and there is a dog at his feet. The dog has a collar on its neck. Perhaps it is his pet.

zh: 妹妹花了兩個月為學校的音樂節目做準備。聽她彈鋼琴真是件愉快的事。我為她感到驕傲。
en: My sister spent two months preparing for the school music program. It is a pleasure to hear her play the piano. I am proud of her.

zh: 我們先在果園採蘋果，再到樹下野餐。媽媽切開蘋果派，在每個人的盤子裡放了一塊。
en: First we picked apples in the orchard, and then we had a picnic under a tree. Mom cut the apple pie and put a piece on each person's plate.

zh: 姑姑送我一份生日禮物。那是一枚粉紅色的小豬胸針，我把它別在書包上。
en: My aunt gave me a birthday present. It was a little pink pig pin, and I pinned it on my schoolbag.

zh: 外公在池塘邊種菜。一根長水管把池塘的水引進菜園裡的小水池。
en: Grandpa plants vegetables by the pond. A long pipe carries water from the pond into a small pool in the vegetable garden.

zh: 我們計畫星期五晚上去公立天文臺。老師會指著天空中的幾顆行星，告訴我們它們的名字。
en: We plan to go to the public observatory on Friday night. The teacher will point at several planets in the sky and tell us their names.

zh: 電影下午兩點開始。我想讓妹妹開心，特地替她買了這家戲院最受歡迎的焦糖爆米花。
en: The movie starts at two p.m. I wanted to please my sister, so I bought her the most popular caramel popcorn at this theater.

zh: 爸爸把馬鈴薯放進大鍋裡煮湯。我們把熱湯送給附近幾戶貧窮的家庭。
en: Dad put potatoes in a big pot to make soup. We gave the hot soup to several poor families nearby.

zh: 桌上的小風車停了。問題很可能出在電池。弟弟問：「不用電池也有辦法讓它轉嗎？」我打開窗戶說：「看！風力也能帶動它。」
en: The small windmill on the table stopped. The problem was probably the battery. My brother asked, "Is it possible to make it turn without a battery?" I opened the window and said, "Look! Wind power can turn it, too."

zh: 我把箱子放下，伸手推門，門卻動也不動。弟弟指著門把旁的字說：「從這一側要用拉的。」
en: I put the box down and reached out to push the door, but it did not move at all. My brother pointed at the words beside the handle and said, "You have to pull from this side."

zh: 兩點一刻，教室裡相當安靜。老師問了個關於故事裡那位皇后的問題。小美反應很快，第一個舉手。
en: At a quarter past two, the classroom was quite quiet. The teacher asked a question about the queen in the story. Xiao-Mei was quick and was the first to raise her hand.

zh: 故事裡的兔子準備好比賽了。裁判舉起小旗子，又把旗子放下。兔子開始跑了。
en: The rabbit in the story was ready for the race. The judge raised a small flag and then put it down. The rabbit started to run.

zh: 我們從收音機聽到這座山城的夏天很多雨。下午果真下起雨來。雨停後，天空出現一道彩虹。
en: We heard on the radio that summers in this mountain town are very rainy. It really did rain in the afternoon. After the rain stopped, a rainbow appeared in the sky.

zh: 我走到樓梯口，讀了牆上的紙條。為了記住上面的地址，我又念了兩遍。
en: I reached the stairs and read the note on the wall. To remember the address on it, I repeated it twice.

zh: 門口有一排小機器人。妹妹指著其中一隻問：「那是真狗嗎？」我說：「牠也是機器人。我喜歡牠有個理由：牠真的會跳舞。」
en: There was a row of small robots at the door. My sister pointed at one of them and asked, "Is that a real dog?" I said, "It is a robot, too. I like it for a reason: it can really dance."

zh: 我在舊相簿裡看到一張親戚們的合照。照片裡，姑姑戴著戒指，手裡拿著一朵紅玫瑰。
en: I saw a photo of my relatives in an old photo book. In the photo, my aunt was wearing a ring and holding a red rose.

zh: 一名記者站在橋上做現場報導。他說：「河水還在上升，請大家留在高處。」
en: A reporter stood on the bridge and gave a live report. He said, "The river is still rising. Please stay in high places."

zh: 這間餐廳的老闆很富有。他讓旅人在店裡休息，還免費請他們吃一碗白飯。
en: The owner of this restaurant is rich. He lets travelers rest in his restaurant and gives them a bowl of rice for free.

zh: 我們沿著這條路騎腳踏車。到了紅色的橋，我們向右轉，就看見了海。
en: We rode our bikes along this road. At the red bridge, we turned right and saw the sea.

zh: 我的房間裡有幾顆來自海邊的石頭。一顆圓圓的石頭從桌上滾下去，滾進床底。
en: There are some rocks from the beach in my room. A round rock rolled off the table and under the bed.

zh: 我們班有個規則：不能踩校園裡的樹根。今天我們沿著一條樹根放好繩子，再用尺量繩子的長度。
en: Our class has a rule: we cannot step on the tree roots at school. Today we put a rope along one root and then used a ruler to measure how long the rope was.

zh: 小貓不見了，妹妹好難過。鄰居從水溝救出小貓。牠平安回家了，妹妹終於露出微笑。
en: The kitten was missing, and my sister was very sad. Our neighbor saved the kitten from a ditch. It got home safe, and my sister finally smiled.

zh: 我在小瓶子裡裝了油和一點鹽，把瓶子搖一搖。妹妹把醬汁淋在沙拉上，跟我分著吃。
en: I put oil and a little salt in a small bottle and shook it. My sister poured the sauce on the salad and shared it with me.

zh: 街角的商店正在特價。我看中照片裡的一雙藍鞋。店員說：「我們昨天賣掉最後一雙了。不過還有同款的紅鞋。」
en: The shop on the corner is having a sale. I liked a pair of blue shoes in a photo. The clerk said, "We sold the last pair yesterday. But we still have the same shoes in red."

zh: 學校的科學老師給我們幾顆種子。她說：「把種子放在濕紙巾上，明天再來看看。」
en: Our science teacher at school gave us several seeds. She said, "Put the seeds on a wet paper towel and come back to see them tomorrow."

zh: 我最喜歡的季節是秋天。我可以從山上看見大海，還有十幾艘一起進港的船。那景象真美！
en: My favorite season is fall. From the mountain I can see the sea and more than ten ships coming into the harbor together. What a beautiful sight!

zh: 一位老人家在第二站上了公車。我站起來對他說：「先生，請坐我的座位。」
en: An old man got on the bus at the second stop. I stood up and said to him, "Sir, please sit in my seat."

zh: 我寫了幾句話，感謝志工們在圖書館的服務。學校的秘書幫我把這封信寄給他們。
en: I wrote several sentences to thank the volunteers for their service at the library. The school secretary helped me send the letter to them.

zh: 我洗完澡後，肩膀還是很痛，手臂也抬不起來。媽媽問：「你是不是生病了？」我說：「我打球傷到了肩膀。傷得很嚴重。」
en: After I took a shower, my shoulder was still very sore, and I could not raise my arm. Mom asked, "Are you sick?" I said, "I hurt my shoulder playing ball. It is serious."

zh: 我們來做星星形狀的餅乾好嗎？做法很簡單。你來壓出星星的形狀，我來把計時器設成十分鐘。
en: Shall we make star-shaped cookies? It is simple. You press out the star shapes, and I will set the timer for ten minutes.

zh: 姊姊在圍欄邊餵綿羊。她的襯衫勾到尖尖的鐵絲，她自己把衣角解開。
en: My sister was feeding the sheep by the fence. Her shirt got caught on a sharp wire, and she got it free by herself.

zh: 我試穿的裙子太短，鞋子的尺寸也不對。店員拿來一件短褲和一雙大一號的鞋讓我試。
en: The skirt I tried on was too short, and the shoes were the wrong size. The clerk brought a pair of shorts and shoes one size bigger for me to try.

zh: 一條蛇停在步道右邊，弟弟大聲喊我。我用手勢示意他停下來，然後我們一起慢慢往後退。
en: A snake stopped on the right side of the path, and my brother shouted to me. I gave him a sign with my hand to stop, and then we slowly stepped back together.

zh: 我姊姊愛唱歌。她在上次學校的表演中唱了一首歌。從那時起，她就一直想成為歌手。
en: My sister loves to sing. She sang a song at the last school show. Since then, she has always wanted to be a singer.

zh: 早上天空灰灰的，我躺在沙發上睡著了。外面下了雪，所以等我醒來，陽臺上的椅子全白了。
en: The sky was gray in the morning, and I lay on the sofa and went to sleep. It snowed outside, so when I woke up, the chairs on the balcony were all white.

zh: 一塊小積木掉進櫃子的縫裡。弟弟很聰明，拿了一把細長的尺把積木推出來。這個方法很慢，但確實有效。
en: A small block fell into the space behind the cabinet. My brother is smart. He took a long, slim ruler and pushed the block out. This way is slow, but it really works.

zh: 一名軍人經過操場，聞到一股燒焦的味道。他看到廚房的窗戶冒煙，立刻打電話求救。
en: A soldier walked past the playground and smelled something burning. He saw smoke coming from the kitchen window and called for help right away.

zh: 廚房裡某個地方傳來奇怪的聲音。有人把一些紙箱放在桌子底下，其中一個箱子裡有東西在動。
en: A strange sound came from somewhere in the kitchen. Someone had put some boxes under the table, and something was moving in one of them.

zh: 我叔叔有時會帶兒子去聽演唱會。他們最喜歡的明星很快就要上台唱最後一首歌了。
en: My uncle sometimes takes his son to concerts. Their favorite star will soon go on stage to sing the last song.

zh: 很抱歉，我今天喉嚨痛，不能說話。我在紙條上寫了「請給我一碗湯」，拿給媽媽看。
en: I am sorry. I have a sore throat today and cannot speak. I wrote "Please give me a bowl of soup" on a note and showed it to Mom.

zh: 春天到了，我們要往南走，到外婆家住幾天。我想花一個下午陪她種花。
en: Spring is here. We are going south to stay at Grandma's house for a few days. I want to spend an afternoon planting flowers with her.

zh: 樓梯下面有一張正方形的桌子。桌子旁還有空位，你可以站在那裡一起拍照。
en: There is a square table under the stairs. There is still space beside the table, so you can stand there and be in the photo with us.

zh: 老師今天出了特別的題目。每個學生要說出最喜歡的學科，再用英文拼出它的名字。
en: The teacher gave us a special task today. Each student has to say his or her favorite subject and then spell its name in English.

zh: 從這條街的盡頭出發，一直往前走。在紅綠燈前停下來。車站就在對面。
en: Start from the end of this street and go straight. Stop at the traffic light. The station is just across the street.

zh: 昨晚那幾本書還在店裡。每本都有一則關於貓的故事。我用細繩把書綁好。我哥哥很強壯，他幫我把書搬回家。
en: The books were still in the store last night. Each one has a story about a cat. I tied the books with string. My brother is strong, and he helped me carry them home.

zh: 我怕問笨問題，一直不敢舉手。姐姐晚上陪我讀書。第二天我很確定答案，就舉手了。我們的讀書計畫很成功。
en: I was afraid of asking stupid questions, so I never raised my hand. My sister studied with me in the evening. The next day I was sure of the answer, so I raised my hand. Our study plan was successful.

zh: 我去超級市場買了一袋糖。妹妹在檸檬汁裡加了一匙，喝了一口。「夠甜了！」她說。
en: I went to the supermarket and bought a bag of sugar. My sister added a spoonful to the lemon juice and took a sip. "It is sweet enough!" she said.

zh: 今天很晴朗，太陽照進我的房間。姐姐在窗前放了一盆花，想給我一個驚喜。看到花盆上有我的名字，我好驚訝。
en: It is sunny today, and the sun is shining into my room. My sister put a pot of flowers by the window to give me a surprise. I was so surprised to see my name on the pot.

zh: 我把短袖圓領衫摺好，用緞帶綁起來，再用膠帶把價格牌貼在桌子上。攤位看起來很整齊。
en: I folded the T-shirts and tied them with ribbon, and then I used tape to stick the price tag on the table. The stand looked very tidy.

zh: 架子頂端有一隻玩具老虎，尾巴上積了厚厚的灰塵。我輕輕碰了一下尾巴，手指就黑了。
en: There is a toy tiger on top of the shelf, and there is thick dust on its tail. I touched the tail lightly, and my finger turned black.

zh: 請帶上相機，跟我們去鎮上那間廟。外公會搭計程車到廟門口等我們。
en: Please take your camera and come with us to the temple in town. Grandpa will take a taxi and wait for us at the temple gate.

zh: 今天訪問的話題是學校生活。我們和一位老師聊天，她教十幾歲的孩子用電腦打字。
en: The topic of today's interview is school life. We talked with a teacher. She teaches teenagers to type on a computer.

words.zh: 十三歲到十九歲的少年

zh: 網球隊來了一位新隊員。他比我高，人很瘦，發球卻很有力。
en: A new player joined the tennis team. He is taller than I am and very thin, but his serve is strong.

zh: 我喉嚨乾，想喝一口茶。我先嚐了一小口，茶太燙了，就把杯子放下。
en: My throat was dry, and I wanted some tea. I tasted a little first. The tea was too hot, so I put the cup down.

zh: 我打電話給哥哥，告訴他：「比賽改到今晚了。我們先吃晚餐，再一起看電視轉播吧。」
en: I called my brother on the telephone and told him, "The game was moved to tonight. Let's have dinner first and then watch it on TV together."

zh: 雖然雨停了，交通狀況還是很糟。一輛卡車卡在路口，後面的車都過不去。
en: Though the rain stopped, the traffic was still terrible. A truck was stuck at the crossing, and the cars behind it could not get through.

zh: 他們剛考完試，看起來都很累。我想他們現在只想回家睡覺。
en: They just finished the test, and they all look tired. I think that they just want to go home and sleep now.

zh: 那個男孩在戲院門口撿到一張票。票的主人還在那裡找，他把票還給她，她連忙向他道謝。
en: The boy found a ticket at the door of the theater. The owner of the ticket was still looking for it there. He gave it back to her, and she thanked him at once.

zh: 我帶這些東西來交換。你可以拿走這個杯子，那些盤子要留給奶奶。
en: I brought these things to trade. You can take this cup, but those plates are for Grandma.

zh: 輪到我丟球了。我連丟兩次都沒進，第三次才把球丟進籃子裡。
en: It was my turn to throw the ball. I missed twice, and the third time I finally threw the ball into the basket.

zh: 晚餐的總額是九百元。我們拿出一千元，打算把剩下的一百元留給服務生當小費。
en: The total for dinner was nine hundred dollars. We took out one thousand dollars and planned to leave the other one hundred as a tip for the waiter.

zh: 我們搭火車去旅行。我穿過車廂時，腳趾撞到一個硬硬的箱子。
en: We took a trip by train. When I walked through the train car, my toe hit a hard box.

zh: 今天我和媽媽一起摘番茄。我們留了兩顆，明天野餐時要坐在樹下吃。
en: Today Mom and I picked tomatoes together. We kept two, and tomorrow we will eat them under a tree at our picnic.

zh: 家裡的馬桶一直流水，給我們添了不少麻煩。爸爸拿著工具走進來，想試著把它修好。
en: The toilet at home keeps running, and it has given us a lot of trouble. Dad came in with his tools to try to fix it.

zh: 妹妹掉了一顆牙，哭得滿臉都是淚。我拿毛巾替她擦臉，牙醫也很溫柔地對待她。
en: My sister lost a tooth and cried until her face was covered in tears. I wiped her face with a towel, and the dentist treated her gently, too.

zh: 叔叔平常都把鑰匙放在制服口袋裡。今天他一直找到中午，才在椅子下面找到鑰匙。
en: My uncle usually keeps his keys in the pocket of his uniform. Today he looked for them until noon and finally found them under a chair.

zh: 山路分成兩條，一條往上，一條往下。我用手機看地圖，這才看懂路牌。這張地圖真有用。
en: The mountain road divides into two, one going up and one going down. I used the map on my phone, and then I could understand the road sign. This map is really useful.

zh: 今天有幾位訪客來參觀我們的學校。菜園裡的蔬菜長得非常好，老師摘了一些送給他們。
en: Today several visitors came to visit our school. The vegetables in the garden are growing very well, so the teacher picked some for them.

zh: 影片裡的女孩正在拉小提琴。旁邊有人輕聲數拍子，我認出了外公的聲音。
en: The girl in the video is playing the violin. Someone beside her is counting the beat in a low voice, and I knew it was my grandfather's voice.

zh: 我想走路去海邊看日出，就先叫醒弟弟。爸爸已經在門口等我們了。
en: I wanted to walk to the beach to watch the sunrise, so I woke my brother first. Dad was already waiting for us at the door.

zh: 風從窗戶吹進來，牆上的畫開始晃動。我看著那幅畫。畫裡的小孩好像在向我揮手。
en: The wind blew in through the window, and the picture on the wall started to move. I watched the picture. The child in it seemed to wave at me.

zh: 小狗昨天很虛弱，我給牠水喝，讓牠睡在溫暖的房間。今天牠看起來已經很健康了。
en: The puppy was weak yesterday, so I gave it water and let it sleep in a warm room. Today it already looks well.

zh: 我們在西門歡迎新同學。去教室的路上有一條很寬的走廊，我們可以並肩走。
en: We welcomed our new classmates at the west gate. On the way to the classroom there is a wide hallway, and we can walk side by side.

zh: 這個星期天氣多變，我連穿了三天雨鞋。到了週末，操場還是濕的。
en: The weather kept changing this week, and I wore rain boots for three days in a row. By the weekend, the playground was still wet.

zh: 我們要帶什麼？什麼時候出發，在哪裡集合？我還不知道妹妹是否會來。哪一個便當盒是她的？
en: What should we bring? When do we leave, and where do we meet? I don't know whether my sister will come yet. Which lunch box is hers?

zh: 我在收書包的時候，發現門口有雙白鞋。這是誰的鞋？誰放在這裡的？為什麼只有一隻有鞋帶？
en: While I was packing my schoolbag, I saw a pair of white shoes at the door. Whose shoes are these? Who put them here? Why does only one have a shoelace?

zh: 明天舅舅將和他的妻子一起參加划船比賽。他們很想贏，我祝他們好運。
en: Tomorrow my uncle will take part in a boat race with his wife. They really want to win, and I wish them good luck.

zh: 故事裡有個有智慧的女人，她帶孩子們去看世界。他們一起看了許多很棒的地方。現在孩子們也能自己旅行，不用她陪。
en: In the story there is a wise woman, and she takes the children to see the world. Together they see many wonderful places. Now the children can travel by themselves without her.

zh: 爸爸和其他工人還在橋上工作。爸爸這麼晚還沒回家，媽媽很擔心。她留了一盞燈給他。
en: Dad and the other workers are still working on the bridge. Dad is not home yet at this late hour, and Mom is worried. She left a light on for him.

zh: 我想當作家，每晚都寫一小段故事。妹妹發現我用錯一個字，還幫我圈起來。
en: I want to be a writer, so I write a short part of a story every night. My sister found that I used a wrong word and circled it for me.

zh: 我年輕時，每年都和爺爺在庭院裡種花。他最喜歡黃色的花，我就把它們種在門口。
en: When I was young, I planted flowers in the yard with my grandfather every year. He liked yellow flowers best, so I planted them by the door.

zh: 你昨天去圖書館了嗎？是的，我借了一本書，但還沒看完。
en: Did you go to the library yesterday? Yes, I borrowed a book, but I have not finished it yet.

zh: 我們在動物園記錄企鵝的數量。我數水裡的，弟弟數岸上的。他那一欄的數字是零。
en: We recorded the number of penguins at the zoo. I counted the ones in the water, and my brother counted the ones on land. The number in his column was zero.

zh: 老師問小青昨天為什麼缺席。聽完她對那場事故的描述，我才承認自己把她缺席的原因說錯了。
en: The teacher asked Xiao-Qing why she was absent yesterday. After listening to her description of the accident, I admitted that I had given the wrong reason for her absence.

zh: 阿姨是社區裡很活躍的一員。這次她接受我們的邀請，來參加一場讓小孩和成年人一起玩的活動。
en: My aunt is a very active member of the community. This time she accepted our invitation to join an activity where children and adults play together.

zh: 小安用加法算出我們總共有三十元。等大家把錢放在桌上，我們才發現實際的金額是四十元，平均每人有八元。
en: Xiao-An used addition and found that we had thirty dollars in total. When everyone put their money on the table, we found that the actual amount was forty dollars, so the average was eight dollars for each person.

zh: 為了安排客人抵達後的行程，我們提前走了一遍預定的路線。出門前，我把旅館地址寫在每張地圖上。
en: To arrange the schedule for our guests after their arrival, we walked the planned route in advance. Before we left, I wrote the hotel's address on every map.

zh: 我們的目標是讓整隊在天黑前抵達營地。隊長聽了嚮導的忠告，決定在他的幫助下沿著河岸前進。
en: Our aim was to get the whole team to the camp before dark. The captain listened to the guide's advice and decided to go along the riverbank with his assistance.

zh: 砍樹的事件影響了全校。兩名同學對這件事有不同看法，爭論了起來。反對砍樹的同學努力壓住怒氣，讓對方先說完。
en: The tree-cutting affected the whole school. Two students had different opinions about it and started to argue. The student against cutting the trees tried hard to control his anger and let the other student finish first.

zh: 警報響起後，一架搜救用的航空器飛進山區。獨自在山上過夜的登山客還活著，他試著揮動紅外套，讓飛行員看見他。
en: After the alarm went off, a rescue aircraft flew into the mountains. The hiker who had spent the night alone on the mountain was still alive, and he tried to wave his red jacket so the pilot could see him.

zh: 在相簿裡所有的照片之中，我最喜歡外公和他哥哥那張。他們年輕時外貌很相似，連媽媽都分不出來。
en: Among all the photos in the album, I like the one of my grandfather and his brother best. They looked so alike when they were young that even my mother cannot tell them apart.

zh: 老師請我大聲朗讀一篇介紹本地藝術家的文章。讀到一半，作者的一個問題吸引了全班的注意：「如果畫裡的人會說話，他想告訴你什麼？」
en: The teacher asked me to read aloud an article about a local artist. Halfway through, a question from the author caught the attention of the whole class: "If the person in the painting could talk, what would he want to tell you?"

zh: 博物館展出一支古代軍隊留下的箭。從側面看過去，才能看清楚它射進木板時的角度。
en: The museum shows an arrow left by an ancient army. Only from the side can you clearly see the angle at which it hit the wooden board.

zh: 妹妹擦傷腳踝，教練幫她塗上藥膏。她很感謝教練的幫忙，也答應今天會避免再跑跳。
en: My sister scraped her ankle, and the coach put some ointment on it. She appreciated the coach's help and promised to avoid running and jumping today.

zh: 哥哥說這台相機現在沒人用，我隨時都能借，也能帶去任何地方。不管怎樣，我都得在星期五之前還給他。
en: My brother said nobody uses this camera now, so I can borrow it anytime and take it anywhere. Anyhow, I have to give it back to him before Friday.

zh: 飼育員靠近時，那隻小猿還睡著。牠醒來後胃口很好，一下就吃完了午餐。
en: The little ape was still asleep when the keeper came near. When it woke up, it had a good appetite and finished its lunch quickly.

zh: 打羽毛球時，我向後跨了一步，踩到場邊的背包。那一步讓我整個人往後倒，好不容易才恢復平衡。
en: While playing badminton, I took a step backward and stepped on a backpack by the court. That step made me fall backward, and I finally got my balance back.

words.zh: 遠足用的揹包、雙肩揹包

zh: 叔叔的麵包店每天早上烤兩種麵包。我挑了一個美式比司吉，妹妹拿了一個小圓麵包，抹上一點點奶油。
en: My uncle's bakery bakes two kinds of bread every morning. I picked an American biscuit, and my sister took a small bun and put a little butter on it.

zh: 妹妹在陽台上放開了氣球。它飄到樹枝旁，一碰到尖刺就爆開了。
en: My sister let go of the balloon on the balcony. It floated next to a branch and burst as soon as it touched a sharp thorn.

zh: 在河邊烤肉時，爸爸到岸邊的酒吧買飲料。回來一看，帳單上多了一杯他沒點的啤酒，他就拿著單子回去問店員。
en: At a barbecue by the river, Dad went to the bar on the bank to buy drinks. When he came back, he saw a beer on the bill that he did not order, so he took the bill back to ask the clerk.

zh: 老家的牆上掛著兩張照片。一張是外公年輕時當理髮師，正替客人修鬍子的樣子。另一張是外婆的婚紗照，外公說她的美貌讓他一見難忘。
en: Two photos hang on the wall of our old house. One shows my grandfather as a young barber, trimming a customer's beard. The other is my grandmother's wedding photo. Grandpa says her beauty made him unable to forget her at first sight.

zh: 我正要幫小狗洗澡，牠就對著水管叫。我拜託哥哥過來幫忙，他一到，小狗就乖乖守規矩了。
en: I was about to give the puppy a bath when it started barking at the hose. I begged my brother to come and help, and as soon as he arrived, the puppy began to behave.

zh: 初學者要先學製陶的基礎。老師說，最基本的一步是把杯子的底部壓平，這也是做好整個杯子的基礎。
en: Beginners must first learn the basics of making pottery. The teacher said the most basic step is to press the bottom of the cup flat, and this is also the basis for making the whole cup well.

words.zh: 最簡單但最重要的部分、基本

zh: 爺爺說，以前有一場戰役就發生在國境附近。沿著河走，過了第一個轉彎處，就能看到橋那一邊的舊城牆。
en: Grandpa said a battle once happened near the border. If you walk along the river past the first bend, you can see the old city wall on the other side of the bridge.

zh: 老師在黑板上畫了四個空白方格，每一格代表一個拍子。我指著方格，跟著拍手唱歌，這次比上次唱得更好了。
en: The teacher drew four blank boxes on the blackboard, and each box stood for one beat. I pointed at the boxes, clapped, and sang along. This time I sang better than last time.

zh: 姊姊始終相信地球以外也有生命。她望著星空問我：「如果那裡有十億顆行星，上面會住著什麼樣的生物呢？」
en: My sister has always believed there is life beyond the earth. Looking at the starry sky, she asked me, "If there are a billion planets out there, what kind of beings live on them?"

zh: 弟弟出生後沒多久，爸爸就第一次抱了他。他的小毯子上沾了一點血，護理師替他換了一條乾淨的。爸爸到現在還留著記錄弟弟出生時間的卡片。
en: Soon after my brother's birth, Dad held him for the first time. There was a little blood on his small blanket, so the nurse gave him a clean one. Dad still keeps the card that recorded the time of my brother's birth.

zh: 弟弟上車後才發現球袋還在球場。他責怪自己，又不想打擾隊長。隊長說：「別一個人扛這個重擔。我陪你回去找。」
en: My brother got on the bus and then found that his ball bag was still at the court. He blamed himself and did not want to bother the captain. The captain said, "Don't carry this burden alone. I will go back and look for it with you."

zh: 媽媽把骨頭放進鍋裡熬湯。等水滾了，她讓我把火轉小，並提醒我別讓蒸氣燙傷手。
en: Mom put some bones in a pot to boil soup. When the water was boiling, she let me turn down the heat and reminded me not to let the steam burn my hand.

zh: 一位商人帶著自己設計的筆記本來到我們的書店。媽媽認得封底的商標，原來這是她小時候最喜歡的牌子。
en: A businessman came to our bookstore with notebooks he had designed himself. Mom recognized the brand on the back cover. It turned out to be her favorite brand when she was a child.

zh: 一位才華出眾的老師來學校做了一場簡短的演講。她讓我們閉上眼睛想像回家的路，再解釋大腦怎麼記住那些街道。
en: A brilliant teacher came to our school and gave a brief speech. She asked us to close our eyes and imagine the way home, and then she explained how the brain remembers those streets.

zh: 那棟建築物有一面很寬的牆。美術老師拿起一把大刷子，只刷了幾下，白牆上就出現了一片藍色的海。
en: That building has a very broad wall. The art teacher picked up a big brush, and with only a few strokes, a blue sea appeared on the white wall.

zh: 鄉間有家咖啡館，每天中午都賣高麗菜玉米湯。那天我們只帶了現金，剛好夠買兩碗。
en: There is a cafe in the countryside that sells cabbage and corn soup every day at noon. That day we only brought cash, and it was just enough for two bowls.

zh: 我們在獸醫院看見一隻駱駝，牠一聽到隔壁籠子的鏈條聲就站了起來。飼育員陪在旁邊，等牠平靜下來才離開。
en: At the animal hospital we saw a camel. It stood up as soon as it heard the sound of a chain from the next cage. The keeper stayed beside it and did not leave until it calmed down.

zh: 我看了行事曆，發現班遊和校慶的日期有衝突。老師請我聯絡遊覽車公司，看看能不能改期，這樣就不用取消班遊了。
en: I looked at the calendar and found that the date of our class trip and the school anniversary were in conflict. The teacher asked me to contact the bus company to see if we could change the date, so we would not have to cancel the trip.

zh: 阿姨結束癌症治療後回來繼續教書。我們點起蛋糕上的蠟燭，向她道賀。她讀著卡片說，很謝謝大家這段時間的關心。
en: My aunt came back to teach after she finished her cancer treatment. We lit the candles on the cake to congratulate her. Reading the card, she said she was very thankful for everyone's care during this time.

zh: 首都的中央廣場旁有一座古堡。導遊說，這座城堡是在五個多世紀前蓋好的。
en: There is an old castle beside the central square of the capital. The guide said the castle was finished more than five centuries ago.

zh: 我轉到卡通頻道，剛好看到一隻貓追著一隻老鼠跑。看到最緊張的地方，電視卻開始播可樂的廣告。
en: I changed to the cartoon channel and saw a cat chasing a mouse. At the most exciting moment, the TV started to show a commercial for cola.

zh: 大雨過後，老師來看教室的狀況。天花板上有一道長十公分的裂縫，原來這就是漏水的原因。
en: After the heavy rain, the teacher came to check the classroom. There was a crack ten centimeters long in the ceiling. That was the cause of the leak.

zh: 老師用粉筆在黑板上畫了一張圖表，讓我們記錄看到的細胞數量。我們用一種化學藥品把細胞染色，再輪流透過顯微鏡觀察。
en: The teacher drew a chart on the blackboard with chalk so we could record the number of cells we saw. We dyed the cells with a chemical and took turns looking at them through a microscope.

zh: 我打開櫃子，看到一隻蟑螂從架子上爬過。還好裝麥片的盒子有蓋緊，標籤上寫著裡面含有可可粉。
en: I opened the cabinet and saw a cockroach crawling across the shelf. Luckily, the box of cereal was closed tightly. The label said it contained cocoa powder.

zh: 小明很有信心，聲稱沒人下西洋棋贏得了他。妹妹接受他的挑戰，先約好誰都不能偷看手機作弊。
en: Xiao-Ming was confident and claimed that nobody could beat him at chess. My sister accepted his challenge, and they first agreed that no one could cheat by looking at a phone.

zh: 我讀的那本經典名著，第一章就出現了我最喜歡的角色。部落首領命令他留在村裡，他卻趁夜出去找人。
en: In the classic novel I am reading, my favorite character appears in the first chapter. The chief of the tribe commanded him to stay in the village, but he went out at night to look for someone.

zh: 這台小火車每次收費十元。我投了一枚硬幣，聽到開關扣上的輕響，就轉動車上的旋鈕控制車速。
en: This little train charges ten dollars each time. I put in a coin, heard the soft click of the switch, and turned the control knob to change the speed.

zh: 同班同學在台上第一次演奏古典音樂。一曲結束，我們一起拍手，還有人站起來為她歡呼。
en: My classmate played classical music on stage for the first time. When the piece ended, we all clapped, and some people stood up to cheer for her.

zh: 翻到童年畫的漫畫，我忍不住笑了。那時我覺得梳頭髮很幼稚，所以把每個大人的梳子都畫成一條魚。
en: I couldn't help laughing when I found the comics I drew in my childhood. Back then I thought combing my hair was childish, so I drew every adult's comb as a fish.

zh: 姑姑從中國旅行回來，帶回一套瓷器和一雙筷子。包著瓷器的那塊藍布很漂亮，妹妹想拿來做娃娃的衣服。
en: My aunt came back from a trip to China with a set of china and a pair of chopsticks. The blue cloth around the china was so pretty that my sister wanted to use it to make clothes for her doll.

zh: 念大學的哥哥想出一個聰明的辦法，把兩個實驗結合起來。原本很複雜的作業，他一個下午就完成了。
en: My brother in college came up with a clever way to combine two experiments. He finished a very complex assignment in one afternoon.

zh: 老師讓我們比較海岸和山區的氣候。我挑了兩地同一天的照片，山區是陰天，海邊卻一片晴朗。老師提醒我還得看看多年的紀錄。
en: The teacher asked us to compare the climate of the coast and the mountains. I chose photos of both places on the same day. It was cloudy in the mountains, but it was clear by the sea. The teacher reminded me to check the records of many years, too.

zh: 我看到一張舊照片，裡面的小黑山旁停著好幾輛貨車。我讀到那家公司以前專門運煤，才推斷出黑山其實是一堆煤。
en: I saw an old photo with several trucks parked beside a small black hill. I read that the company used to carry coal, so I concluded that the black hill was really a pile of coal.

zh: 我們和客服談話時，爸爸說家裡的網路連線一直中斷。對方請我們考慮新的合約，爸爸說他還得把費用列入考量。
en: While we were talking with customer service, Dad said the internet connection at home kept stopping. They asked us to consider a new contract, and Dad said he still had to take the cost into consideration.

zh: 一對夫妻親眼看見那起犯罪。妻子害怕在法庭上開口，丈夫陪她走進去，她才鼓起勇氣說出經過。
en: A married couple saw the crime with their own eyes. The wife was afraid to speak in court. Her husband walked in with her, and then she found the courage to tell what happened.

zh: 弟弟用蠟筆創造了一個西部小鎮。他畫了一個牛仔站在窗前拉開窗簾，外頭有隻烏鴉正叼著他的帽子。
en: My brother created a western town with crayons. He drew a cowboy standing at the window and opening the curtain. Outside, a crow was holding his hat in its mouth.

zh: 一位顧客看見一排小鳥形狀的麵包，很好奇裡面包了什麼餡。店主切開一個，給她看裡頭的鮮奶油。在他的家鄉，春天烤這種麵包是一項習俗。
en: A customer saw a row of bird-shaped buns and was curious about what was inside. The owner cut one open and showed her the cream inside. In his hometown, baking these buns in spring is a custom.

zh: 人群跟著鼓聲走到廣場，參加週末的文化交流活動。奶奶說，小時候她就是透過這些歌認識家鄉的文化。
en: The crowd followed the drums to the square to join the weekend cultural exchange. Grandma said she learned about the culture of her hometown through these songs when she was little.

zh: 在我們的故事裡，河水的水流帶走了最後幾顆花種，村子陷入危機。這種花能治癒怪病，而且開花週期長達一年，主角得趁種子漂進大海前找回來。
en: In our story, the current of the river carried away the last few flower seeds, and the village was in crisis. This flower can cure a strange disease, and its cycle of blooming lasts a whole year, so the main character has to get the seeds back before they float into the sea.

zh: 颱風過後，我們每天記錄老樹掉了幾根樹枝。老師把數據交給園丁，請他評估老樹受損的程度。
en: After the typhoon, we recorded how many branches the old tree lost every day. The teacher gave the data to the gardener and asked him to judge how much damage the tree had.

zh: 導演請一位聾人舞者參與學校的戲劇演出。兩人一起改了最後幾句對話，讓主角能用手語道別。
en: The director asked a deaf dancer to take part in the school play. Together they changed the last few lines of dialogue so the main character could say goodbye in sign language.

zh: 爸爸先看見遠方山坡上的鹿，我只看得到幾個小點。等鹿走到路邊，他叫我保持距離，靠得太近會有危險。
en: Dad saw the deer on the distant hill first, but I could only see a few small dots. When the deer came to the side of the road, he told me to keep my distance because getting too close was dangerous.

zh: 班上為了校外教學的地點舉行辯論。兩組意見不合，於是先討論各地的車程。討論結束後，大家才投票做決定。
en: Our class held a debate about where to go for the field trip. The two groups did not agree, so we first discussed the travel time to each place. After the discussion, we voted to make a decision.

zh: 我上個月為了買自行車借了錢，今天第一筆款項到期了。如果我每週還的錢加倍，就能早點還清這筆債。
en: Last month I borrowed money to buy a bicycle, and the first payment is due today. If I double the money I pay back each week, I can pay off this debt sooner.

zh: 店家本來要在中午前把餐盒送到我們的部門，但大雨耽擱了司機的行程。這次外送晚了半小時，好在打開餐盒時，飯菜還熱著，吃起來也很美味。
en: The shop was supposed to deliver the lunch boxes to our department before noon, but the heavy rain caused a delay for the driver. The delivery was half an hour late this time. Luckily, the food was still hot when we opened the boxes, and it was delicious.

zh: 牙醫問起我的飲食習慣，我否認自己每天吃糖。回家翻開日記，我才發現這星期每天都寫了自己吃哪一種糖。
en: The dentist asked about my diet, and I denied eating candy every day. When I got home and opened my diary, I found that I had written down which kind of candy I ate every day this week.

zh: 沙漠裡的人仰賴一口老井取水。工人量井的深度時，發現井壁上有古老的圖畫。他們把這項發現告訴村長。
en: People in the desert depend on an old well for water. When the workers measured the depth of the well, they discovered ancient pictures on the wall of the well. They told the village head about this discovery.

zh: 我向櫃檯人員描述遺失的戒指，還提到一個細節。戒指內側有一顆星。我的描述剛好符合工作人員撿到的那枚鑽石戒指。
en: I described my lost ring to the person at the counter and mentioned one detail. There is a star on the inside of the ring. My description matched the diamond ring that a worker had found.

zh: 老師要我們設計一把椅子，我先畫了一張鉛筆素描。展覽當天，我把第一張草圖和成品一起展出，讓大家看看這個點子如何一步步發展。
en: The teacher asked us to design a chair, and I drew a pencil sketch first. On the day of the show, I displayed my first draft with the finished chair so everyone could see how the idea developed step by step.

zh: 爺爺從抽屜裡拿出兩支舊電話，問我看得出它們的差別嗎。我用按鍵電話撥號很順利，換成轉盤電話就遇到了困難。
en: Grandpa took two old phones out of the drawer and asked me if I could see the difference between them. I had no problem dialing with the push-button phone, but I had difficulty with the rotary phone.

zh: 地圖上的藍色小圓點代表國內線航廈。阿姨指引我們走到月台，還提醒我們上車前先看清列車行駛的方向。
en: The small blue dot on the map stands for the domestic terminal. My aunt directed us to the platform and reminded us to check which direction the train was going before we got on.

zh: 魔術師把一隻白鴿放進盒子。盒蓋再打開時，鴿子消失了。我不相信牠真的不見了，就跑到樓下，果然看見助手捧著那隻鳥。
en: The magician put a white dove into a box. When the lid was opened again, the dove had disappeared. I didn't believe it was really gone, so I ran downstairs and saw the assistant holding the bird.

zh: 我下載了一個練習除法的遊戲。要過第一關，得把二十四塊餅乾平均分給六個小孩。
en: I downloaded a game for practicing division. To pass the first level, I had to divide twenty-four cookies equally among six children.

zh: 學校的戲劇演出剛開始，一條龍就從煙裡探出頭來。牠的鱗片本來黯淡無光，燈一照下去，竟然變成了金色。
en: The school play had just started when a dragon put its head out of the smoke. Its scales were dull at first, but when the light shone on them, they turned gold.

zh: 故事裡，全村的人都得了一種奇怪的疾病。年輕藥師認為找出能對付這種病的藥是自己的責任，便帶著老師的筆記上山找藥材。
en: In the story, everyone in the village got a strange disease. The young pharmacist thought it was his duty to find a drug for this disease, so he took his teacher's notes and went up the mountain to look for herbs.

zh: 球衣到晚上還沒乾，我拿去樓下放進烘衣機。幸好及時烘乾，第二天大家穿好球衣出發，沒有耽擱。
en: The team shirts were still wet in the evening, so I took them downstairs and put them in the dryer. Luckily, they were dry in time. The next day everyone put on the shirts and left without delay.

zh: 島的東部有座很高的山，山崖邊緣有個老鷹的巢。我特別喜歡清晨來這裡，看親鳥展翅飛出去。
en: There is a high mountain in the eastern part of the island, and there is an eagle's nest at the edge of the cliff. I especially like coming here early in the morning to watch the parent birds spread their wings and fly out.

zh: 我靠週末打工賺到了第一份薪水，想替家裡一位長輩挑份禮物。奶奶愛戴耳環，我就選了一對她最喜歡的藍色耳環。
en: I earned my first pay from a weekend job, and I wanted to choose a gift for an elder in my family. Grandma loves to wear earrings, so I chose a pair of blue earrings, her favorite color.

zh: 地震過後，老師請我們用畫來表達自己的情緒。妹妹畫了兩道皺起的眉毛，那是她害怕時的表情。說起自己的畫，她心裡的恐懼也減輕了。
en: After the earthquake, the teacher asked us to express our emotions with drawings. My sister drew two frowning eyebrows, which was her face when she was scared. As she talked about her drawing, her fear became smaller.

zh: 新版課本寫了山裡的孩子怎麼爭取上學的機會。作者在書末強調，每個孩子都該有平等的受教育機會。
en: The new edition of the textbook describes how children in the mountains fight for the chance to go to school. At the end of the book, the author stresses that every child should have an equal chance at education.

zh: 我快要停下來時，哥哥在跑道邊鼓勵我。他的話對我很有作用，我決定再努力一下。比起一開始就衝刺，慢慢起跑對我更有效。
en: When I was about to stop, my brother encouraged me from the side of the track. His words had a strong effect on me, and I decided to try a little harder. Starting slowly is more effective for me than running fast from the start.

zh: 電動車從電池取得能量。爸爸的舊車則靠汽油驅動引擎。在修車廠，師傅指給我們看電動車裡的電路和其他電氣設備。
en: An electric car gets its energy from a battery. Dad's old car uses gas to power its engine. At the garage, the mechanic showed us the electric circuits and other electrical equipment in the electric car.

zh: 巷口的麵包店剛僱用了我，現在我是店裡最年輕的員工。雇主說，如果我去別家分店幫忙，搭車的費用由店裡出。
en: The bakery at the end of the lane just hired me, and now I am the youngest employee in the shop. My employer said the shop will pay for my bus fare if I go to help at another branch.

zh: 閉館前，我從入口走到出口，找遍了整間展覽館。最後一間展覽室已經空了，妹妹原來早就在外面等我。
en: Before the museum closed, I walked from the entrance to the exit and searched the entire hall. The last room was already empty. My sister had been waiting for me outside all along.

zh: 邪惡的國王把王子和公主鎖在塔裡。兩人原本是敵人，卻決定一起逃出去。我最喜歡這個結局，他們回來打開城門，讓所有人重獲自由。
en: The evil king locked the prince and princess in a tower. The two had been enemies, but they decided to escape together. I like the ending best: they come back and open the city gate, and everyone is free again.

zh: 我為了寫一篇談環境問題的短文，到河邊訪問一位專家。我們一起撿起水裡的塑膠袋，她讓我看見垃圾如何改變魚生活的環境。
en: To write a short essay about environmental problems, I went to the river to interview an expert. We picked plastic bags out of the water together, and she showed me how trash changes the environment where fish live.

zh: 運動會是我們學校今年的一件大事。比賽前夕，老師公布接力賽開始的確切時間，這個消息讓我們全隊興奮不已。
en: The sports day is a big event at our school this year. The night before the races, the teacher announced the exact time the relay would start, and the news made our whole team very excited.

zh: 考試結束後，我還在檢查最後一道題，想跟老師多要一分鐘。她指了指時鐘，我只好交卷，沒再找藉口要求額外的時間。
en: When the exam ended, I was still checking the last question and wanted to ask the teacher for one more minute. She pointed at the clock, so I handed in my paper and did not make any more excuses for extra time.

zh: 弟弟相信湖裡真的存在一隻水怪。他拿一張模糊的照片給專家看，她說光憑這張照片，還無法證明水怪的存在。
en: My brother believes a monster really exists in the lake. He showed an expert a blurry photo, and she said this photo alone could not prove the monster's existence.

zh: 我們訪問了一位剛在決賽落敗的女跑者。她說，疲勞是影響成績的一個因素。這次失敗讓她學會下次要更妥善安排休息時間。
en: We interviewed a female runner who had just lost in the final. She said that being tired was one factor that affected her result. This failure taught her to plan her rest time better next time.

zh: 裁判是我叔叔，但他沒有偏袒我們，而是讓兩隊重賽。隊長承認剛才偷跑是他的過錯，請對手原諒。我覺得這個決定很公平。
en: The referee was my uncle, but he did not favor us. Instead, he made the two teams play again. Our captain admitted that starting early was his fault and asked the other team to forgive him. I think the decision was fair.

zh: 表姐最喜愛的時尚雜誌介紹了一件外套，大口袋裡還有個小口袋。我在市場試穿了一件外觀一樣、又很合身的外套。標籤說它有暗袋，但這個說法是假的。
en: My cousin's favorite fashion magazine showed a coat with a small pocket inside its big pocket. At the market I tried on a coat that looked the same and fit me well. The label said it had a secret pocket, but that was false.

zh: 書裡兩個孩子都畏懼國王，卻因為彼此的友誼而有勇氣逃走。他們終於能決定自己的命運。讀到他們重獲自由那一頁，我也有種鬆了一口氣的感覺。
en: In the book, both children fear the king, but their friendship gives them the courage to escape. At last they can decide their own fate. When I read the page where they are free again, I felt a sense of relief, too.

zh: 我們想創立一個球社，老師請我們先填申請表。收到學校正式的批准通知後，大家才開始討論每個人要繳多少會費。
en: We wanted to form a ball club, and the teacher asked us to fill out an application form first. Only after we got formal approval from the school did we start to discuss how much each member should pay.

zh: 營長帶來一個我不認識的小伙子，讓我們兩人住同一間小屋。第二天他發燒，得了流感，只好回家休息。接下來的星期一，他才回到營隊。
en: The camp leader brought a young fellow I did not know and let the two of us share a cabin. The next day he had a fever and caught the flu, so he had to go home and rest. He did not come back to the camp until the following Monday.

zh: 田野裡起火時，村裡的人急著去搶救農具。強風迫使他們後退，一位女消防員帶大家走到安全的地方。
en: When a fire started in the field, the villagers hurried to save their farm tools. The strong wind forced them back, and a female firefighter led everyone to a safe place.

zh: 森林裡起了霧，我在樹後看見一個瘦小的身影。直到牠走近，我才看清那是一隻叼著果子的狐狸。
en: Fog came into the forest, and I saw a small, thin figure behind a tree. Not until it came closer did I see that it was a fox with a fruit in its mouth.

zh: 漁夫發現河水流得比昨天快，但碼頭的木樁鬆了。他先修好木樁，確定它夠牢固，才把船繫上去。
en: The fisherman noticed that the river was flowing faster than yesterday, and the wooden post at the dock was loose. He fixed the post first and made sure it was firm before he tied his boat to it.

zh: 我們在一塊平坦的草地上試飛模型飛機，用一面紅旗標出終點。這是它第一次飛行，我把注意力集中在機翼上，怕飛機在半路翻覆。
en: We tested our model airplane on a flat field and used a red flag to mark the finish line. It was its first flight, so I focused my attention on the wings, afraid that the plane would flip over halfway.

zh: 美式足球練習前，隊長把教練寄來的影片轉寄給我。練習時，我和隊友像影片裡一樣來回傳球。後來我閉著眼睛往前跑，這個愚蠢的決定害我一頭撞上軟墊。
en: Before football practice, the captain forwarded me a video from the coach. During practice, my teammates and I passed the ball back and forth like in the video. Later I ran forward with my eyes closed, and this foolish decision made me crash into a soft mat.

zh: 我們可以帶炸薯條，也可以帶烤馬鈴薯。弟弟喜歡前一個選項，還自告奮勇要幫忙。我把馬鈴薯切成條，再交給爸爸油炸。
en: We can bring French fries or baked potatoes. My brother liked the former choice and offered to help. I cut the potatoes into strips and handed them to Dad to fry.

zh: 家具店裡有張小桌子，還有收納玩具的功能。看到桌面可以掀開，我想進一步了解它的設計，就請店員再示範一次。
en: There was a small table at the furniture store that could also store toys. When I saw that the top could open, I wanted to learn more about its design, so I asked the clerk to show me again.

zh: 我們在菜圃集合，跟園丁學種大蒜。第一天先清理垃圾，這學期的目標是種出足夠全班吃的蒜頭。我也想累積一些種菜的經驗。
en: We met at the vegetable garden to learn how to grow garlic from the gardener. On the first day we cleared away the garbage. Our goal this term is to grow enough garlic for the whole class. I also want to gain some experience in growing vegetables.

zh: 鄰居說，那位退休將軍是個慷慨的紳士。下雨時他把自己的傘送給迷路的小孩，還用溫柔的聲音告訴她回家的路。
en: The neighbors say the retired general is a generous gentleman. When it rained, he gave his own umbrella to a lost child and told her the way home in a gentle voice.

zh: 妹妹用紙捲做了一隻長頸鹿，脖子卻一直歪下來。她今天的目標是讓長頸鹿自己站好，所以拿了膠水來，把兩層厚紙黏在一起當底座。
en: My sister made a giraffe out of paper rolls, but its neck kept falling to one side. Her goal today was to make the giraffe stand by itself, so she got some glue and stuck two layers of thick paper together as a base.

zh: 我每天秤五十公克的穀物餵鵝，再帶小山羊去吃草。為了記錄小山羊的成長，我每週幫牠量一次身高。
en: Every day I weigh fifty grams of grain to feed the geese, and then I take the young goat out to eat grass. To record the goat's growth, I measure its height once a week.

zh: 雄偉的王宮有一扇金色的大門，門上的小鳥是用黃金做的。門口的警衛背著槍，提醒我們在門外等。
en: The grand palace has a big golden gate, and the little birds on the gate are made of gold. The guards at the gate carry guns and reminded us to wait outside.

zh: 以前一位女王統治這座島，現在島上的事務由當地政府管理。島上的改變是逐步的，學校等了好幾年才有自己的體育館。
en: A queen used to rule this island. Now the local government manages the island's affairs. The changes on the island were gradual, and the school waited several years before it had its own gym.

zh: 嚮導在果園門口向每位客人打招呼。他帶我們摘葡萄，又切了一顆芭樂讓大家分著吃。
en: The guide greeted every guest at the gate of the orchard. He took us to pick grapes and cut a guava for everyone to share.

zh: 哥哥去理髮後，約我在飯店大廳見面。他剪短頭髮後看起來好英俊，我幾乎認不出他。
en: After my brother got a haircut, he asked me to meet him in the hotel hall. With short hair he looked so handsome that I almost did not recognize him.

zh: 第一位客人轉動門把時，女主人還在廚房準備漢堡。她請我趕快去開門，再帶客人到桌邊坐。
en: The hostess was still making hamburgers in the kitchen when the first guest turned the door handle. She asked me to open the door quickly and then take the guest to the table.

zh: 這部歷史電影裡的女英雄是一位謙虛的隊長。受過她幫助的人都對她評價很高。故事結尾，小女孩抬起頭，希望在天國的隊長能聽見她說謝謝。
en: The heroine of this historical movie is a humble captain. The people she helped all speak highly of her. At the end of the story, a little girl looks up and hopes the captain in heaven can hear her say thank you.

zh: 我們離開公路，沿著山路健行。弟弟單腳跳過一個洞時跌倒，髖部撞在地上。我陪他坐在路邊休息了一會兒。
en: We left the highway and hiked along the mountain road. My brother fell when he hopped over a hole on one foot, and his hip hit the ground. I sat with him at the side of the road and rested for a while.

zh: 獵人原本想去河邊獵野鴨，卻看見泥地上有巨大的腳印。那些腳印是河馬留下的，比人類的腳印寬得多。
en: The hunter wanted to hunt wild ducks by the river, but he saw huge footprints in the mud. The footprints were left by a hippo, and they were much wider than human footprints.

zh: 我生病時還硬要練球。教練說，這可不是練球的理想時機。他提醒我別忽視休息的重要性，等體力改善了再回球場。
en: I insisted on practicing even though I was ill. The coach said this was not an ideal time to practice. He reminded me not to ignore the importance of rest and to come back to the court when my strength improved.

zh: 相機拍下了選手跳過水坑的影像，我們卻不知道他的身分。很難想像他穿著拖鞋還能跳那麼遠，這一跳真讓人印象深刻。
en: The camera caught an image of a player jumping over a puddle, but we did not know his identity. It is hard to imagine that he could jump so far in slippers. That jump was really impressive.

words.zh: 給人深刻印象的、威嚴的

zh: 展覽裡有一本漁夫的帳簿，裡面的數字顯示他哪幾個月收入增加。從這本帳簿，我們看見漁業有淡季也有旺季。
en: There is a fisherman's account book in the exhibition. The numbers in it show the months when his income increased. From this book, we can see that fishing has slow seasons and busy seasons.

zh: 搬出去住後，姊姊變得更獨立了。對她而言，自主就是能自己安排每一天。她說，這份自由確實會影響一個人看待自己的方式。
en: After moving out, my sister became more independent. For her, being independent means planning each day by herself. She says this freedom does influence the way a person sees herself.

zh: 祖父有些習慣從來沒變。比如說，他堅持用藍色墨水寫信。有一次我勸他改傳簡訊，他卻拿出信紙，還用熨斗把折痕燙平。
en: Some of my grandfather's habits have never changed. For instance, he insists on writing letters in blue ink. Once I tried to get him to send text messages instead, but he took out his writing paper and even used an iron to press the folds flat.

zh: 上課前，老師先給了我們這臺儀器的使用說明。儀器能偵測木盒內部的震動。盒裡的小球一碰到盒壁，螢幕就有即時反應。
en: Before class, the teacher gave us the instructions for using this instrument. It can detect shaking inside a wooden box. As soon as the small ball in the box touches the side, the screen reacts right away.

zh: 這場國際讀書會透過網際網路舉行。主持人做了簡短的開場介紹後，請我們各自介紹一本喜歡的書。
en: This international book club meets on the internet. After a short introduction, the host asked each of us to introduce a book we like.

zh: 爸爸每天早上慢跑，回家後邊吃抹果醬的吐司，邊寫日誌。今天他只寫了一行，說膝關節不舒服，所以提早回家。
en: Dad jogs every morning. When he gets home, he eats toast with jam and writes in his journal. Today he only wrote one line, saying his knee joint did not feel well, so he came home early.

zh: 法官讓最後一位證人把話說完，才做出判決。一名旁聽的學生問老師：「如果只聽一方的說法，怎麼能維護正義？」
en: The judge let the last witness finish speaking before making a decision. A student watching asked the teacher, "How can we protect justice if we only listen to one side?"

zh: 園遊會上，學校的器材室管理員搬來一公斤番茄醬，交給賣薯條的同學。他在清單上記下重量，才去搬下一箱。
en: At the school fair, the man in charge of the equipment room brought a kilogram of ketchup to the students selling fries. He wrote down the weight on his list before he went to get the next box.

zh: 班上的最新消息是小榆要競選班長。她雖然缺乏經驗，卻是很好的傾聽者。上次她讓吵架的兩組坐下來談，大家都看見她的領導才能。
en: The latest news in our class is that Xiao-Yu will run for class leader. Although she lacks experience, she is a good listener. Last time she got two arguing groups to sit down and talk, and everyone saw her leadership.

zh: 那位戴帽子的女士把毛巾放在膝上，再把小羊抱上來。小羊靠著她，很快就睡著了。
en: The lady in the hat put a towel on her lap and then picked up the lamb. The lamb leaned against her and soon fell asleep.

zh: 我把放大鏡借給同桌，讓她透過鏡片觀察樹葉上的瓢蟲。她把尺放在葉子旁，量出瓢蟲身體的長度。
en: I lent my magnifying glass to the classmate next to me so she could look at the ladybug on the leaf through the lens. She put a ruler beside the leaf and measured the length of the ladybug's body.

zh: 當地居民沿著小巷掛了一整排燈籠。夜深人散後，巷口只剩一名獨自收燈的老人。
en: The local people hung a long row of lanterns along the lane. Late at night, after the crowd left, only an old man was left alone at the end of the lane, taking down the lanterns.

zh: 兩位作家在報上討論街頭表演，一人主張禁止，另一人主張開放。後者的立場較自由開放，他希望修改法律，讓街頭表演成為合法的工作。
en: Two writers discussed street performers in the newspaper. One wanted to ban them, and the other wanted to allow them. The latter was more liberal. He hoped to change the law so that street performing could become a legal job.

zh: 老師掀起盒蓋，讓大家看裡面的肝臟模型。模型有一條透明的管子，按一下旁邊的按鈕，紅色液體就會流進去。
en: The teacher lifted the lid of the box and showed us a model of a liver. The model has a clear tube, and when you press the button beside it, red liquid flows in.

zh: 我們正要把最後兩箱裝上小貨車，司機提醒我們，前面的橋有重量限制。如果再裝兩箱，車子就很容易超重，所以我們減輕了車上的重量，把這兩箱留在原地。
en: We were about to load the last two boxes onto the small truck when the driver reminded us that the bridge ahead had a weight limit. If we loaded two more boxes, the truck could easily be too heavy, so we made the load lighter and left these two boxes where they were.

zh: 這張老照片是奶奶和故鄉之間唯一的聯繫。弄丟照片讓她覺得失去了很重要的東西。幸好有人撿到照片，拿去派出所。奶奶拿回照片，笑著說：「我今天的運氣真好！」
en: This old photo is Grandma's only link to her hometown. Losing it made her feel she had lost something very important. Luckily, someone found the photo and took it to the police station. When Grandma got it back, she smiled and said, "I am so lucky today!"

zh: 這本運動雜誌的主要報導都在介紹男性選手，受訪選手中女性只佔少數。新編輯覺得這不是個小問題，下期要讓女選手上封面。
en: The main stories in this sports magazine are about male players, and women are only a minority of the players interviewed. The new editor feels this is not a minor problem, and she will put a female player on the next cover.

zh: 阿姨是租車店的經理，負責管理十幾輛機車。為了把車保養好，她每週都安排時間讓師傅檢查。
en: My aunt is the manager of a scooter rental shop, and she manages more than ten scooters. To keep them in good condition, she makes time every week for a mechanic to check them.

zh: 我把芒果和牛奶混合，再把混合好的飲料倒進我的馬克杯。弟弟伸手拿杯子時打翻了它，我們只好一起拖地。
en: I mixed mango and milk and poured the mixture into my mug. My brother knocked it over when he reached for the cup, so we had to mop the floor together.

zh: 阿公很年輕就和阿嬤結婚了。阿嬤說，那時最打動她的是他待人的溫柔態度。多年後，他們都比以前成熟，也更懂得照顧這段婚姻。
en: Grandpa married Grandma when he was very young. Grandma says what moved her most then was the gentle way he treated people. Years later, they are both more mature and know better how to take care of their marriage.

zh: 我把做狐狸面具的材料擺在桌上，其中有一大團紙漿。等紙漿在狐狸頭的模型上乾了，我就戴上面具照鏡子，看耳朵有沒有歪掉。
en: I put the materials for my fox mask on the table, including a big mass of paper pulp. When the pulp dried on the fox head model, I put on the mask and looked in the mirror to see if the ears were crooked.

zh: 為了精通柔道的摔法，我每天放學後都和柔道社的一位朋友在墊子上練習。到了比賽那天，他一把將我摔倒，我照著練過的動作安全落地。
en: To master judo throws, I practiced on the mat with a friend from the judo club every day after school. On the day of the match, he threw me down, and I landed safely, just like we had practiced.

zh: 對這位音樂家來說，奶奶唱過的旋律有特別的意義。音樂是他保存童年記憶的一種方法，每次彈起這首曲子，他的心情就會好起來。
en: For this musician, the melody his grandmother sang has a special meaning. Music is one method he uses to keep his childhood memories, and his mood gets better every time he plays this song.

zh: 老師要我們測量一根金屬管的長度，可是手邊的捲尺只有一公尺長。我們換了一個方法，每量完一段就做個記號，最後把各段長度加起來。
en: The teacher asked us to measure the length of a metal pipe, but our tape measure was only one meter long. We used another method. We made a mark after each part and added up the lengths at the end.

zh: 午夜時，軍方收到一則求援訊息。訊息中提到，一英里外的村莊需要醫療用品，於是士兵連夜把物資送去。
en: At midnight, the army got a message asking for help. It said a village one mile away needed medical supplies, so the soldiers took the supplies there that night.

zh: 我剛取得劇團的會員資格，劇團就開始為新歌舞劇招募演員。試演時我忘了舞步，只好跟著前面的舞者做動作。
en: I had just become a member of the theater group when it started looking for actors for a new musical. During the audition I forgot the dance steps, so I had to copy the dancer in front of me.

zh: 我和朋友騎單車穿過一條狹窄的巷子時，我的輪胎扎到釘子，氣幾乎漏光了。還好附近就有一家修車店，我把車牽了過去。
en: When my friend and I rode our bikes through a narrow lane, a nail went into my tire, and almost all the air came out. Luckily, there was a bike shop nearby, so I walked my bike there.

zh: 這個國家的北部有一座天然的深水港。以前村民從這裡乘船出海，現在遊客也能搭船看沿岸的村落。
en: There is a natural deep-water harbor in the north of this nation. Villagers used to go out to sea by boat from here. Now visitors can also take a boat to see the villages along the coast.

zh: 我那頑皮的外甥把球踢進鄰居的院子，外甥女陪他去按門鈴。鄰居問他們是不是來撿球的，兩個孩子一起點頭。
en: My naughty nephew kicked a ball into the neighbor's yard, and my niece went with him to ring the doorbell. The neighbor asked if they had come to get the ball, and the two children nodded together.

zh: 我想用堅果的硬殼做一條項鍊。老師說，先在殼上鑽孔是必要的，這樣才能用針把線穿過去。
en: I wanted to make a necklace out of hard nutshells. The teacher said it was necessary to drill holes in the shells first, so I could pass the string through them with a needle.

zh: 我們的模型用一排小燈模擬訊號沿著神經傳遞的過程，就像訊息在電腦網路裡傳遞一樣。第一位觀眾走過來時，我緊張得手心冒汗，怕他給我負面的評語。
en: Our model uses a row of small lights to show how a signal travels along a nerve, just like a message moving through a computer network. When the first visitor came over, I was so nervous that my hands were sweating. I was afraid he would give me negative comments.

zh: 兩個孩子既不吃蔥也不吃蒜，老闆就另外煮了一鍋麵。等其他人想再添一碗時，鍋裡一點也沒剩。
