en: The two children ate neither green onion nor garlic, so the owner cooked a separate pot of noodles. When the others wanted another bowl, there was none left in the pot.

zh: 姊姊一直想寫一本小說，卻每次一提筆就緊張。生日那天我送她一本空白筆記本，她就在第一頁寫下了主角的名字。
en: My sister has always wanted to write a novel, but every time she picks up a pen, she gets nervous. On her birthday I gave her a blank notebook, and she wrote the main character's name on the first page.

zh: 校長說，大家都要遵守操場的使用規定，也歡迎我們提出自己的意見。我反對太早關門，因為放學後還有很多人想留下來運動。
en: The principal said everyone must obey the rules for using the playground, and he welcomed us to share our opinions. I objected to closing the gate too early because many people want to stay and exercise after school.

zh: 暴風雨發生在昨晚。今天，站在岸上還能看到海洋上的大浪。海灘入口的官方告示已經換成紅色，海灘關閉的原因很明顯。
en: The storm happened last night. Today you can still see big waves on the ocean from the shore. The official sign at the beach entrance has changed to red, and the reason the beach is closed is obvious.

zh: 對醫院的接線生來說，這原本是個平常的夜晚。後來醫師來電，說移植用的器官已經送達，外科醫師可以開始動手術了。
en: For the hospital operator, it was an ordinary night at first. Then a doctor called and said the organ for the transplant had arrived, and the surgeon could start the operation.

zh: 一個保存地方歷史的組織找到了這塊老招牌的主人。她一解釋店名的由來，我們才知道這間店最早只賣茶。
en: An organization that keeps local history found the owner of this old sign. When she explained the origin of the shop's name, we learned that the shop only sold tea at first.

zh: 診間有一位臉色蒼白的病人。他說腳踝昨晚開始痛，今天每走一步都很痛。
en: There was a pale patient in the doctor's office. He said his ankle started to hurt last night, and today every step was painful.

zh: 妹妹帶了印著貓熊圖案的睡衣，還堅持自己抱著枕頭。到了外婆家，她很快就睡著了。
en: My sister brought pajamas with a panda on them and insisted on carrying her pillow by herself. When we got to Grandma's house, she fell asleep quickly.

zh: 老師請每位學生選一幅自己的水彩畫，貼在紫色的紙上。老師把畫排成一列，教室就像一座小畫廊。
en: The teacher asked each student to choose one of their own watercolor paintings and stick it on purple paper. When she put the paintings in a row, the classroom looked like a small gallery.

zh: 爸爸買了一磅豬肉，切成小塊放進平底鍋炒。我把炒熟的肉撒在披薩上，再把披薩送進烤箱。
en: Dad bought a pound of pork, cut it into small pieces, and fried it in a pan. I sprinkled the cooked meat on the pizza and then put the pizza in the oven.

zh: 弟弟花了好久才選定要買桃子還是梨子。我比較喜歡木瓜，早就挑好一顆，在水果攤旁邊等他。
en: My brother took a long time to decide whether to buy peaches or pears. I prefer papaya, so I had already picked one and was waiting for him beside the fruit stand.

zh: 公主到監獄探望一名囚犯。他偷了麵包給妹妹吃。公主聽完他的故事，便請國王寬恕他，免去他的處罰。
en: The princess visited a prisoner in prison. He had stolen bread for his little sister. After hearing his story, the princess asked the king to forgive him and free him from punishment.

zh: 報名這場比賽時，你心裡有特定的搭檔嗎？大家都得兩人一組參加，兩人都抵達終點才能領獎。
en: When you signed up for this race, did you have a particular partner in mind? Everyone has to enter in pairs, and you only get the prize when both partners reach the finish line.

zh: 我用淺白的話向爺爺解釋，密碼是個人資料。如果他想跟行員談帳戶的事，可以請行員帶他去一間能單獨談話的房間。
en: I explained to Grandpa in plain words that a password is private information. If he wants to talk to the bank clerk about his account, he can ask the clerk to take him to a private room.

zh: 我們沿著小徑走到山頂。那裡很寧靜，只聽得見風聲。我們在山上度過了一個愉快的早晨。
en: We walked along the path to the top of the mountain. It was so peaceful there that we could only hear the wind. We spent a pleasant morning on the mountain.

zh: 大家在教堂裡為和平祈禱。神父請孩子們把自己的禱詞寫下來，放在點著蠟燭的桌上。
en: Everyone prayed for peace in the church. The priest asked the children to write down their prayers and put them on the table with the candles.

zh: 南瓜布丁每杯二十元，加一匙鮮奶油要再付五元。妹妹把零錢數了兩次，剛好夠買一杯加鮮奶油的布丁。
en: Pumpkin pudding costs twenty dollars a cup, and a spoonful of cream costs five dollars more. My sister counted her coins twice, and she had just enough for a pudding with cream.

zh: 妹妹換了三次位置才找到完美的背景，接著對著鏡頭擺好姿勢。我把照片印成明信片，隔天寄給奶奶。
en: My sister changed places three times before she found the perfect background, and then she posed for the camera. I printed the photo as a postcard and mailed it to Grandma the next day.

zh: 國文老師請一位詩人來談詩歌。那一堂課，我們每人選了一個喜歡的詞組，用它當開頭寫了一首短詩。
en: Our Chinese teacher invited a poet to talk about poetry. In that class, each of us chose a favorite phrase and used it to begin a short poem.

zh: 隊長個性開朗，就算輸球也會給隊友正面的回應。他稱讚大家練習認真，也以全隊的進步為榮。
en: Our captain is cheerful and gives his teammates positive feedback even when we lose. He praised everyone for practicing hard and is proud of the whole team's progress.

zh: 從火車站的月台上就能看見港口。鎮上的人口比以前多了，每天都有好多人在這裡等火車。
en: You can see the port from the platform of the train station. The town's population is bigger than before, and many people wait for trains here every day.

zh: 孩子們在遊樂場發現一瓶標著「毒物」的液體。為了保護大家，一名警察請孩子們先離開，再找人來把瓶子帶走。
en: The children found a bottle of liquid marked "Poison" at the playground. To protect everyone, a police officer asked the children to leave first and then called someone to take the bottle away.

zh: 總統向孩子們說明新的森林政策。他說這項計畫的主要目標是在山坡上重新種植原生樹木。
en: The president explained the new forest policy to the children. He said the main goal of the plan was to plant native trees on the hillsides again.

zh: 我們的流行音樂表演就要開始了，我感受到上台的壓力。我按下電子琴的第一個琴鍵，鼓手也跟著打了起來，他那強而有力的節奏讓我安下心來。
en: Our pop music show was about to start, and I felt the pressure of going on stage. I pressed the first key on the keyboard, and the drummer started playing, too. His strong, powerful beat calmed me down.

zh: 解最後一道謎題時，阿哲提議先看看畫框後面。藏在那裡的鑰匙證明他猜對了。現在我們有機會提早過關了。
en: When we were solving the last puzzle, A-Zhe proposed looking behind the picture frame first. The key hidden there proved he was right. Now we have a chance to finish early.

zh: 校長問我們辦這場活動的目的。我答應活動結束會把椅子排回原位，因為把借用的場地恢復原狀是我們社團的原則。
en: The principal asked us about the purpose of this event. I promised to put the chairs back after the event, because putting a borrowed place back the way it was is a principle of our club.

zh: 這家工廠生產玩具，生產的最後一步是裝盒。工作人員用一台小印表機印出標籤，再貼到盒子上。
en: This factory produces toys, and the last step of production is putting them in boxes. The workers print labels with a small printer and then stick them on the boxes.

zh: 老師提供適當的工具和防護眼鏡，讓我們練習把木板鋸直。第二次鋸出來的邊比第一次直多了，我看得出自己有進步。
en: The teacher provided proper tools and safety glasses so we could practice sawing wooden boards straight. The edge I cut the second time was much straighter than the first, so I could see my progress.

zh: 小狗一直縮在雨棚下。我提議先用毛巾把牠擦乾。哥哥用外套裹住牠，保護牠不受冷風吹。
en: The puppy kept hiding under the awning. I suggested drying it with a towel first. My brother wrapped it in his coat to protect it from the cold wind.

zh: 今天的小考有一道買橘子的題目。兩箱價錢相同，一箱的橘子數量較多，另一箱的橘子品質較好。你會替班上選哪一箱？
en: Today's quiz had a question about buying oranges. The two boxes cost the same. One box has a larger quantity of oranges, and the other has oranges of better quality. Which box would you choose for the class?

zh: 大雨過後，這個地區的鐵路停駛了。工人穿著雨衣趕到現場。多虧他們反應迅速，第一班車中午就開了。
en: After the heavy rain, the railroad in this region stopped running. Workers in raincoats rushed to the scene. Thanks to their rapid response, the first train ran at noon.

zh: 我們在多岩石的山坡上看見一隻罕見的鳥。老師請我們記錄發現牠的位置。累積這樣的紀錄，就能幫助我們畫出這種鳥的活動範圍。
en: We saw a rare bird on a rocky hillside. The teacher asked us to record where we found it. Collecting records like this can help us map the range where this bird lives.

zh: 修理冰箱前，師傅先搬開旁邊的紙箱。一隻大老鼠立刻從牆角竄出來，躲進後院。
en: Before fixing the refrigerator, the repairman moved the boxes beside it. A big rat ran out of the corner at once and hid in the backyard.

zh: 小國王夢見自己擁有全世界的財富。一醒來，他才明白那只是夢。現實生活中，他寧可待在家裡和妹妹一起玩。
en: The little king dreamed that he owned all the riches in the world. When he woke up, he realized it was only a dream. In real life, he would rather stay home and play with his sister.

zh: 我收到一位賽跑選手的來信。他提到最近的一場比賽，也說自己的腳傷已經好了，現在可以跟我一起練跑了。
en: I got a letter from a runner. He mentioned a recent race and said his foot injury had healed, so now he can practice running with me.

zh: 我的新同學因為宗教信仰而拒絕吃豬肉。我尊重他的選擇，每次幫他點餐都會先問他。我們的關係也越來越好。
en: My new classmate refuses to eat pork because of his religion. I respect his choice, and I always ask him first when I order food for him. Our relationship is getting better and better.

zh: 我是這間租車店的老客人，老闆已經把我當成朋友。我寫信問他週日能不能租一輛雙人腳踏車，他很快就回覆了。
en: I am a regular customer at this rental shop, and the owner already treats me as a friend. I wrote to ask him if I could rent a bike for two on Sunday, and he replied quickly.

zh: 要加入球隊，有一項基本要求，就是每週都得來練球。隊長拒絕了我的申請，但他很有耐心地回答我的問題，一點也不無禮。
en: There is one basic requirement for joining the team: you have to come to practice every week. The captain refused my application, but he answered my questions patiently and was not rude at all.

zh: 我們複習了上週的調查結果。第一張圖表和睡眠有關，第二張則顯示睡眠時數與上課專心程度之間的關係。
en: We reviewed the results of last week's survey. The first chart was about sleep, and the second showed the relationship between hours of sleep and how well we focus in class.

zh: 弟弟在公園的廁所外撿到一串鑰匙。他拿著鑰匙到服務台請人廣播。等失主趕來，他親手把鑰匙還給她。大家都說他很負責任。
en: My brother picked up a set of keys outside the restroom in the park. He took the keys to the service desk and asked them to make an announcement. When the owner came, he returned the keys to her himself. Everyone said he was very responsible.

zh: 在學校的戲裡，我的角色是一隻住在王宮的公雞。每次我爬上紙做的屋頂啼叫，皇家樂隊就開始演奏。
en: In the school play, my role was a rooster living in the royal palace. Every time I climbed onto the paper roof and crowed, the royal band began to play.

zh: 那位賽跑選手的鞋底是橡膠做的。比賽過後，他用濕布來回擦鞋底，直到把泥巴全擦掉。
en: The runner's shoes have rubber soles. After the race, he rubbed the soles back and forth with a wet cloth until all the mud was gone.

zh: 水手站在岸邊，用腳在沙上畫出今天要走的航線。他說為了大家的安全，要等風小一點才能出航。
en: The sailor stood on the shore and drew today's route in the sand with his foot. He said that for everyone's safety, we had to wait until the wind was weaker before we set sail.

zh: 店員請我試吃一小塊火腿三明治，但火腿太鹹了。我請他換成小黃瓜，這才滿足了我想吃點清淡食物的心願。
en: The clerk asked me to try a small piece of a ham sandwich, but the ham was too salty. I asked him to change it to cucumber, and that satisfied my wish for something light.

zh: 學校拍短片時，有一幕要用到鋸子。弟弟看到演員舉起鋸子就很害怕。導演怕道具再嚇到他，便讓他摸摸那把軟鋸子。
en: When our school made a short film, one scene needed a saw. My little brother was scared when he saw the actor raise the saw. The director was afraid the prop would scare him again, so he let him touch the soft saw.

zh: 我沿著人行道走到爸爸的小店，抄下門口的公車時刻表。隔壁的店主說末班車已經開走了，爸爸就騎機車載我回家。
en: I walked along the sidewalk to Dad's small shop and copied down the bus schedule at the door. The owner of the shop next door said the last bus had already left, so Dad took me home on his scooter.

zh: 體育館的大螢幕上顯示的比數是三十比三十。教練說輸贏是次要的，但最後一次投籃進了的時候，大家還是跳了起來。
en: The score on the big screen in the gym was thirty to thirty. The coach said winning or losing was secondary, but when the last shot went in, everyone still jumped up.

zh: 海鮮餐廳隔壁有間小店，窗邊擺著一顆粉紅色的貝殼。我進去看了看，最後挑了一隻用銀做的小鯊魚。
en: There is a small shop next to the seafood restaurant, and a pink shell sits by the window. I went in to look around and finally chose a little shark made of silver.

zh: 為了解開老相館的秘密，我仔細搜尋地方志裡介紹車站的那一節。書裡沒寫老闆的名字，我只好去圖書館向館員尋求協助。
en: To solve the secret of the old photo studio, I carefully searched the section about the train station in the local history book. The book did not have the owner's name, so I went to the library to ask a librarian for help.

zh: 新同學很害羞，很少跟別人說話。我邀她一起玩蹺蹺板，她笑著點了點頭，看起來很開心。
en: The new classmate is shy and seldom talks to others. I invited her to play on the seesaw with me. She smiled and nodded, and she looked happy.

zh: 合唱團只剩一個名額。選拔從明天開始，老師會聽錄音來挑選新團員。每段錄音只標編號，報名表上也不用填性別。
en: There is only one place left in the choir. The selection starts tomorrow, and the teacher will listen to recordings to choose the new member. Each recording only has a number, and you do not need to write your sex on the form.

zh: 我在戲裡演一個自私的國王。他拿走弟弟的王冠，還找了個很傻的藉口。最後，國王滿心羞愧地把王冠還給弟弟。弟弟笑著說：「你又變回原來的自己了。」
en: In the play I acted as a selfish king. He took his brother's crown and gave a silly excuse. In the end, the king gave the crown back to his brother in shame. His brother smiled and said, "You are your old self again."

zh: 老師把三種香料裝在不同的碗裡，請我們蒙上眼睛。妹妹對氣味很敏感，只靠嗅覺就認出了肉桂。
en: The teacher put three spices in different bowls and asked us to cover our eyes. My sister is sensitive to smells, and she recognized the cinnamon by smell alone.

zh: 城堡裡的僕人多年來都在宴會上為客人上菜。這次兩位客人爭著坐窗邊，其中一名僕人搬來另一張桌子，就解決了爭執。
en: The servants in the castle have served food to guests at banquets for many years. This time, two guests argued about who would sit by the window. One of the servants brought another table and settled the argument.

zh: 陽光從窗外照在架子上，我才看見那盒少了一片的拼圖。旁邊有張紙，紙上畫的圖形和缺口的形狀很相似。
en: Sunlight shone through the window onto the shelf, and then I saw the puzzle box with a missing piece. Next to it was a sheet of paper with a shape on it that looked similar to the shape of the gap.

zh: 我們正在一間寂靜的房間裡拍短片，門突然關上了。大家都嚇了一跳，沒有人打破沉默。原來只是攝影師伸手把門帶上了。
en: We were making a short film in a silent room when the door suddenly shut. Everyone was startled, and nobody broke the silence. It was only the cameraman reaching out to close the door.

zh: 叔叔是位熟練的廚師。他用鋼刀把牛排切成薄片。我想學這項技能，他就先教我怎麼握刀。
en: My uncle is a skillful cook. He cuts the steak into thin slices with a steel knife. I wanted to learn this skill, so he first taught me how to hold the knife.

zh: 妹妹用肥皂洗手，再用柔軟的毛巾輕輕擦乾。她說手背的皮膚很乾，請我幫她打開乳液瓶。
en: My sister washed her hands with soap and dried them gently with a soft towel. She said the skin on the back of her hands was dry and asked me to help her open the bottle of lotion.

zh: 妹妹等車等得想睡了。我一打開點心盒，她就坐直了。她用湯匙吃了一口草莓優格，把最大顆的草莓留給我。
en: My sister got sleepy waiting for the bus. As soon as I opened the snack box, she sat up straight. She ate a spoonful of strawberry yogurt and saved the biggest strawberry for me.

zh: 弟弟穿著拖鞋跑向鞦韆，滑了一跤，一屁股坐在地上。他想改玩溜滑梯，但我摸了摸，光滑的表面還是濕的。
en: My brother ran to the swing in his slippers, slipped, and fell on his bottom. He wanted to play on the slide instead, but when I touched it, the smooth surface was still wet.

zh: 我在潮濕的泥土上發現一隻蝸牛。妹妹在葉子底下看到一隻蜘蛛，牠背上有兩個白色斑點。
en: I found a snail on the damp soil. My sister saw a spider under a leaf, and there were two white spots on its back.

zh: 舅舅住的地方冬天多雪，我出發前特地帶了厚毛衣。媽媽看了我的行李，又放進三雙短襪。
en: It snows a lot in winter where my uncle lives, so I packed a thick sweater before I left. Mom looked at my bag and put in three pairs of socks.

zh: 足球是全班最愛的運動。比賽前，我們先伸展雙腿，再慢跑，逐漸加快速度。最後一位同學跑完時，大家都為他拍手，教練稱讚我們有團隊精神。
en: Soccer is the whole class's favorite sport. Before the game, we stretched our legs first and then jogged, slowly increasing our speed. When the last classmate finished running, everyone clapped for him, and the coach praised our team spirit.

zh: 演講者走上舞臺，跟我們談獨居長者面對的社會問題。聽完演講，我才知道我們的社會裡有這麼多人需要有人陪他們吃頓飯。
en: The speaker walked onto the stage and talked to us about the social problems that old people living alone face. After the speech, I learned that so many people in our society need someone to share a meal with them.

zh: 晚餐時，我喝了一口檸檬汽水，覺得有點酸。弟弟也想喝，可是他胃痛，就把杯子放回去了。
en: At dinner, I took a sip of lemon soda, and it was a little sour. My brother wanted some too, but he had a stomachache, so he put the cup back.

zh: 我們每天早上掃地，下午走廊上卻又滿是落葉。為了解決這個問題，小安建議在門口裝一道紗門。我們試了一週，覺得這個解決方法有效。
en: We sweep the floor every morning, but the hallway is full of fallen leaves again in the afternoon. To solve this problem, Xiao-An suggested putting a screen door at the entrance. We tried it for a week and found this solution worked.

zh: 爺爺把郵票按國家分類，每一組都放進不同的透明袋。我幫他把寫著國名的標籤貼在袋子上。
en: Grandpa sorts his stamps by country and puts each group in a different clear bag. I helped him stick the labels with the country names on the bags.

zh: 外婆唱歌有自己的風格，我只聽一句就認得出她的聲音。我沒想到這樣一首簡單的歌也能打動我的靈魂。
en: Grandma has her own style of singing, and I can recognize her voice after just one line. I never expected such a simple song to touch my soul.

zh: 暑假，我們到南部的一個村子，沿著小溪往上走。溪水的源頭就在兩塊大石頭中間。
en: During the summer vacation, we went to a village in the south and walked up along a stream. The source of the stream was right between two big rocks.

zh: 爸爸把黃豆攤開在桌上，要我幫忙挑出壞掉的。後來我們煮了豆漿。豆漿稍微放涼時，表面就出現一層薄膜。
en: Dad spread the soybeans on the table and asked me to help pick out the bad ones. Later we made soy milk. When it cooled a little, a thin layer appeared on the surface.

zh: 拼字比賽開始前，老師先說明評分標準。她對拼法要求很嚴格，就算只少一個字母，這一題也拿不到分數。
en: Before the spelling contest began, the teacher explained the standards for scoring. She is strict about spelling, so even if one letter is missing, you get no points for that word.

zh: 我抱著一箱補給品走出地鐵站。走到最後幾級臺階時，箱底破了。一位陌生人停下來，幫我把箱子抬到路邊。
en: I walked out of the subway station carrying a box of supplies. On the last few steps, the bottom of the box broke. A stranger stopped and helped me carry the box to the side of the road.

zh: 一場突如其來的暴風雨吹倒了島上的大樹。我們回去時，發現幾隻幼鳥活了下來。牠們能生存，全靠一塊替牠們擋風的大石頭。
en: A sudden storm blew down the big tree on the island. When we went back, we found that a few baby birds had survived. They survived only because a big rock had blocked the wind for them.

zh: 我練琴時一直在跟壓力搏鬥，一碰到難的地方就停下來。有了姊姊的支持，我反覆練習，終於成功把整首曲子彈完。我把這次成功記在日記裡。
en: I kept struggling with pressure while practicing the piano, and I stopped whenever I reached a hard part. With my sister's support, I practiced again and again and finally succeeded in playing the whole piece. I wrote about this success in my diary.

zh: 禮堂的鐘敲了九下，哥哥才換好西裝。他問我這套衣服適不適合穿去頒獎典禮。我說很合適，而且他看起來超級帥。
en: The clock in the hall struck nine before my brother finished putting on his suit. He asked me if the suit was suitable for the award ceremony. I said it was perfect, and he looked super handsome.

zh: 表哥看見我穿著泳衣，說：「我猜你是來游泳的吧？」我說：「我是來學衝浪的。你看，教練已經拿著板子在等我了。」
en: When my cousin saw me in my swimsuit, he said, "I suppose you came to swim?" I said, "I came to learn to surf. Look, the coach is already waiting for me with a board."

zh: 展場的廣播系統突然沒了聲音，我緊張得吞了口口水。幸好我認得開關旁邊的電源符號。我按下開關，喇叭又有聲音了。
en: The speaker system at the exhibition suddenly went silent, and I swallowed nervously. Luckily, I recognized the power symbol beside the switch. I pressed the switch, and the speakers came back on.

zh: 外婆邊泡茶邊講一個老故事，說一個女孩用一只茶壺換回了家裡的財寶。講到女孩終於回家時，外婆眼裡閃著淚水。
en: While making tea, Grandma told an old story about a girl who traded a teapot for her family's treasure. When she got to the part where the girl finally went home, there were tears in Grandma's eyes.

zh: 在青少年科技營裡，我們的任務是做一盞不用插電的燈。我們這組的目標是讓燈亮一整晚。
en: At the teen technology camp, our task was to make a lamp that does not need to be plugged in. Our group's goal was to keep the lamp on all night.

zh: 老街上的茶商跟外地商人做買賣，每年都得繳稅。他用傳統的方法烘茶。把手藝傳給下一代，是他們家的傳統。
en: The tea dealer on the old street trades with merchants from other places and has to pay tax every year. He roasts his tea in the traditional way. Passing the skill on to the next generation is his family's tradition.

zh: 午後氣溫升高，大家跑得很口渴。遠處傳來雷聲時，教練說颱風正接近，要我們留在室內，直到爸媽來接。
en: The temperature rose in the afternoon, and everyone got thirsty from running. When we heard thunder in the distance, the coach said a typhoon was coming and told us to stay inside until our parents picked us up.

zh: 這學期第一堂課，老師把教科書裡一篇文章的標題遮起來。我們得先讀正文，再替文章取一個名字。
en: In the first class of the term, the teacher covered the title of an article in the textbook. We had to read the text first and then give the article a name.

zh: 新聞說全國各地都將舉行反對恐怖主義的活動。一位曾在恐怖攻擊中受傷的記者會來我們學校演講，因此老師請我們先準備幾個問題。
en: The news said that events against terrorism will be held all over the country. A reporter who was hurt in a terrorist attack will give a speech at our school, so the teacher asked us to prepare some questions first.

zh: 小偷帶著失竊的畫去見買家，掉進了警方設下的圈套。在審判中，一位證人認出了畫背面的簽名，說出了這幅畫失竊的真相。
en: The thief took the stolen painting to meet a buyer and fell into a trap set by the police. At the trial, a witness recognized the signature on the back of the painting and told the truth about how it was stolen.

zh: 弟弟說他摔壞了我的模型，語氣很認真。我告訴他：「我相信你說的是真的，也很高興你信任我，願意告訴我心裡的想法。」
en: My brother told me he had broken my model, and he said it seriously. I told him, "I believe you are telling the truth, and I am glad you trust me enough to tell me what you think."

zh: 叔叔把腳踏車輪胎裡的內胎放進水盆，水面立刻冒出細小的氣泡。他就這樣找到了漏氣的地方。
en: My uncle put the inner tube from the bike tire into a basin of water, and tiny bubbles came up at once. That was how he found the place where the air was leaking.

zh: 阿姨把煎豆腐夾在兩片烤吐司中間，請我嚐一口。豆腐燙到我的舌頭，我趕緊放下吐司，拿面紙擦掉下巴上的醬汁。
en: My aunt put fried tofu between two slices of toast and asked me to try a bite. The tofu burned my tongue, so I quickly put down the toast and wiped the sauce off my chin with a tissue.

zh: 出門旅行前，我因為牙痛去看牙醫。回家打包時，我把牙刷放進隨身包，這樣一到旅館就找得到。
en: Before my trip, I went to the dentist because of a toothache. When I packed at home, I put my toothbrush in my small bag so I could find it as soon as I got to the hotel.

zh: 在這趟徒步導覽中，我們沿著廢棄的鐵軌朝車站走。導遊指著站長的老宿舍說，這就是當地典型的木造房屋。
en: On this walking tour, we walked toward the station along the old railroad tracks. The guide pointed at the stationmaster's old house and said it was a typical local wooden house.

zh: 魔術師拿起一張我正要丟進垃圾桶的舊報紙，把它摺成三角形。他變了個戲法，紙下竟然出現了一隻小烏龜。
en: The magician picked up an old newspaper that I was about to throw in the trash can and folded it into a triangle. He did a trick, and a little turtle appeared under the paper.

zh: 我的雨傘被風吹壞了，我正為這件事心煩，阿姨就借我一把二手傘。它雖然有點醜，卻連一滴雨都沒漏進來。
en: I was upset because the wind broke my umbrella, and then my aunt lent me a used one. It was a little ugly, but not a single drop of rain came through.

zh: 大學老師來教天文單元，帶來一張太空人的老照片。一看見照片裡的太空人站在月球上，我就開始好奇宇宙有多大。
en: A university teacher came to teach the astronomy unit and brought an old photo of an astronaut. As soon as I saw the astronaut standing on the moon, I began to wonder how big the universe is.

zh: 依照我們平時的規定，每個使用者都可以上傳自己拍的照片。除非照片裡的人同意公開，否則請把照片設成只有自己能看。
en: Under our usual rules, every user can upload photos they took themselves. Unless the people in the photo agree to share it, please set the photo so only you can see it.

zh: 我跑上樓，想從書架上層拿一本書。那裡放的都是二手書，每本的第一頁都留著前一位主人的名字。
en: I ran upstairs to get a book from the upper shelf. All the books there are used, and each one still has the name of its last owner on the first page.

zh: 放假時，我們住在山谷裡的一座小村落。房間看出去的景色真美，窗外就是一片金黃色的稻田。
en: During the vacation, we stayed in a small village in a valley. The view from our room was beautiful. Outside the window was a golden rice field.

zh: 鎮民投票決定要不要保留老戲院，支持保留的一方以三票之差獲得勝利。對他們來說，這棟建築很珍貴。它的價值就在那些一起看電影的回憶裡。
en: The people of the town voted on whether to keep the old theater, and the side that wanted to keep it won by three votes. To them, the building is valuable. Its value lies in the memories of watching movies together.

zh: 男服務生在桌下撿到一個皮夾。兩位女服務生跑了過來，其中一位腰上繫著綠色圍裙。他低聲問她們：「這是你們的嗎？」
en: A waiter found a wallet under the table. Two waitresses ran over, and one of them wore a green apron around her waist. He asked them quietly, "Is this yours?"

zh: 戰爭結束時，曾祖父全部的財富就是一小塊地和一批木材。他用這些木材蓋了一間西式小屋，還用剩下的料做了一張木桌。
en: When the war ended, all my great-grandfather's wealth was a small piece of land and some wood. He used the wood to build a small Western-style house and made a wooden table with what was left.

zh: 水果攤的阿姨先秤西瓜，再把重量寫在紙袋上。她把兩顆熟透的西瓜洗乾淨、切開來，分給幫忙的人吃，一點也沒浪費。
en: The lady at the fruit stand weighed the watermelons first and wrote the weight on a paper bag. She washed two very ripe watermelons, cut them open, and shared them with the helpers. Nothing went to waste.

zh: 表姊的婚禮辦在平日，叔叔願意請假幫忙接送客人。晚餐時，大家舉起葡萄酒向新人道賀，叔叔因為還要開車，就舉起了茶杯。
en: My cousin's wedding was on a weekday, and my uncle was willing to take a day off to drive the guests. At dinner, everyone raised their glasses of wine to congratulate the couple. My uncle had to drive, so he raised his cup of tea.

zh: 每當我們看見野生鯨魚浮出水面，全船的人都會安靜下來。船長說，無論牠游到哪裡，我們都得保持距離。
en: Whenever we see a wild whale come up out of the water, everyone on the boat becomes quiet. The captain said that wherever it swims, we must keep our distance.

zh: 無論誰來參加這場料理比賽，都得在三十分鐘內做完一道菜。廚房裡的食材可以任選，但每組只能用一顆完整的南瓜。
en: Whoever joins this cooking contest must finish a dish within thirty minutes. You can choose any ingredients in the kitchen, but each group can only use one whole pumpkin.

zh: 爸爸用金屬線把鬆掉的輪子固定好，推車卻還是進不了門。我量了門口的寬度，才發現得先把推車轉個方向，側著進去。
en: Dad fixed the loose wheel with wire, but the cart still could not get through the door. I measured the width of the doorway and found that we had to turn the cart and take it in sideways.

zh: 那天下午風很大，我看見一隻小鳥躲在圍牆邊。我正納悶牠為什麼不飛。走近一看，才發現牠的翅膀上有一道傷口。
en: The wind was strong that afternoon, and I saw a little bird hiding by the wall. I wondered why it did not fly. When I got closer, I saw a wound on its wing.

zh: 弟弟在美術作業簿上畫了一隻狼，再把灰色羊毛黏在牠背上。我指著狼腳邊那條細細的線問：「那是牠的尾巴，還是一條蚯蚓？」
en: My brother drew a wolf in his art workbook and stuck gray wool on its back. I pointed at the thin line by the wolf's foot and asked, "Is that its tail or a worm?"

words.zh: 輔助練習冊、工作規程書

zh: 今天的天氣比昨天更糟，山頂的霧也是這一週最濃的。弟弟說最糟的是爬了山卻看不到日出。直到雲縫間露出一道金光，他才說這一趟值得。
en: The weather today was worse than yesterday, and the fog on the mountain top was the worst of the week. My brother said the worst part was climbing the mountain without seeing the sunrise. It was not until a golden light came through the clouds that he said the trip was worth it.

zh: 爺爺說，他年輕時常和兄弟一起上山挖山藥。今天他煮了一鍋山藥湯，說這就是他年少時最愛的點心。
en: Grandpa says that when he was young, he often went up the mountain with his brothers to dig yams. Today he cooked a pot of yam soup and said it was his favorite snack in his youth.

zh: 弟弟第一次在草原上看見斑馬，舉起相機想拍牠身上的條紋。那隻斑馬正好轉過頭來，也看了他一眼。
en: My brother saw a zebra on the grassland for the first time and raised his camera to take a picture of its stripes. Just then the zebra turned its head and looked at him, too.

zh: 航空公司剛宣布我們換了登機口。等大家都上了飛機，我才發現剛才讓到一旁讓我通過的乘客就坐在我隔壁。
en: The airline just announced that our gate had changed. After everyone was aboard, I found that the passenger who had stepped aside to let me pass was sitting right next to me.

zh: 這支比較先進的溫度計有什麼優點？如果兩支都夠準確，而且價差在我可以接受的範圍內，我願意為較大的螢幕支付額外的費用。
en: What is the advantage of this more advanced thermometer? If both are accurate and the difference in price is acceptable to me, I am willing to pay an additional amount for the bigger screen.

zh: 昨晚我膝蓋痠痛，一直到半夜十二點才睡著。一位曾在比賽中受傷的運動員勸我先告訴教練。
en: Last night my knee ached, and I did not fall asleep until midnight. An athlete who once got hurt in a game advised me to tell my coach first.

zh: 姊姊的志向是拍一部連小朋友都看得懂的紀錄片。她已經實現了這個目標，還得了一個獎。我最佩服她的是，她花了一年聽孩子們說故事。
en: My sister's ambition was to make a documentary that even children can understand. She has achieved this goal and won an award. What I admire most is that she spent a year listening to children's stories.

zh: 我把第一次在老街尋寶當成一場冒險。地圖上的兩口井只相隔二十公尺。我們先找到廟旁邊那口，之後才在小巷的盡頭看見另一口。
en: I treated my first treasure hunt on the old street as an adventure. The two wells on the map were only twenty meters apart. We found the one beside the temple first, and afterward we saw the other one at the end of the alley.

zh: 河邊有張單車店的廣告。上面那張漂亮的照片已經吸引了不少遊客，但最吸引我的是連學生都付得起的租車價格。
en: There was an advertisement for a bike shop by the river. The beautiful photo on it had already attracted many visitors, but what attracted me most was a rental price that even students could afford.

zh: 來參觀學校菜園的大使以前學過農業。他的顧問協助我們把問題翻成英文，好讓我們問他家鄉的農民怎麼種菜。
en: The ambassador who visited our school garden had studied agriculture. His adviser assisted us in turning our questions into English so we could ask how farmers in his country grow vegetables.

zh: 烘焙老師請助手把圍裙拿給前排的孩子。老師把烤過的杏仁倒進碗裡時，觀眾席裡有個孩子舉手問能不能改用花生。
en: The baking teacher asked her assistant to give aprons to the children in the front row. When the teacher poured the roasted almonds into a bowl, a child in the audience raised a hand and asked if he could use peanuts instead.

zh: 弟弟還在學英文字母，卻已經會拼出「天使」這個字了。他在卡片上寫下這個字，又把第一個字母畫成一雙翅膀。這個點子讓我很驚奇。
en: My little brother is still learning the alphabet, but he can already spell the word "angel." He wrote the word on a card and drew the first letter as a pair of wings. This idea amazed me.

zh: 目睹那場可怕的車禍後，我打電話叫了救護車。爸爸在車上等消息時一直很焦慮，直到我告訴他我很安全。
en: After seeing that awful car accident, I called an ambulance. Dad was anxious while he waited in the car for news, until I told him I was safe.

zh: 主持人把新同學的名字叫錯了，台上一陣尷尬的沉默。他的朋友說沒人注意到，但他還是親自去道歉。新同學很欣賞他願意認錯的態度。
en: The host called the new student by the wrong name, and there was an awkward silence on the stage. His friend said no one noticed, but he still went to apologize in person. The new student admired his attitude of admitting his mistake.

zh: 在我們的短片裡，一名武裝劫匪在銀行外被逮捕。我們原以為校長會同意我們在校門口拍這一幕，今天才知道還要先交劇本。
en: In our short film, an armed robber is arrested outside a bank. We assumed the principal would approve of filming this scene at the school gate, but today we learned we had to hand in the script first.

zh: 是自動火警警報器把我從睡夢中喚醒的。我推開廚房門才察覺裡面有煙，烤盤上的吐司已經燒成了灰。
en: The automatic fire alarm awakened me from my sleep. When I pushed open the kitchen door, I became aware of the smoke inside. The toast on the baking pan had turned to ash.

zh: 外公找出一張老照片，指給我看當年駛過這條大道的第一輛汽車。後來，人們在大道兩旁蓋了房子，照片裡的稻田也消失了。
en: Grandpa found an old photo and showed me the first automobile that drove down this avenue. Later, people built houses on both sides of the avenue, and the rice fields in the photo disappeared.

zh: 一位有教學背景的銀行家提出一個大膽的點子，要把歇業的戲院變成免費教室。他已編好第一年的預算，現在正在找願意來教課的人。
en: A banker with a teaching background came up with a bold idea to turn a closed theater into a free classroom. He has already planned the budget for the first year and is now looking for people willing to teach.

zh: 我們到的時候，早午餐自助餐快結束了。弟弟想拿培根，但廚師請他等新的一盤。廚師解釋，食物在室溫下放太久，細菌就會繁殖。
en: When we arrived, the brunch buffet was almost over. My brother wanted some bacon, but the cook asked him to wait for a new plate. The cook explained that bacteria grow when food is left at room temperature for too long.

zh: 哥哥說看別人打保齡球讓他覺得無聊，還跟我打賭他第一球就能打倒所有球瓶。結果他第一球打得很差，連一個瓶子都沒碰到。
en: My brother said watching others go bowling bored him, and he bet me he could knock down all the pins with his first ball. In the end, he played his first ball so badly that he did not hit a single pin.

zh: 放下行李後，我們幫民宿主人把書架搬進地下室。樓梯太窄，我們得把書架轉個角度才剛好能通過轉角。
en: After putting down our baggage, we helped the owner of the guesthouse move a bookcase into the basement. The stairs were so narrow that we had to turn the bookcase at an angle to barely get it around the corner.

zh: 一陣微風吹過海灣，外公把他用竹子做的釣竿交給我。他說如果魚吃掉了餌卻沒有上鉤，我就得在鉤上放新的餌。
en: A breeze blew across the bay, and Grandpa handed me the fishing rod he made from bamboo. He said if a fish ate the bait but did not get caught, I had to put new bait on the hook.

zh: 我們在穀倉外聽見有人用力敲門。叔叔從裡面喊，說一根橫樑倒下來抵住了門，所以他沒辦法把那桶水搬出來。
en: Outside the barn, we heard someone banging on the door. My uncle shouted from inside that a beam had fallen against the door, so he could not carry the barrel of water out.

zh: 有隻亮綠色的甲蟲躲在我的雨靴底下。弟弟光著腳走過來，蹲在一旁看牠慢慢爬回草地。
en: A bright green beetle was hiding under my rain boot. My brother came over in bare feet and squatted beside it to watch it crawl slowly back to the grass.

zh: 妹妹指著田裡的水牛，問農夫這麼大的野獸會不會攻擊人。農夫解釋，這頭水牛是他養的，但還是請我們站在圍欄外，因為隔壁那頭公牛不喜歡陌生人靠近。
en: My sister pointed at the buffalo in the field and asked the farmer if such a big beast would attack people. The farmer explained that he raised this buffalo, but he still asked us to stand outside the fence because the bull next door did not like strangers coming close.

zh: 除了莓果，農夫還請我們吃一種帶點苦味的葉子。他說種不同的植物對果園有好處，因為這樣會吸引更多昆蟲。
en: Besides berries, the farmer let us try a leaf with a slightly bitter taste. He said planting different plants benefits the orchard because it attracts more insects.

zh: 新娘把一顆藍色的小珠子穿在細繩上，再用繩子把一束花綁好。她把花送給妹妹，奶奶站在兩人身邊，輕聲祝福她們。
en: The bride put a small blue bead on a thin string and used the string to tie up a bunch of flowers. She gave the flowers to my sister, and Grandma stood beside them and quietly blessed them.

zh: 我搬椅子時手肘撞到門把，傷口開始流血。姊姊拿了一條乾淨的毛巾給我，我才發現身上那件女襯衫的袖子已經沾滿了血。
en: I bumped my elbow on the door handle while I was moving a chair, and the cut started to bleed. My sister brought me a clean towel, and then I noticed that the sleeve of my blouse was covered in blood.

zh: 那面紅磚牆上的洞是一顆子彈留下的。居民在整修老屋時還找到一枚未爆炸彈和一支黃銅軍號。軍號現在就陳列在牆邊。
en: The hole in that red brick wall was made by a bullet. While fixing the old house, the people living there also found an unexploded bomb and a brass bugle. The bugle is now displayed beside the wall.

zh: 阿姨上週在廣播節目裡談她接受乳房手術的經歷。訪問後，有位聽眾寫信謝謝她，說他很佩服她願意公開談這段經歷的勇氣。
en: Last week my aunt talked on a radio broadcast about her breast surgery. After the interview, a listener wrote to thank her and said he admired her bravery in talking about this experience in public.

zh: 教練請我站在淺水區，先深吸一口氣。我把臉埋進水裡，用鼻子慢慢吐氣，吐出一串氣泡，這才明白游泳時要怎麼呼吸。
en: The coach asked me to stand in the shallow water and take a deep breath first. I put my face in the water and breathed out slowly through my nose, making a stream of bubbles. Then I understood how to breathe while swimming.

zh: 清晨院子裡的燈泡還亮著，媽媽已經提著水桶在外面了。灌木上的幾個花苞開了，蜜蜂正在花朵四周飛舞，振翅作響。
en: Early in the morning, the light bulb in the yard was still on, and Mom was already outside with a bucket. A few buds on the bush had opened, and bees were buzzing around the flowers.

zh: 送報員看見前方的路被泥沙掩埋，連忙踩下煞車。後座那一捆報紙滑到了地上，幸好外層的塑膠袋沒有破。
en: The newspaper boy saw that the road ahead was buried under mud and quickly hit the brakes. The bundle of newspapers on the back seat slid to the ground. Luckily, the plastic bag around it did not break.

zh: 機長請大家往左邊的窗戶看，客艙裡一下子安靜下來。我從座位上看見一座橫跨峽谷的吊橋，陽光正照在支撐橋面的纜索上。
en: The captain asked everyone to look out of the windows on the left, and the cabin suddenly went quiet. From my seat I saw a bridge hanging across the canyon, and the sun was shining on the cables that held it up.

zh: 到了新學校，我第一個敢走進去的地方是校園裡的自助餐廳。跟我同桌的女孩很開朗，我們才聊了一會兒，我就沒那麼緊張了。
en: At my new school, the first place I dared to walk into was the cafeteria on campus. The girl at my table was cheerful, and after we chatted for a while, I was not so nervous.

zh: 爸爸做木匠已經二十年了。他職業生涯中第一次遇到坐輪椅的客戶。他相信自己有能力為這位客戶做出一張高度剛好的書桌。
en: Dad has been a carpenter for twenty years. For the first time in his career, he has a client who uses a wheelchair. He believes he is capable of making a desk at just the right height for this client.

zh: 農夫正在山腳下數牛，忽然聽見洞穴裡傳來公雞的叫聲。我們在洞口撒了一把米，終於捉到了昨天逃走的那隻公雞。
en: The farmer was counting his cattle at the foot of the mountain when he heard a rooster crowing in a cave. We threw a handful of rice at the entrance of the cave and finally captured the cock that ran away yesterday.

zh: 我們在博物館看到一輛馬車，車廂地板上竟然鋪著地毯。導覽員說這輛馬車當年造價昂貴，旁邊那輛木製手推車才是農夫用來載菜的。
en: At the museum we saw a carriage with a carpet on its floor. The guide said this carriage was costly back then, and the wooden cart next to it was what farmers used to carry vegetables.

zh: 這是一場非正式的試鏡，大家都穿著自己的衣服來。導演選了平時很安靜的學姊演馬戲團的小丑。她一走上台，她的魅力就把我們全都吸引住了。
en: It was a casual audition, so everyone came in their own clothes. The director chose a usually quiet older student to play the circus clown. As soon as she walked on stage, her charm won all of us over.

zh: 去年拿下冠軍的學長今天代表我們學校，和來自台南的選手競爭。比賽後，教練坐到他身邊安慰他，說第二名也是他努力得來的。
en: Last year's champion represented our school today and competed against players from Tainan. After the match, the coach sat beside him to comfort him and said second place was something he had earned with hard work.

zh: 妹妹用黏土做了一個下巴尖尖的老人，還用指尖在他的臉頰上壓出酒窩。老師說妹妹很有創造力，因為大家一看就認得出那是我們的校長。
en: My sister made an old man with a pointed chin out of clay and pressed dimples into his cheeks with her fingertip. The teacher said she was very creative because everyone could tell right away that it was our principal.

zh: 媽媽點了一杯用椰子汁調的雞尾酒，杯沿上還放了一顆櫻桃。妹妹想吃那顆櫻桃，服務生就從廚房另外拿了一顆給她。
en: Mom ordered a cocktail made with coconut water, with a cherry on the edge of the glass. My sister wanted to eat the cherry, so the waiter brought her another one from the kitchen.

zh: 山上那天冷颼颼的，門一打開，我就感到一股寒意。我從木箱裡拿出毯子時，正好看見隔壁的煙囪冒起了白煙。
en: It was chilly on the mountain that day, and when the door opened, I felt a chill. As I took a blanket out of the wooden box, I saw white smoke rising from the chimney next door.

zh: 我們只帶了一個小電鍋，哥哥負責把蔬菜切碎。飯還在煮的時候，我們分著吃了最後一包洋芋片。
en: We only brought a small rice cooker, and my brother was in charge of chopping the vegetables. While the rice was still cooking, we shared the last bag of chips.

zh: 我們還沒走進電影院，弟弟就因為門口有人抽香菸而開始咳嗽。爸爸帶他到街角的診所，我則把電影票換成下星期的。
en: Before we even walked into the cinema, my brother started to cough because someone was smoking a cigarette at the door. Dad took him to the clinic on the corner, and I changed our movie tickets to next week.

zh: 幾位市民成立了委員會，討論身心障礙者的公民權利。他們請我把大家的意見傳達給市長，特別是對投票所樓梯的疑慮。
en: Some citizens formed a committee to discuss the civil rights of people with disabilities. They asked me to communicate everyone's opinions to the mayor, especially their worries about the stairs at the voting places.

zh: 清潔工在衣櫥裡找到一件外套，口袋裡有張收據，夾在一張名片上。那張名片是她找到失主的第一條線索。
en: The cleaner found a coat in the closet. In its pocket was a receipt clipped to a business card. That card was her first clue to finding the owner.

zh: 妹妹想用自己做的衣服給搖籃裡的娃娃穿。她拿出一塊棉布做小襯衫，連衣領都是自己縫的。
en: My sister wanted to clothe the doll in the cradle with clothes she made herself. She took out a piece of cotton cloth to make a little shirt, and she even sewed the collar herself.

zh: 外公有一批珍藏的彩色郵票，他把這批收藏按大洲分類。其中有一張來自昔日的英國殖民地，票上的地名跟現在地圖上的不同。
en: Grandpa has a treasured collection of colorful stamps, and he sorts the collection by continent. One of them comes from a former British colony, and the place name on it is different from the one on today's maps.

zh: 我替校報的專欄校稿時，發現最後一句少了一個逗號。少了這個停頓，整段話就會讓讀者困惑，甚至使人得出相反的結論。
en: When I was checking a column for the school newspaper, I found that the last sentence was missing a comma. Without this pause, the whole paragraph would confuse readers and might even lead them to the opposite conclusion.

zh: 音樂會結束後，後排的同學抱怨說他們聽不清楚。他們的抱怨讓我們去比較前後排的錄音。這一比，我們才發現後面的喇叭從頭到尾都沒出聲。
en: After the concert, the students in the back rows complained that they could not hear clearly. Their complaint made us compare the recordings from the front and back rows. This comparison showed that the speakers at the back had not made a sound the whole time.

zh: 我用圓錐體當機器人的帽子，再把馬達接到控制器上。如果兩條線接對了，帽子就會跟著音樂轉動。
en: I used a cone as the robot's hat and then connected the motor to the controller. If the two wires are connected correctly, the hat will turn with the music.

zh: 我看見一輛小貨車撞上停在工地門口的起重機。碰撞後司機仍然神志清醒。他向我確認車裡只有他一個人，我便把這件事告訴接線員。
en: I saw a small truck crash into a crane parked at the gate of a construction site. After the crash, the driver was still conscious. He confirmed with me that he was the only one in the truck, and I told the operator.

zh: 這兩個村子雖然在同一個縣，今天的雨量卻有相當大的差距。其中一村整個下午雨勢都維持不變，另一村卻只下了十分鐘。
en: Although these two villages are in the same county, there was a considerable difference in rainfall today. In one village the rain stayed constant all afternoon, but in the other it only rained for ten minutes.

zh: 英文老師指著一隻正往海裡爬的螃蟹，請我們說出眼前看到的兩個名詞。接著她問我們，英文裡「螃蟹」和「沙」哪一個是可數名詞。
en: The English teacher pointed at a crab crawling toward the sea and asked us to name two nouns we could see. Then she asked us which word in English is countable, "crab" or "sand."

zh: 這本漫畫的創作者把每種生物都畫得比實物大。弟弟看了半天，才認出戴眼鏡的主角是一隻蟋蟀。
en: The creator of this comic book draws every creature bigger than it really is. My brother looked for a long time before he realized that the main character in glasses was a cricket.

zh: 我們的戲裡，一名罪犯偷走王冠，躲到一艘正要出港的船上。殘酷的國王下令把全體船員關起來，直到有人說出小偷藏在哪裡。
en: In our play, a criminal steals the crown and hides on a ship that is about to leave the harbor. The cruel king orders the whole crew to be locked up until someone tells where the thief is hiding.

zh: 地瓜是外婆家農場的主要作物。她把賣剩的地瓜烤成酥脆的薄片，收在店裡的碗櫃。她認識多年的客人可以賒帳買這些地瓜片。
en: Sweet potatoes are the main crop on Grandma's farm. She bakes the unsold sweet potatoes into crispy slices and keeps them in the cupboard in her shop. Customers she has known for years can buy these chips on credit.

zh: 過去十年，小鎮上的牛奶店已從五家減少到一家。剩下的那家在黎明就開門，趕早班車的人也買得到鮮奶。
en: In the past decade, the dairy shops in the town have decreased from five to one. The last one opens at dawn, so people catching the early train can still buy fresh milk.

zh: 水壩下方有一條水溝，把田裡多餘的水排出去。雨停了，水還從葉尖滴下來，一隻蜻蜓就停在其中一片葉子上。
en: There is a ditch below the dam that drains extra water from the fields. The rain had stopped, but water was still dripping from the tips of the leaves, and a dragonfly was resting on one of them.

zh: 我不喜歡高處，從跳水台往下看就頭暈。弟弟問我敢不敢跳。我還在搖頭，他就沿著跳板飛奔，跳進了水裡。
en: I dislike high places, and looking down from the diving board makes me dizzy. My brother asked if I dared to jump. I was still shaking my head when he dashed along the board and dived into the water.

zh: 爸在卡片上寫著：「親愛的，今晚跟我一起在陽台用餐好嗎？」他已經用媽媽喜歡的花把陽台布置好了，冰箱裡還藏著她最愛的甜點。
en: Dad wrote on the card, "Darling, will you dine with me on the balcony tonight?" He had already decorated the balcony with the flowers Mom likes, and her favorite dessert was hidden in the fridge.

zh: 老師拿出一張舊磁碟，裡面存著我們學校第一份方言資料庫。新程式偵測到兩筆拼法相同的詞條。我們讀了定義才明白，這是兩個不同的詞。
en: The teacher took out an old disk that holds our school's first database of local dialects. The new program detected two entries with the same spelling. After reading the definitions, we understood that they were two different words.

zh: 一名不誠實的古董商聲稱自己擁有鎮上最老的房子。叔叔先查了房屋契據才決定要不要付訂金，結果發現屋主另有其人。
en: A dishonest antique dealer claimed he owned the oldest house in town. My uncle checked the deed of the house before deciding whether to pay the deposit and found that someone else owned it.

zh: 班導讓我們自己決定班費如何運用。每個人都能提出想法並投票。這次民主的決策過程加深了我對民主的了解。
en: Our homeroom teacher let us determine how to use our class money. Everyone could share ideas and vote. This democratic way of deciding deepened my understanding of democracy.

zh: 姊姊從小就渴望成為服裝設計師。她覺得市中心那家店是最理想的工作地點，因為新人也能在櫥窗展示自己的作品。
en: Since she was little, my sister has had a strong desire to become a fashion designer. She thinks the downtown shop is the most desirable place to work because even new designers can show their work in the window.

zh: 微暗的燈光下，一個長角的惡魔在舞台上追著紙做的恐龍和驢子跑。演到一半，有人打翻一杯水，毀了惡魔的紙翅膀。
en: Under the dim light, a devil with horns chased a paper dinosaur and a donkey around the stage. Halfway through, someone knocked over a glass of water and destroyed the devil's paper wings.

zh: 船靠近碼頭時，大家都以為今天看不到海豚了。就在我走上甲板時，一隻海豚躍出海面，又一頭潛入水裡。
en: As the boat came near the dock, everyone thought we would not see any dolphins today. Just as I stepped onto the deck, a dolphin jumped out of the sea and dived back into the water.

words.zh: 甲板、(汽車後部的)行李倉

zh: 在美國旅行時，妹妹買一個甜甜圈還差十美分。她很懷疑店主肯給她折扣，沒想到一位客人把一枚十美分硬幣放在她手上。
en: While traveling in the US, my sister was ten cents short for a doughnut. She was doubtful the owner would give her a discount, but a customer put a dime in her hand.

zh: 我把舊木箱拖到院子裡，先撣去蓋子上的灰塵。把手旁的汙垢很難清，我只好把布浸在水裡，再慢慢擦掉汙垢。
en: I dragged the old wooden box into the yard and dusted the lid first. The dirt by the handle was hard to clean, so I dipped a cloth in water and slowly wiped it off.

zh: 我去藥房替爸爸領藥。藥師正在說明每一劑該吃幾顆，一名喝醉的男子走錯門，進來問公車站在哪裡。
en: I went to the drugstore to get Dad's medicine. While the pharmacist was explaining how many pills to take for each dose, a drunk man came in through the wrong door and asked where the bus stop was.

zh: 有人把廢土倒進排水溝，雨水流不出去，菜苗全淹死了。農夫清好水溝、重新播種。幾週後，菜園的變化十分顯著，原本光禿禿的地方長滿了青菜。
en: Someone dumped dirt into the drain, so the rainwater could not flow out and all the young vegetables drowned. The farmer cleaned the ditch and planted the seeds again. A few weeks later, the change in the garden was dramatic. The bare spots were full of green vegetables.

zh: 童話裡，其他動物笑驢子笨，連一顆餃子也包不好。等客人愈來愈多，牠們才發現只有驢子記得每一桌點了什麼。
en: In the fairy tale, the other animals laughed at the donkey for being dumb because it could not even wrap a dumpling. When more and more guests came, they found that only the donkey remembered what each table ordered.

zh: 校刊編輯急著看球賽報導，但我還在等隊長回覆。她教我先編輯其他段落，這個做法比坐著等更有效率。
en: The editor of the school magazine was eager to see the report on the game, but I was still waiting for the captain's reply. She taught me to edit the other parts first. This way was more efficient than sitting and waiting.

zh: 學校設計了一個遊戲，教孩子認識水資源短缺的問題。這個遊戲既有教育意義又好玩。我最喜歡的環節，是自己決定如何把一桶水分給三戶人家。
en: The school designed a game to educate children about the shortage of water. The game is both educational and enjoyable. My favorite part was deciding how to share a bucket of water among three families.

words.zh: 可從中得到樂趣的、令人愉快的

zh: 一位年長的乘客在電梯裡跌倒，撞到了手肘。遇到這種緊急情況時，可以按牆上的通話鈕，讓管理員知道你在哪裡。
en: An elderly passenger fell in the elevator and hit her elbow. In an emergency like this, you can press the call button on the wall to let the manager know where you are.

zh: 學校原本打算用電子設備舉行選舉，可是當天早上停了電。大家改用紙票，還是在午休前選出了新會長。
en: The school planned to hold the election with electronic equipment, but the electricity went out that morning. Everyone used paper votes instead, and they still elected a new president before lunch break.

zh: 我很羨慕演皇帝的同學。他那張表情豐富的臉讓全場都看得出皇帝有多生氣。謝幕時他看見爸爸站起來鼓掌，激動得掉了眼淚。
en: I envy my classmate who played the emperor. His expressive face showed everyone how angry the emperor was. At the curtain call, he saw his father stand up and clap, and he became so emotional that he cried.

zh: 表姊的訂婚派對在二樓舉行。入口旁新裝的升降椅讓外婆能自己上樓。她那天精神特別好，還拉著我去跳了第一支舞。
en: My cousin's engagement party was held on the second floor. The new stair lift beside the entry enabled Grandma to go upstairs by herself. She was especially energetic that day and even pulled me to the first dance.

zh: 在學生美術展覽開幕前，我把海報上一條多餘的鉛筆線擦掉了。老師說我對自己的期待很高，但追求卓越也要學會在畫完時放下筆。
en: Before the student art exhibition opened, I erased an extra pencil line on my poster. The teacher said I had high expectations of myself, but pursuing excellence also means learning to put the pen down when the painting is done.

zh: 我們和國外的學生交換禮物時，送的是阿姨家出口的茶葉。對方回信說，他們那裡的冬天極其寒冷，放學後很喜歡把我們送的茶葉泡成熱茶來喝。
en: When we exchanged gifts with students abroad, we gave them tea that my aunt's family exports. They wrote back that winters there are extremely cold, and they love making hot tea with our gift after school.

zh: 我們和老師一起探索一條舊隧道，還做了一個關於回聲的實驗。老師把氣球吹到爆裂，我們用手機錄下聲音，查看過了多久才聽到回聲。
en: We explored an old tunnel with our teacher and did an experiment on echoes. The teacher blew up a balloon until it exploded, and we recorded the sound with our phones to see how long it took to hear the echo.

zh: 戲服間裡有件花俏的外套，是去年演仙女的同學穿過的。雖然袖口已經褪色，加上一條窄皮帶後，這件外套看起來又很時尚。
en: In the costume room there is a fancy jacket that a classmate wore to play a fairy last year. Although the cuffs have faded, with a narrow belt the jacket looks fashionable again.

zh: 浴室的水龍頭把手突然掉下來，妹妹嚇得幾乎暈倒。受了這場驚嚇後，她一直害怕獨自走進浴室，直到爸爸把水龍頭修好。
en: The handle of the bathroom faucet suddenly fell off, and my sister almost fainted from fear. After this fright, she was fearful of going into the bathroom alone until Dad fixed the faucet.

zh: 兩位鬥士在上場前握起拳頭，輕輕碰了碰對方的拳套。他們都信任這位裁判，因為她總是公平地對待每個人。
en: Before the match, the two fighters made fists and lightly touched each other's gloves. They both had faith in the referee because she always treats everyone fairly.

zh: 叔叔原以為這只錶值一大筆錢，就拿去給一位熟悉老錶的師傅看。師傅很坦白，當場指出它是仿造品，還讓我們比較真錶和這只錶上的刻字。
en: My uncle thought this watch was worth a fortune, so he took it to a repairman familiar with old watches. The repairman was frank and told him right away that it was a fake. He even let us compare the words on a real watch and this one.

zh: 在多霧的山區，這兩個村子之間的公車班次不多。站牌上寫得很清楚，想再往山裡搭遠一點的人要付多少車資。
en: In the foggy mountains, there are not many buses between these two villages. The sign at the bus stop clearly shows how much the fare is for people who want to go farther into the mountains.

zh: 一群白鳥越過田邊的柵欄時，我看見一根羽毛慢慢落下來。它輕輕落在灌溉溝裡，浮在水面上。
en: When a flock of white birds flew over the fence by the field, I saw a feather slowly falling. It landed gently in the ditch and floated on the water.

zh: 操場上突然閃過一道光，我以為有人提早放了煙火。原來是警衛打開了手電筒。他看到球門旁有一小團火焰，想看清楚是什麼東西著火了。
en: A light suddenly flashed across the playground, and I thought someone had set off fireworks early. It was the guard turning on his flashlight. He saw a small flame beside the goal and wanted to see clearly what was burning.

zh: 我把芒果從冷凍庫取出，等它稍微變軟，再把果肉壓成泥。妹妹把果泥拌進麵粉裡，烤出來的餅乾有淡淡的芒果味。
en: I took the mango out of the freezer, waited for it to soften a little, and then mashed the flesh. My sister mixed the mashed mango into the flour, and the cookies she baked had a light mango flavor.

zh: 我喜歡聽阿公在河堤吹長笛，他甚至有一小群每週都來聽他演奏的聽眾。等我搬走後，我想我會永遠記得那段隨風飄進窗戶的旋律。
en: I love listening to Grandpa play the flute on the riverbank, and he even has a small group of followers who come to hear him every week. After I move away, I think I will remember that melody drifting through my window forever.

zh: 洪水退去後，我們把借來的毛毯摺好，讓卡車司機載到下一個村子。居民還成立了基金，替載送物資的司機支付燃料費。
en: After the flood went down, we folded the borrowed blankets so a truck driver could take them to the next village. The villagers also set up a fund to pay for fuel for the drivers who carried supplies.

zh: 那年冬天我住在國外，看見公園的噴泉整座結冰了。一塊掉下來的冰嚇到了旁邊的小狗，牠鑽進主人懷裡，只露出一小撮灰色的軟毛。
en: I lived abroad that winter and saw the whole fountain in the park freeze. A falling piece of ice frightened a small dog nearby. It jumped into its owner's arms, and only a little gray fur showed.

zh: 住在美國的叔叔讓我看車庫裡的一本舊帳本。我只瞥了一眼，就發現他當年買一加侖汽油付的錢比現在少得多。
en: My uncle in the US showed me an old account book in his garage. With just one glance, I saw that he paid much less for a gallon of gasoline back then than now.

zh: 小說裡，一幫人常躲在圍牆的缺口後面賭博。最貪心的那個人想把贏來的錢翻倍，結果連最後一枚硬幣都輸掉了。
en: In the novel, a gang often gambles behind a gap in the wall. The greediest man wanted to double the money he had won, but in the end he lost even his last coin.

zh: 我們在地理老師的指導下，寫信問美國一位州長，當地農民如何因應全球氣候變遷。州長回信時附了一張地圖，上面標出了最缺水的農場。
en: With guidance from our geography teacher, we wrote to a US governor to ask how local farmers deal with global climate change. The governor wrote back with a map showing the farms that need water most.

zh: 日落的餘暉照在高爾夫球場上，教練做了個手勢，請觀眾安靜。這位為學校贏得榮耀的選手，去年還只是個幫大家撿球的新生。
en: The glow of the sunset shone on the golf course, and the coach made a gesture asking the audience to be quiet. The player who has brought glory to our school was only a new student who picked up balls for everyone last year.

zh: 聽到有人說班長畢業後要當歌手，我沒有把這段流言傳出去。拍班級合照時我親口問了她，她露齒一笑，說自己已經考上音樂系了。
en: When I heard someone say our class leader would become a singer after she graduates, I did not spread the gossip. When we took the class photo, I asked her myself. She grinned and said she had already been accepted by a music department.

zh: 弟弟在雜貨店買完口香糖，裝著零錢的袋子就從櫃檯滑了下來。他一把抓住提帶，我握緊袋口，硬幣一枚都沒掉出來。
en: After my brother bought gum at the grocery store, the bag with his change slid off the counter. He grabbed the handle, and I grasped the top of the bag, so not a single coin fell out.

words.zh: 食品雜貨店、食品雜貨業

zh: 溫室旁有一片長滿草的斜坡，是美術老師最喜歡帶我們寫生的地方。今天一隻蚱蜢跳到同學的畫上，顏色和他畫的草一模一樣。
en: There is a grassy slope beside the greenhouse, and it is the art teacher's favorite place to take us to draw. Today a grasshopper jumped onto a classmate's painting, and it was exactly the same color as the grass he painted.

zh: 我到店裡時，美髮師正用一條手帕幫淋了雨的小客人擦臉。我從走廊盡頭拿來一個衣架，讓這個孩子把濕外套掛起來。
en: When I got to the shop, the hairdresser was using a handkerchief to dry the face of a little customer who had been caught in the rain. I brought a hanger from the end of the hallway so the child could hang up his wet jacket.

zh: 一堆舊木板旁只剩一小把釘子，正好夠我們修好一張凳子。老師借給我一支小鐵鎚，比家裡的那支輕。要在凳腳之間敲釘子時，這支鐵鎚特別好用。
en: Only a handful of nails were left beside a heap of old boards, just enough for us to fix a stool. The teacher lent me a small hammer that was lighter than the one at home. It was especially handy for hitting nails between the stool's legs.

zh: 地方報紙的頭條報導了港口的漏油事件。油會傷害海鳥，這次已經有兩隻幼鳥受害。居民想知道怎麼做才能保護鳥群，避免漏油造成更嚴重的危害。
en: The headline of the local newspaper was about an oil spill in the harbor. Oil can harm seabirds, and two young birds have already been hurt. The people living nearby want to know how to protect the birds and keep the oil spill from causing more harm.

zh: 我們在農場幫忙收割牧草。草曬乾後，我們把乾草搬進穀倉，卻有一隻剛孵出來的小雞擋在門口。我猶豫了一下，決定等牠自己跟上母雞。
en: We helped with the hay harvest on the farm. After the grass dried, we carried the hay into the barn, but a chick that had just hatched was standing in the doorway. I hesitated and decided to wait until it followed the mother hen by itself.

zh: 有人暗示球隊總部把比賽獎金全拿走了，網路上很快就出現充滿恨意的留言。隊長請我們先看看隊員自己公布的帳目，以免倉促下結論。
en: Someone hinted that the team's headquarters had taken all the prize money, and hateful comments soon appeared online. The captain asked us to look at the accounts the players had made public first, so we would not make a hasty conclusion.

zh: 上次爬山時腳後跟磨出的水泡已經癒合，我終於能再出發了。這次我們雇用了一位當地嚮導，她在落石區入口叫大家戴好安全帽。
en: The blister on my heel from the last hike has healed, so I can finally go again. This time we hired a local guide, and at the start of the area with falling rocks, she told everyone to put on their helmets.

zh: 我們排的是一齣描寫地獄的戲，舞台上有一堆畫成火焰的紙板。排練室的暖氣機也開到了最強，才念完第一句臺詞，大家就熱得脫下外套。
en: We were rehearsing a play about hell, and there was a heap of cardboard painted like flames on the stage. The heater in the rehearsal room was also turned all the way up. After the first line, everyone was so hot that they took off their jackets.

zh: 每位持票人都可以跟歷史學家走進這座有歷史意義的古城。我們進入當地人視為神聖的殿堂前，先脫了鞋。
en: Every ticket holder can walk into this historic old city with a historian. Before we entered the hall that local people consider holy, we took off our shoes.

words.zh: 歷史上著名的、有歷史性的

zh: 室友聽見我閉著嘴輕聲唱著故鄉的小調，就知道我想家了。她給了我一個擁抱。我告訴她，我希望今年能回家過年。
en: When my roommate heard me humming a song from my hometown, she knew I was homesick. She gave me a hug. I told her I was hopeful that I could go home for the New Year this year.

zh: 阿哲說，得到校刊寫作獎是份榮譽。他在致詞時唸了自己寫得最糟的一句，還解釋那句話好笑在哪裡。那段幽默的致詞讓我們欣賞他的誠實和幽默感。
en: A-Zhe said winning the school magazine's writing award was an honor. In his speech, he read the worst sentence he had ever written and explained why it was funny. That humorous speech made us admire his honesty and his sense of humor.

zh: 在那部恐怖片裡，男主角聽到一聲可怕的尖叫。我們到片尾才發現，那是一個孩子對著中空的牛角吹出來的聲音。
en: In that horror movie, the hero hears a horrible scream. Not until the end did we learn that it was the sound of a child blowing into a hollow horn.

zh: 夏天，山上的度假小屋很潮濕，管家每天都來開窗。她按鐘點領薪水，也常把一部分收入捐給幫助村民對抗飢餓的團體。
en: In summer, the vacation cabin in the mountains is very humid, so the housekeeper comes to open the windows every day. She is paid hourly and often gives part of her pay to a group that helps villagers fight hunger.

zh: 阿姨在小旅館外結冰的臺階上滑倒，傷了腳踝。我跑去通知旅館老闆，說她需要立即就醫。
en: My aunt slipped on the icy steps outside the small inn and hurt her ankle. I ran to inform the owner of the inn that she needed immediate medical care.

zh: 雨下了一整天，我們只好待在室內。老師為室內活動準備的材料只有紙箱，但同學用想像力搭出了一座有捷運的城市，讓來參觀的家長印象深刻。
en: It rained all day, so we had to stay indoors. The only materials the teacher prepared for the indoor activity were boxes, but my classmates used their imagination to build a city with an MRT, and it impressed the visiting parents.

zh: 這家公司以前從海外進口工業用零件。檢查員逐件檢查後，發現其中一批的品質比臺灣製的零件差。
en: This company used to import industrial parts from overseas. The inspector inspected them one by one and found that the quality of one batch was inferior to parts made in Taiwan.

zh: 班費少了一百元，班長先蒐集資訊，調查那筆錢是誰拿去買東西的。後來他在自己的背包內袋找到收據，才想起買粉筆的是自己。被大家懷疑的值日生是清白的。
en: One hundred dollars was missing from the class money, so the class leader gathered information to investigate who had taken it to buy something. Later he found the receipt in the inner pocket of his own backpack and remembered that he was the one who bought the chalk. The student on duty, whom everyone suspected, was innocent.

zh: 那位聰明的年輕發明家收到科展邀請後，帶來一雙她發明的乳白色手套。弟弟想知道她怎麼用手套控制玩具車，卻不想打斷她的示範，就等到最後才問。
en: After receiving the invitation to the science fair, the young intelligent inventor brought a pair of ivory gloves she had invented. My brother wanted to know how she controlled a toy car with the gloves, but he did not want to interrupt her show, so he waited until the end to ask.

zh: 在這本推理小說裡，一名珠寶商從監獄寄了封信給女兒。信裡附了一張失竊寶石的素描。女兒一看到圖，就認出那是母親首飾盒裡的那顆寶石。
en: In this mystery novel, a jeweler sends a letter to his daughter from jail. The letter includes a sketch of a stolen jewel. As soon as the daughter sees the picture, she recognizes the stone from her mother's jewelry box.

zh: 姊姊的下顎剛開完刀，咬不動她最愛的多汁水蜜桃。我用桃汁做了果凍，裝進小玻璃罐，讓她也能吃到生日甜點。
en: My sister just had surgery on her jaw, so she cannot bite her favorite juicy peaches. I made jelly with peach juice and put it in small glass jars, so she could have a birthday dessert, too.

zh: 這趟旅行的第一站是叢林邊的小鎮。我們搭噴射機到最近的城市，再轉乘吉普車，趕在天黑前抵達小鎮。
en: The first stop on this journey was a small town at the edge of the jungle. We took a jet to the nearest city and then took a jeep, arriving at the town before dark.

zh: 學校爵士樂團裡，一名資淺的團員用一堆廢棄舊物做了一面鼓。她被選為獨奏者時，我有點嫉妒，但當她敲出那段歡快的節奏，我也跟著拍起手來。
en: In the school jazz band, a junior member made a drum out of a pile of junk. When she was chosen to play a solo, I was a little jealous, but when she played that joyful beat, I started clapping along.

zh: 幼兒園的孩子走了一公里才到無尾熊館，卻只看到一隻無尾熊抱著樹睡覺。回程經過袋鼠區時，剛好有隻小袋鼠從媽媽的育兒袋裡探出頭來。
en: The kindergarten children walked one kilometer to the koala house but only saw one koala sleeping in a tree. On the way back, as they passed the kangaroo area, a baby kangaroo was just looking out of its mother's pouch.

zh: 在妹妹寫的故事裡，王國中最勇敢的騎士很怕冷。奶奶替他織了一條紅圍巾，他出發前還請她把圍巾的兩端打成一個結。
en: In my sister's story, the bravest knight in the kingdom hates the cold. Grandma knitted him a red scarf, and before he left, he asked her to tie the two ends of the scarf in a knot.

zh: 自然老師帶來一套人體模型組裝材料。我的工作是裝上兩顆腎臟。同組同學坐在鍵盤前，把我做的每個步驟都打進電腦。
en: The science teacher brought a kit for building a model of the human body. My job was to put in the two kidneys. My partner sat at the keyboard and typed every step I did into the computer.

zh: 我正要把皮外套和有蕾絲花邊的洋裝放進洗衣籃。媽媽看了外套的標籤，提醒我這件只能乾洗。
en: I was about to put my leather jacket and a dress with lace into the laundry basket. Mom looked at the label on the jacket and reminded me that it could only be dry-cleaned.

zh: 最近，每次澆陽臺上的花，水都會從鬆動的接頭漏到下面的草坪上。今天爸爸扶著梯子，我爬上去把接頭轉緊了。
en: Lately, every time I water the flowers on the balcony, water leaks from a loose joint onto the lawn below. Today Dad held the ladder while I climbed up and tightened the joint.

zh: 爺爺喜歡在閒暇時到公園下棋。每局的輸家都要教贏家一句家鄉話。爺爺說這種學語言的方式很活潑，棋桌旁也總是充滿笑聲。
en: Grandpa likes to play chess in the park in his leisure time. The loser of each game has to teach the winner a sentence in his hometown dialect. Grandpa says this way of learning a language is lively, and the chess table is always full of laughter.

zh: 紀錄片裡那隻豹傷了一條後肢，每次走到倒下的原木前就停下來。幾週後，同一臺相機拍到牠一躍而過。
en: In the documentary, a leopard hurt one of its back limbs and stopped every time it came to a fallen log. A few weeks later, the same camera filmed it leaping over the log.

zh: 我帶了一條麵包、生菜和一壺檸檬水去野餐。弟弟忙著舔棒棒糖，沒注意到有隻鴿子已經跳上麵包袋了。
en: I brought a loaf of bread, some lettuce, and a jug of lemonade to the picnic. My brother was busy licking a lollipop and did not notice that a pigeon had already jumped onto the bread bag.

zh: 劇裡的領主把一名水手關了起來。水手在獄中寫信給戀人，說他願意用一輩子的財富換回自由。
en: In the play, the lord locked up a sailor. In prison, the sailor wrote to his lover, saying he would trade a lifetime of wealth for his liberty.

zh: 救援隊知道船的確切位置嗎？一道閃電照亮海面，燈塔管理員這才找到那艘船，並用無線電告訴救援隊它在哪裡。
en: Did the rescue team know the exact location of the boat? A flash of lightning lit up the sea, and then the lighthouse keeper located the boat and told the rescue team by radio where it was.

zh: 肺部手術後，爸爸第一次出門過夜。到了旅館，他把行李鎖進櫃子，就到花園去畫百合花。他的畫現在掛在大廳，旁邊還貼著他寫的告示，請遊客別在花園亂丟垃圾。
en: After his lung surgery, Dad stayed away from home overnight for the first time. At the hotel, he locked his luggage in a cabinet and went to the garden to paint the lilies. His painting now hangs in the lobby, with a sign he wrote beside it asking visitors not to litter in the garden.

zh: 魔術師的湯匙彷彿有股魔力，竟能自己在桌面上移動。弟弟後來發現桌子底下藏著一塊磁鐵，卻還是說這是場絕妙的表演。
en: The magician's spoon seemed to have magical power because it could move across the table by itself. My brother later found a magnet hidden under the table, but he still said it was a marvelous show.

zh: 士兵們列隊走過城堡，泥靴把大理石地板弄得一團亂。女僕看著自己剛拖好的地，請隊長留下來一起打掃。
en: The soldiers marched through the castle, and their muddy boots made a mess of the marble floor. The maid looked at the floor she had just mopped and asked the captain to stay and help clean it.

zh: 市長宣布了鎮民投票的結果。多數人希望保留小溪旁的牧草地，把購物中心蓋在舊車站附近。當地新聞媒體隔天公布了得票數。
en: The mayor announced the result of the town vote. The majority wanted to keep the meadow beside the stream and build the mall near the old station. The local news media reported the number of votes the next day.

zh: 和平展裡，一個孩子寫道：「一枚威力強大的飛彈摧毀了我的學校，一群暴民又闖進我家。我希望全人類都記得戰爭帶來的痛苦。」
en: At the peace exhibition, a child wrote, "A mighty missile destroyed my school, and a mob broke into my home. I hope all mankind remembers the misery that war brings."

zh: 老師在白板上寫下一道數學算式，請我們找錯。弟弟拿起白板筆，把減號改成乘號，解釋這裡為什麼要把兩個數字相乘。
en: The teacher wrote a mathematical problem on the whiteboard and asked us to find the mistake. My brother picked up a marker, changed the minus sign to a times sign, and explained why we had to multiply the two numbers here.

zh: 哥哥說，受傷後再度跑過終點，比得到獎牌更有意義。朋友稱這是奇蹟，但哥哥還記得自己怎麼鍛鍊肌肉，也記得復健期間承受的心理壓力。
en: My brother said crossing the finish line again after his injury was more meaningful than winning a medal. His friends called it a miracle, but my brother still remembers how he built up his muscles and the mental stress he went through during recovery.

zh: 我把蘑菇湯放進微波爐加熱。這段時間，姊姊把甜瓜切成小塊。突然停電了，我們便決定先吃冰淇淋，免得它融化。
en: I heated the mushroom soup in the microwave. Meanwhile, my sister cut the melon into small pieces. Suddenly the power went out, so we decided to eat the ice cream first before it melted.

zh: 里民每月的聚會才剛開始，麥克風就沒了聲音。林伯伯修好接在麥克風上的電線，大家就又唱起歡快的歌。
en: The neighborhood's monthly meeting had just started when the microphone went silent. Uncle Lin mended the wire connected to the microphone, and everyone sang merry songs again.

zh: 搜救隊的任務是找到一名失蹤的登山客。霧太濃了，隊員就把移動式指揮站設在河邊。等霧散了，他們才發動船上的馬達，沿河搜索。
en: The rescue team's mission was to find a missing hiker. The mist was so thick that the team set up a mobile command station by the river. When the mist cleared, they started the boat's motor and searched along the river.

zh: 我們住的汽車旅館就在池塘旁。房間的窗戶上凝著水氣，連床單摸起來都是潮的。夜裡聚在燈下的昆蟲多半是蛾，但鑽進蚊帳咬我的是一隻蚊子。
en: Our motel was right beside a pond. There was moisture on the windows of our room, and even the sheets felt moist. Most of the insects gathered under the light at night were moths, but the one that got into my net and bit me was a mosquito.

zh: 村民以為怪物謀殺了守門人，一名僧侶卻決心解開謎團。劇終前，他得決定是否揭發那位曾經救過他的人。散場後，我們還在討論這個道德問題。
en: The villagers thought a monster had murdered the gatekeeper, but a monk was determined to solve the mystery. Before the end of the play, he has to decide whether to expose the person who once saved him. After the show, we were still talking about this moral question.

zh: 媽媽找出一張我還是嬰兒時的照片。我洗完澡，正光著身子打盹。哥哥躺在我旁邊，把一張餐巾摺成整齊的小方塊，給他的玩具熊當枕頭。
en: Mom found a photo of me as a baby. I had just had a bath and was taking a nap naked. My brother was lying beside me, folding a napkin into a neat little square as a pillow for his teddy bear.

zh: 我們社區有棵老樹，每年都有臺灣原生的鳥回來築巢。妹妹放學經過時，會站在對街靜靜地看牠們一會兒。
en: There is an old tree in our neighborhood, and every year birds native to Taiwan come back to build a nest in it. When my sister passes by after school, she stands across the street and quietly watches them for a while.

zh: 爸爸在海軍服役時，有張我很喜歡的照片。那天船班剛恢復正常，他鬆開制服上的領帶，幫忙把生活必需品搬上島。
en: There is a photo of Dad from when he served in the navy that I really like. That day, the boats had just gone back to normal. He loosened the necktie of his uniform and helped carry daily necessities onto the island.

zh: 那位小說家的筆名來自她小時候的綽號。替她取這個綽號的修女至今仍留著她寫的第一篇故事。
en: The novelist's pen name comes from her childhood nickname. The nun who gave her this nickname still keeps the first story she wrote.

zh: 這項仍在進行的調查記錄老橡樹裡一家貓頭鷹的生活。我們躲在遠處的矮牆後面，輪流用望遠鏡觀察親鳥帶了什麼回巢。
en: This ongoing study records the life of an owl family in an old oak tree. We hid behind a low wall far away and took turns observing with binoculars what the parent birds brought back to the nest.

zh: 這是我第一次在這麼正式的場合做口頭報告。時間不夠，我只好略過兩個例子，概述居民在訪談裡提到的三個問題。
en: This was my first oral report on such a formal occasion. There was not enough time, so I had to omit two examples and outline the three problems the residents mentioned in the interviews.

zh: 農場寄來幾顆形狀古怪的有機洋蔥。我把洋蔥切片，放到烤盤上，再把烤盤送進烤箱。晚餐就這樣多了一道菜。
en: The farm sent us some odd-shaped organic onions. I sliced the onions, put them onto a baking tray, and then put the tray in the oven. That gave us one more dish for dinner.

zh: 手術後，阿嘉常望著醫院對面的籃球場。他對復原很樂觀，還告訴我們，出院後他想先到那裡投一球。
en: After his operation, A-Jia often looked at the basketball court opposite the hospital. He was optimistic about his recovery and told us that the first thing he wanted to do after leaving the hospital was shoot a ball there.

zh: 美術社原本的計畫是在教室辦展。後來社員在學校圍牆外側辦了場戶外畫展。籌辦展覽的同學說，明年他想再到戶外展出，讓路過的居民也能留下自己的畫。
en: The art club's original plan was to hold the show in a classroom. Later the members held an outdoor art show on the outer side of the school wall. The student who organized it said he wants to show the art outdoors again next year so the people walking by can leave their own drawings, too.

zh: 阿姨陪我練口試，讓我得到出國讀書的機會。到宿舍的第一晚，我就寫信告訴她，我欠她一聲謝謝。
en: My aunt helped me practice for my oral exam, and I got the opportunity to study overseas. On my first night in the dorm, I wrote to tell her that I owed her a thank-you.

zh: 一頭平時幫忙拉車的役牛走進了隔壁的牧場，兩邊的農夫都說牛是自己的。獸醫用耳牌號碼查了登記資料，才釐清這頭牛的所有權。
en: An ox that usually helps pull a cart walked into the field next door, and the farmers on both sides said the ox was theirs. The vet checked the records with the number on its ear tag and cleared up the question of ownership.

zh: 爺爺把一個小木偶放在我的手掌上，教我輕拍它背上的軟墊，讓它點頭。我練了一個下午才抓到力道，這才知道演木偶戲需要多少耐心。
en: Grandpa put a small wooden puppet on the palm of my hand and taught me to pat the pad on its back to make it nod. I practiced all afternoon before I got the right strength, and then I learned how much patience a puppet show needs.

zh: 這位畫家受邀到宮殿裡替女王畫肖像。女王請他把珍珠耳環也畫進去，因為那是母親留給她的。
en: The painter was invited to the palace to paint a portrait of the queen. The queen asked him to include her pearl earrings because her mother had left them to her.

zh: 我最要好的朋友第一次來我家過夜。隔天早上，我做了花生薄煎餅，她則用新鮮鳳梨榨了一品脫的果汁。
en: My best pal stayed at my house for the first time. The next morning, I made peanut pancakes, and she made a pint of juice from fresh pineapple.

words.zh: 品脫(乾量或液量的單位)

zh: 一位乘客發現護照不見了，開始驚慌起來。一名正要登機的飛行員在通往飛機的狹窄通道裡撿到了護照，交給了地勤人員。
en: A passenger found that her passport was missing and started to panic. A pilot about to board the plane found the passport in the narrow passage leading to the plane and gave it to the ground staff.

zh: 為了拍到整支遊行隊伍，攝影師爬上我家的屋頂。一隻從鏡頭前飛過的鴿子也入了鏡，後來這張照片被印成了明年的活動海報。
en: To get the whole parade in the picture, the photographer climbed onto our roof. A pigeon that flew in front of the camera was also in the shot, and later the photo was printed as the poster for next year's event.

zh: 對喜歡畫動物的外公來說，動物園簡直是樂園。他最愛畫那隻愛玩耍的鸚鵡，也畫過站在水池邊不肯跳下去的企鵝。
en: For Grandpa, who loves drawing animals, the zoo is simply a paradise. He loves drawing the playful parrot most, and he has also drawn the penguin that stood by the pool and refused to jump in.

zh: 我在門口的一堆包裹裡找到我訂的塑膠澡盆。倒水進去時，我才發現底部的塞子掉了，只好蹲下來找。
en: I found the plastic tub I ordered in a pile of parcels at the door. When I poured water in, I found that the plug at the bottom had fallen out, so I had to squat down to look for it.

zh: 阿美從小就對小提琴充滿熱情，今年終於有機會在鄰居面前演奏。雖然那場演出因雨延期了一週，巷子裡的座位還是全坐滿了。
en: A-Mei has had a passion for the violin since she was little, and this year she finally had a chance to perform for her neighbors. Although the performance was postponed for a week because of rain, all the seats in the lane were still full.

zh: 主持人看到我的姓氏時停頓了一下，我就教他怎麼發音。後來有人說他在台上念錯了，幸好我們有當天的錄音，可以證明他念對了。
en: The host paused when he saw my family name, so I taught him how to pronounce it. Later someone said he had said it wrong on stage, but luckily we had a recording from that day as proof that he said it right.

zh: 里長先取得地主的同意，再說服居民一起出錢鋪路。工程許可證核發後，工人用石板鋪好了那條一下雨就全是泥巴的小路。
en: The neighborhood chief first got permission from the landowner and then persuaded the residents to pay together to pave the road. After the work permit was issued, workers paved the path, which used to be full of mud whenever it rained, with stone.

zh: 奶奶要我先把馬鈴薯削皮，再和豌豆一起煮湯。湯煮好以後，我把它倒進兩個碗裡，只在自己的那碗撒了胡椒。
en: Grandma asked me to peel the potatoes first and then cook them in soup with peas. When the soup was ready, I poured it into two bowls and only put pepper in my own.

zh: 我在外婆的小錢包裡找到一枚英國的一便士硬幣。它只值一便士，對我卻比新買的紀念品更寶貴。
en: I found a British penny in Grandma's little purse. It is only worth one penny, but to me it is more precious than any new souvenir.

zh: 爸爸每天都要帶幾顆藥丸去上班，我送了他一個分格的小藥盒。裡面有充足的空間放一天的藥，他說這比帶著一整袋藥實用多了。
en: Dad has to take a few pills to work every day, so I gave him a small pill box with sections. There is plenty of room for one day's medicine, and he says it is much more practical than carrying a whole bag of medicine.

zh: 我們本想在松樹下搭帳篷，卻看見樹根旁有個被落葉蓋住的坑。我們改到平地，把最長的那根營柱立在帳篷中央。
en: We wanted to put up our tent under a pine tree, but we saw a pit covered with fallen leaves beside the roots. We moved to flat ground and stood the longest pole in the middle of the tent.

zh: 小時候我還能在這條溪游泳，現在污染嚴重，真可惜。今年村民在上游設了廢油收集站，防止廢油再污染溪水。
en: When I was little, I could still swim in this stream. It is a pity that the pollution is serious now. This year the villagers set up a waste oil collection point upstream to prevent oil from polluting the stream again.

zh: 以前我對政治沒興趣，直到一位政治人物到學校跟我們談公車票價。班上做了一次民意調查，才發現政治立場不同的人也會支持同一項方案。
en: I used to have no interest in politics, until a politician came to our school to talk about bus fares. Our class did a poll and found that people with different political views could support the same plan.

zh: 教我們做陶器的教授帶來了一隻瓷碗，薄得對著光就能看見手指的影子。他讓我們各做一隻厚碗，親自體驗泥土變成陶器的過程。
en: The professor who taught us pottery brought a porcelain bowl so thin that you could see the shadow of your finger through it in the light. He let each of us make a thick bowl so we could experience the process of clay becoming pottery ourselves.

zh: 為了幫助生活在貧窮中的家庭，我們在市場推銷自己種的米。扣掉成本後，我們把一部分利潤捐給了社區廚房。
en: To help families living in poverty, we promoted the rice we grew at the market. After taking out the costs, we gave part of the profit to the community kitchen.

zh: 這位茶葉生產者把茶葉磨成粉，做成了一項新產品。我問他茶香從哪裡來，他說裡面只有純茶葉，沒有加香料。
en: This tea producer ground tea leaves into powder to make a new product. I asked him where the tea smell came from, and he said it was only pure tea leaves with no added flavors.

zh: 消防員說，上一次火災最可能的原因是電線過熱。在消防演習的準備過程中，我們學了該如何通報走廊出現煙霧。演習當天，老師請我們假裝聞到了煙味。
en: The firefighter said the probable cause of the previous fire was an overheated wire. During the preparation for the fire drill, we learned how to report smoke in the hallway. On the day of the drill, the teacher asked us to pretend we smelled smoke.

zh: 有人在叔叔的酒吧裡打了一架，一拳打壞了吧檯上的老啤酒幫浦。為了讓店裡的財產多一層保障，叔叔決定買保險。
en: Someone got into a fight in my uncle's pub, and a punch broke the old beer pump on the bar. To give the shop's property more protection, my uncle decided to buy insurance.

zh: 校刊引用了教練的一句話，但標題讀起來很古怪，好像他要辭職了。我問了他才知道，他說的是他要戒掉喝汽水的習慣。
en: The school magazine quoted a line from the coach, but the headline read queerly, as if he was going to quit his job. When I asked him, I learned that he meant he was going to quit drinking soda.

zh: 看台上有人喊出種族歧視的話，我不知道隊友會怎麼反應。他立刻去告訴裁判。我問他為什麼反應這麼快，他的答覆是：「因為上次沒有人站出來。」
en: Someone in the stands shouted something racist, and I did not know how my teammate would react. He went to tell the referee right away. When I asked him why his reaction was so quick, his response was, "Because last time nobody stood up."

zh: 擦工具是祖父每天的例行工作，他總留一塊抹布在抽屜裡。今天我幫他擦老剃刀，發現刀柄上已經長了鐵鏽。
en: Wiping his tools is part of Grandpa's daily routine, and he always keeps a rag in the drawer. Today I helped him clean his old razor and found rust on the handle.

zh: 教練按過去五場比賽的接棒成功率替各組排名。排名第一的那組將代表學校參加地區接力賽。
en: The coach ranked each group by its success rate in passing the baton over the last five races. The group ranked first will represent our school in the regional relay.

zh: 姐姐把生雞肉放進烤箱，準備烤給大家吃。我在旁邊整理水果，挑出一顆爛掉的梨子，再把成熟的梨子放進冰箱，免得它們也開始腐爛。
en: My sister put the raw chicken in the oven to roast it for everyone. Next to her, I sorted the fruit, picked out a rotten pear, and put the ripe pears in the fridge so they would not start to rot too.

zh: 一束陽光穿過窗戶，在桌上照出一個長方形。那片光裡有個繫著紅緞帶的紙盒，裝的全是爸爸以前寫給媽媽的信。媽媽說這是她收過最浪漫的禮物。
en: A ray of sunlight came through the window and made a rectangle on the table. In that light was a paper box tied with a red ribbon, full of letters Dad wrote to Mom long ago. Mom said it was the most romantic gift she had ever received.

zh: 店員拿起電話聽筒時，我手裡正拿著那束花的收據。我說花送錯了樓層，請她派人來取。她說我的請求很合理，立刻聯絡了外送員。
en: When the clerk picked up the receiver, I was holding the receipt for the flowers. I said the flowers had been sent to the wrong floor and asked her to send someone to pick them up. She said my request was reasonable and contacted the delivery person right away.

zh: 外公年輕時曾在一場宗教慶典上用錄音機錄下自己的歌聲。今年廟方發行了那段錄音，我一聽就認出了他的聲音。
en: When Grandpa was young, he recorded his own singing on a tape recorder at a religious festival. This year the temple released the recording, and I recognized his voice as soon as I heard it.

zh: 爸爸每天晚上都提醒我把手機留在客廳，好減少睡前看螢幕的時間。不用再急著回訊息，我鬆了一口氣，終於可以在睡前放鬆了。
en: Dad reminds me every night to leave my phone in the living room to reduce my screen time before bed. Not having to rush to answer messages was a relief, and I could finally relax before sleep.

zh: 體育館裡傳出一聲吼叫，接著就有猛獸逃跑的謠言。我後悔自己沒問清楚就衝去找老師，原來是戲劇社在排練。
en: A roar came from the gym, and then there was a rumor that a wild animal had escaped. I regret that I rushed to find the teacher without asking first. It was just the drama club rehearsing.

zh: 住在偏遠山村的奶奶得依靠每週來一次的送貨車。自從店主用一輛更可靠的新車取代舊車，她再也沒等過一整天。
en: Grandma, who lives in a remote mountain village, has to rely on a delivery truck that comes once a week. Since the owner replaced the old truck with a more reliable new one, she has never had to wait a whole day again.

zh: 山屋裡只剩兩桶水，管理員決定保留一桶給隔天要上山的人。水是這裡最珍貴的資源，如果再不下雨，管理員明天就會限制大家的用水量。
en: There were only two barrels of water left in the mountain hut, and the manager decided to reserve one for the people coming up the next day. Water is the most precious resource here. If it does not rain soon, the manager will restrict everyone's water use tomorrow.

zh: 在班上演的戲裡，我們成立了一個共和國，旗子上的火箭象徵探索的精神。演議員的同學用舊床單做長袍，演太空人的同學用雨衣做太空衣。
en: In our class play, we formed a republic, and the rocket on our flag represented the spirit of exploration. The classmate who played a representative made a robe from an old sheet, and the one who played an astronaut made a space suit from a raincoat.

zh: 超商發生搶劫案時，店員克制住追出去的衝動，記下了搶劫超商的男子長什麼樣子。他說自己有責任告訴警察實情，卻沒向記者透露證人的姓名。
en: When the convenience store was robbed, the clerk resisted the urge to chase the man and remembered what the robber looked like. He said it was his responsibility to tell the police the truth, but he did not reveal the witness's name to the reporters.

zh: 那張小地毯的背面原本很粗糙，用了大約三年後卻磨平了。為了消除滑倒的風險，我們在地毯下加了一塊防滑墊。
en: The back of the small rug was rough at first, but after roughly three years it wore smooth. To get rid of the risk of slipping, we put a non-slip pad under the rug.

zh: 我把一袋米抬上磅秤時，袋底裂開，米粒撒了一地。這裡的糧食本來就不足，大家趕緊用乾淨的盆子接住袋裡剩下的米。
en: When I lifted a sack of rice onto the scale, the bottom split open, and the rice scattered all over the floor. Food is already scarce here, so everyone quickly caught the rest of the rice in clean basins.

zh: 為了全家人，媽媽每月都從薪水裡撥一筆錢存起來。今年修屋頂的成果讓她很滿意，而且付完工錢後還剩下一些積蓄。
en: For the sake of the family, Mom saves part of her salary every month. She is satisfied with this year's roof repair, and she still had some savings left after paying the workers.

zh: 我在店裡喝茶時，店主端來一小碟切好的香腸讓我試吃。我沾了一點醬汁，辣得趕緊喝了一小口水，他就替我換了不辣的醬汁。
en: While I was having tea in the shop, the owner brought a small saucer of sliced sausage for me to try. I dipped it in a little sauce and it was so spicy that I quickly took a sip of water, so he gave me a sauce that was not spicy.

zh: 我拿起剪刀剪開包裝，裡面是姐姐送的絲綢圍巾。她叮嚀我用冷水洗，因為她去年用熱水洗自己的那條，結果圍巾縮水了。
en: I cut open the package with scissors, and inside was a silk scarf from my sister. She told me to wash it in cold water because last year she washed hers in hot water, and the scarf shrank.

zh: 童軍夜間尋寶時，牆上突然出現一個嚇人的影子，隊伍後面有人尖叫起來。我們把手電筒往下一照，才發現那是一隻正要跳上圍牆的貓。
en: During the scouts' night treasure hunt, a scary shadow suddenly appeared on the wall, and someone at the back of the line screamed. When we pointed our flashlights down, we saw it was a cat about to jump onto the wall.

zh: 這學期，一位大學四年級的學長得到了研究地方歷史的獎學金。他寫信向那位陪他讀老報紙的學者道謝，還把研究報告寄給了她。
en: This semester, a senior student won a scholarship to study local history. He wrote to thank the scholar who read old newspapers with him and sent her his research report.

zh: 一位科學家帶我們到溪邊，用科學方法比較兩種蝦子的花紋。我們在淺水區畫下每隻蝦子的模樣，再比對圖畫，找出花紋的相似之處。
en: A scientist took us to a stream and compared the patterns of two kinds of shrimp in a scientific way. We drew every shrimp in the shallow water and then compared the drawings to find the similarities in their patterns.

zh: 我用力擦洗廚房的水槽，直到金屬表面變得亮晶晶的。爸爸把新的置物架裝在水槽旁，最後還特地檢查每一根螺絲釘。
en: I scrubbed the kitchen sink hard until the metal was shiny. Dad put the new shelf up beside the sink and finally checked every screw.

zh: 為了展品的安全，館員把盒子密封後才放進櫃子裡。他發出關門的信號後不久，我們就聽見最後一道門鎖上的聲音。
en: For the security of the objects, the staff member sealed the box before putting it in the cabinet. Shortly after he gave the signal to close up, we heard the last door lock.

zh: 兩群羊分開了一個冬天，今天牧羊人終於帶牠們回到同一片草地。看到兩隻小羊又靠在一起，他鬆了一口氣，說今後讓牠們待在一起才明智。
en: The two flocks of sheep had been apart for a whole winter, and today the shepherd finally brought them back to the same field. Seeing two lambs leaning against each other again, he sighed with relief and said it would be sensible to keep them together from now on.

zh: 課堂上討論性騷擾時，老師請我們想想一位模特兒的處境。攝影師要她擺出性感的姿勢，她拒絕了。對她而言，這是重要的一步，因為她第一次在工作時說出了自己的界線。
en: When we discussed sexual harassment in class, the teacher asked us to think about a model's situation. A photographer asked her to strike a sexy pose, but she refused. For her, it was a significant step because it was the first time she stated her limits at work.

zh: 妹妹用鏟子在沙灘上挖水道，我們發現把水道縮短，海水就更容易流到沙堡旁邊。回家時她連頭髮裡都是沙，只好用我的洗髮精洗頭。
en: My sister dug a channel in the sand with a shovel, and we found that if we shortened the channel, seawater reached the sandcastle more easily. When we went home, she even had sand in her hair, so she had to wash it with my shampoo.

zh: 外婆從小就教我，在她的信仰裡，說謊是一種罪。今天我承認是我打破了她最喜歡的杯子，也向她道歉。外婆握著我的手說，她知道我的道歉是真誠的。
en: Since I was little, Grandma has taught me that in her faith, lying is a sin. Today I admitted that I broke her favorite cup and said sorry. Grandma held my hand and said she knew my apology was sincere.

zh: 我已經會溜冰，所以學滑雪時想跳過第一堂課。那位技術熟練的教練請我示範怎麼停下來，我才明白自己還需要那堂課。
en: I can already skate, so I wanted to skip the first lesson when I learned to ski. The skillful coach asked me to show how to stop, and then I realized I still needed that lesson.

zh: 演王子的男孩很瘦，戲服的袖子蓋住了他纖細的手腕。開演前，服裝老師在每邊袖口各縫了三針，把袖子改短。
en: The boy playing the prince was skinny, and the sleeves of his costume covered his slender wrists. Before the show, the costume teacher sewed three stitches in each cuff to shorten the sleeves.

zh: 港邊立著一座雕像，紀念曾在這裡被賣為奴隸的人。讀完其中一人寫給家人的信，我才明白雕刻家為什麼讓雕像的臉上帶著悲傷。
en: There is a statue by the harbor in memory of the people who were once sold here as slaves. After reading a letter one of them wrote to his family, I understood why the artist gave the statue a sad face.

zh: 媽媽教我把蘑菇切片，和菠菜一起放進鍋裡。我一邊攪拌醬汁一邊加香料，最後才放進煮好的義大利細麵。
