en: Mom taught me to slice mushrooms and put them in the pot with spinach. I stirred the sauce while adding spices, and at the end I put in the cooked spaghetti.

zh: 雨後的斜坡比我記得的更滑。等我們爬完最陡的那一段，汗水已經浸透了衣領。
en: After the rain, the slope was more slippery than I remembered. By the time we finished climbing the steepest part, sweat had soaked my collar.

zh: 舊腳架有一條腿突然折斷，相機險些落地。新腳架的底座很堅固，即使地面不平也很穩定，我終於能拍出平穩的畫面。
en: One leg of the old tripod suddenly snapped, and the camera almost hit the ground. The base of the new tripod is solid and stays stable even on uneven ground, so I can finally take steady pictures.

zh: 我希望將來有一天能有自己的畫室。不知怎麼的，一位路過的女士認出了我的畫，還約我下週找個時間去看她要出租的工作室。
en: I hope to have my own studio someday. Somehow, a lady passing by recognized my paintings and invited me to see a studio she wants to rent out sometime next week.

zh: 弟弟堅持用某一支特定的吸管試喝果汁。他才透過吸管吸了一小口，就把果汁吐回杯裡，說自己胃痛。
en: My brother insisted on trying the juice with one specific straw. He had only sucked a little through the straw when he spit the juice back into the cup and said he had a stomachache.

zh: 我不小心把水桶裡的水灑出來，水濺到弟弟的短褲上。他拿起噴水用的瓶子，對準我的腳，握緊把手一噴，算是回敬我。
en: I spilled some water from the bucket by accident, and it splashed on my brother's shorts. He picked up a spray bottle, aimed at my feet, and squeezed the handle to spray me back.

zh: 我想把矮凳轉過來修理，才發現一隻腳被黏黏的膠黏在地板上。我用一把硬刷子把膠刷掉，現在連弟弟都能單手把凳子轉得飛快。
en: I wanted to turn the stool over to fix it, and then I found that one leg was stuck to the floor with sticky glue. I brushed the glue off with a stiff brush, and now even my little brother can spin the stool fast with one hand.

zh: 錢不見後，哥哥懷疑我偷了錢，還開始暗中監視我。我發誓沒拿，他卻說媽媽太寵我。我能理解他的猜疑，但他出於惡意撕掉我的畫，還是讓我很難過。
en: After the money went missing, my brother suspected that I stole it and started to spy on me. I swore I did not take it, but he said Mom spoils me. I can understand his suspicion, but it still hurt when he tore up my drawing out of spite.

zh: 弟弟盯著湖邊的天鵝，擔心牠會餓死，便拿出已經不新鮮的麵包。爸爸叫他把麵包收好時，一隻松鼠正爬上我們的野餐桌。
en: My brother stared at the swan by the lake, worried it would starve, so he took out some stale bread. When Dad told him to put the bread away, a squirrel was climbing onto our picnic table.

zh: 傍晚風雨交加，體育場外還有一群孩子在等簽名。工作人員反應迅速，在孩子們淋濕前把他們帶進室內。
en: The evening was stormy, and a group of children were still waiting outside the stadium for autographs. The staff reacted quickly and took the children inside before they got wet.

zh: 停電後，外婆用瓦斯爐和竹籠蒸地瓜。她先確認鍋裡有足夠的水，再坐下來跟我們聊天。
en: After the power went out, Grandma steamed sweet potatoes in a bamboo basket on the gas stove. She made sure there was sufficient water in the pot and then sat down to chat with us.

zh: 我們到達山頂時，雲霧正圍繞著附近的山峰。姊姊一打開便當就被蜜蜂螫了，手背很快腫起來。
en: When we reached the summit, clouds were surrounding the nearby peaks. As soon as my sister opened her lunch box, a bee stung her, and the back of her hand soon swelled up.

zh: 剛進擊劍社時，我以為光靠力氣就能把劍用好。教練要我改變策略，可是我太固執，連輸了三場才肯換個打法。
en: When I first joined the fencing club, I thought strength alone was enough to use a sword well. The coach asked me to change my strategy, but I was so stubborn that I lost three matches before I was willing to try a different way.

zh: 我們把紙撕成長條，再將捲緊的廢紙塞進模型橋的橋墩。老師請我們說明橋的結構，也問黏合紙張的透明物質是什麼。
en: We tore paper into strips and stuffed tightly rolled waste paper into the base of our model bridge. The teacher asked us to explain the bridge's structure and also asked what the clear substance holding the paper together was.

zh: 結帳前，我得算出所有收據金額的總和，再減去租攤的費用。這是我第一次獨自做帳，我的直屬上司在一旁等我報出數字。
en: Before closing the accounts, I had to find the sum of all the receipts and subtract the cost of renting the stand. It was my first time doing the accounts alone, and my direct supervisor was waiting for me to report the number.

zh: 住在郊區的阿姨是地震生還者，她參加了一項災後生活調查。讀了調查摘要，我才知道有些居民多年來深受失眠之苦，也有人曾向社工說出自殺的念頭。
en: My aunt, who lives in the suburbs, is an earthquake survivor, and she took part in a survey about life after the disaster. After reading the summary of the survey, I learned that some residents have suffered from sleeplessness for years, and some have told social workers about thoughts of suicide.

zh: 那位裁縫師用平板電腦記錄客人的尺寸，再替每件外套掛上標籤。我幫他穿針時，不小心刺到了拇指。
en: The tailor records his customers' sizes on a tablet and puts a tag on every jacket. When I helped him thread a needle, I pricked my thumb by accident.

zh: 我十幾歲的弟弟很健談，也有模仿老師的天分。以前同學取笑他的聲音時，他總會發脾氣，如今他敢自己站上台說笑話了。
en: My teenage brother is talkative and has a talent for copying teachers. He used to lose his temper when classmates teased him about his voice, but now he dares to go on stage alone and tell jokes.

zh: 我幫舅舅照料一隻已經馴服的小羊。我們輕聲溫柔地喚牠，牠就會走過來。別隻羊走進牠的地盤時，牠卻會低下頭把對方頂出去。
en: I help my uncle look after a tame little goat. When we call it softly and tenderly, it comes over. But when another goat walks into its territory, it lowers its head and pushes the other one out.

zh: 休息時間，爸爸端來一盤橘子。冰水解了我的渴，比賽後吃到的第一片橘子也特別美味。
en: During the break, Dad brought a tray of tangerines. The ice water ended my thirst, and the first tangerine after the game tasted especially good.

zh: 浴缸已經滿了，水龍頭卻還在滴水。爸爸叫我去關儲水槽旁的閥門，我雙手握住把手，用力扭轉了半圈。
en: The tub was already full, but the tap was still dripping. Dad told me to turn off the valve beside the water tank, so I held the handle with both hands and twisted it half a turn.

zh: 姊姊吹小喇叭的技巧比去年更好了。聽完那段美妙的曲調，我問她是怎麼練的，她便用我聽得懂的話解釋了幾個技術上的細節。
en: My sister's technique on the trumpet is better than last year. After listening to that terrific tune, I asked her how she practiced, and she explained a few technical details in words I could understand.

zh: 強風吹得臨時帳篷搖搖晃晃，鬆動的柱子威脅著裡面的人。一位攤商察覺了危險，及時帶我們出去，我很感激她。
en: The strong wind made the temporary tent shake, and the loose poles threatened the people inside. A trader noticed the danger and led us out in time. I am thankful to her.

zh: 海邊那根樹幹每天早上都在不同的地方。哥哥提出一個理論，說是潮汐帶著它移動。我們決定連續三天在地圖上追蹤它的路線。
en: The tree trunk on the beach is in a different place every morning. My brother had a theory that the tide moves it. We decided to trace its path on a map for three days in a row.

zh: 拔河用的繩子必須夠堅韌，才能承受十二個人同時用力拉。我正要把鞋帶拉得更緊一點，隊友提醒我，綁得太緊會讓腳痛。
en: The rope for the tug-of-war must be tough enough to hold twelve people pulling at the same time. I was about to tighten my shoelaces, but my teammate reminded me that tying them too tight would hurt my feet.

zh: 曾祖父是位商人，曾從這個碼頭把木材運送到南方。他的帳本裡還記著另一批貨，那是一噸曬乾的菸葉。
en: My great-grandfather was a trader who once transported timber south from this dock. His account book also recorded another load: a ton of dried tobacco leaves.

zh: 老師拋硬幣決定誰先挑隊友。一個孩子等硬幣落地才喊正面，讓老師碰上了棘手的問題。幸好有位同學看清楚了經過，向老師如實說明。
en: The teacher tossed a coin to decide who would choose teammates first. A child did not call heads until the coin landed, which gave the teacher a tricky problem. Luckily, a classmate saw clearly what happened and gave the teacher a truthful account.

zh: 觀光業帶來了許多工作，也讓這個部落的小路變得擁擠。我當導覽員的阿姨會帶觀光客爬上舊水塔，從高處看看部落的孩子每天要走多遠才能到學校。
en: Tourism has brought many jobs, but it has also made the paths of this tribe crowded. My aunt, a tour guide, takes tourists up the old water tower so they can see from above how far the tribe's children walk to school every day.

zh: 遊覽車剛開出隧道就壞了，旅客只好下車等待。救援車把它拖走時，一條鬆脫的電線拖在車尾，我趕快叫司機停下。
en: The tour bus broke down just after it came out of the tunnel, so the travelers had to get off and wait. When the tow truck pulled it away, a loose wire was dragging behind the bus, so I quickly told the driver to stop.

zh: 那對雙胞胎想研究熱帶城市的雨量變化。他們的家教請兩人各挑一座城市，再比較兩地近十年的趨勢。
en: The twins want to study changes in rainfall in tropical cities. Their tutor asked each of them to choose a city and then compare the trends in the two places over the last ten years.

words.zh: 雙胞胎中一人、一對非常相像的人(或物)中的一個

zh: 戲劇社要演一群士兵在山上過冬的故事，我們用回收木材搭了小屋。弟弟有一套理論，認為把門做得窄一點，台上的小屋看起來就會比較高。
en: The drama club was going to perform a story about a troop of soldiers spending the winter on a mountain, so we built a hut with recycled timber. My brother had a theory that if the door was narrower, the hut would look taller on stage.

zh: 我們訪問了市區公車司機，才明白誤點背後有個問題：司機人數太少。工會把不同路線的司機團結起來，一起爭取合理的班表。
en: After we interviewed city bus drivers, we understood the underlying problem behind the delays: there are too few drivers. The union united drivers from different routes to fight together for reasonable schedules.

zh: 姊姊替每個旅行收納袋設計了獨特的花紋。裝內衣的袋子上是藍色的魚，其他袋子也用同一種藍色，讓整套設計有了整體感。
en: My sister designed a unique pattern for each travel bag. The bag for underwear has blue fish on it, and the other bags use the same blue, which gives the whole set a sense of unity.

zh: 派出所門前原本空著的車位，現在停了一輛廂型車。霧越來越濃，其他車輛的輪廓都消失了，我還能看見那輛車的尾燈。
en: The parking space in front of the police station that used to be vacant now has a van in it. The fog got thicker and the shapes of other vehicles vanished, but I could still see that van's taillights.

zh: 桌上放著各式各樣的工具，老師卻讓我們先用雙手捏一只花瓶。大家做的花瓶在高度和顏色上各有差異，這份多樣性讓展覽格外有趣。
en: There were various tools on the table, but the teacher asked us to shape a vase with our hands first. Everyone's vases varied in height and color, and this variety made the exhibition especially interesting.

zh: 我原本想借詩集的第二冊，回家才發現拿了第一冊。其中一首詩的最後一節把雨後的紫羅蘭寫得好鮮明，還讓我學到了幾個新詞。
en: I wanted to borrow the second volume of the poetry book, but when I got home I found I had taken the first. The last verse of one poem described violets after the rain so vividly, and it also taught me some new vocabulary.

zh: 弟弟的視力不好，天一暗就很難認出排球隊友。教練讓兩隊穿上不同顏色的背心，亮黃色的背心隔著半座球場都清晰可見。
en: My brother's vision is poor, and it is hard for him to recognize his volleyball teammates when it gets dark. The coach had the two teams wear vests of different colors, and the bright yellow vests were visible from half a court away.

zh: 一名選民離開投票所時，成了暴力行為的受害者。班會上，我們讀到他事前收到的暴力威脅，也討論了意見不同的人該怎麼和平表達立場。
en: A voter became the victim of violence as he left the voting place. At our class meeting, we read about the violent threats he had received before, and we discussed how people with different opinions can express their views peacefully.

zh: 排球比賽那天，爸爸幫我準備了一份色彩繽紛的便當。他放進各種蔬果，好讓我能吃到不同的維生素。
en: On the day of the volleyball game, Dad packed me a colorful lunch box. He put in a variety of fruits and vegetables so I could get different vitamins.

zh: 電影裡的女孩把第一週的工資都留給妹妹，自己決定嫁給一個富裕的商人。看到兩姊妹在車站哭著道別，外婆說她年輕時看過這部電影。
en: The girl in the movie left all her first week's wages to her sister and decided to wed a wealthy merchant. Seeing the two sisters weeping as they said goodbye at the station, Grandma said she had seen this movie when she was young.

zh: 故事裡那名邪惡的守衛拿起鞭子，正要抽打拉貨的馬。妹妹演的車伕搶走他的武器，跳上運貨馬車，趕在城門關閉前逃走了。
en: In the story, the wicked guard picked up a whip and was about to hit the horse pulling the goods. The driver, played by my sister, grabbed his weapon, jumped onto the wagon, and escaped before the city gate closed.

zh: 我和阿公每週都約好沿著山路閒逛到瀑布旁。回程時他總把外套披在我身上，我到現在都記得那份溫暖。
en: Grandpa and I had a weekly plan to wander along the mountain path to the waterfall. On the way back, he always put his jacket over my shoulders, and I still remember that warmth.

zh: 工程師在河邊的步道加寬前檢查了堤岸，發現連日大雨已經讓堤岸變得脆弱。他們在工地入口立了牌子，警告行人遠離鬆動的土坡。
en: Before the path by the river was widened, the engineers checked the bank and found that days of heavy rain had weakened it. They put up a sign at the entrance of the site to warn people walking by to stay away from the loose slope.

zh: 木手環做好後，我先用布擦去木屑，再替它上蠟。我本想用彩紙把它包起來，妹妹卻等不及，直接戴到了手腕上。
en: After the wooden bracelet was finished, I wiped off the wood dust with a cloth and then waxed it. I wanted to wrap it in colored paper, but my sister could not wait and put it on her wrist right away.

zh: 我在小麥田邊拔草時，發現了一張沾著露水的蜘蛛網。蜘蛛還在兩根麥稈間織網，我便留下那片草，繞到另一端繼續工作。
en: While I was pulling weeds by the wheat field, I found a spider web covered in dew. The spider was still weaving its web between two stalks, so I left that patch of grass and went to work at the other end.

zh: 阿公走到看不清楚的彎道前，會先吹口哨警告迎面來的人。他說這麼做的智慧，是他在山上送了四十年信才學來的。
en: Before Grandpa reaches a bend where he cannot see clearly, he blows a whistle to warn people coming the other way. He says he learned the wisdom of doing this after forty years of delivering mail in the mountains.

zh: 今年，社區的年輕人首度能參加一年一度蛋糕展上的比賽。我一緊張就把蛋黃倒進蛋白裡，弟弟從台下大喊，叫我換個碗重來。
en: This year, youngsters in the community could join the contest at the yearly cake show for the first time. I got nervous and poured a yolk into the egg whites, and my brother yelled from the audience that I should use another bowl and start again.

zh: 營區裡有一塊專供孩子觀察昆蟲的區域，就在我們的帳篷旁。回來時記得拉上帳門的拉鍊，免得昆蟲也跟著進來過夜。
en: At the camp there is a zone just for children to watch insects, right next to our tent. Remember to close the zipper on the tent door when you come back so the insects don't come in and spend the night too.

zh: 那篇學術論文的開頭太抽象，連作者的同學都看不懂。雖然他一度想放棄，最後還是拿家鄉的老橋當例子。他最有成就感的，是終於把自己的想法說清楚了。
en: The opening of that academic paper was so abstract that even the author's classmates could not understand it. Although he once wanted to abandon it, in the end he used an old bridge in his hometown as an example. His greatest sense of accomplishment came from finally making his ideas clear.

zh: 老師問這塊布能吸收多少水，以及它能不能給底下的木桌足夠的保護。她提醒我們，一次清水實驗無法提供絕對的保證，尤其下一次要用的是酸。
en: The teacher asked how much water this cloth could absorb and whether it could give adequate protection to the wooden table below. She reminded us that one test with clean water could not give absolute assurance, especially since we would use acid next time.

zh: 剛搬到臺南時，我擔心自己的口音會被取笑。班上輕鬆的氣氛和同學對我的接納，讓我很快就適應了新學校。
en: When I first moved to Tainan, I was worried that people would laugh at my accent. The relaxed atmosphere in class and my classmates' acceptance helped me adapt to my new school quickly.

zh: 在指控任何人之前，會計師先查核了金額的正確性。她調閱舊檔案後才發現，那一頁是掃描時無意間漏掉的。
en: Before accusing anyone, the accountant checked the accuracy of the amounts. After looking at the old files, she found that the page had been accidentally left out when it was scanned.

zh: 爸爸陪一位認識多年的熟人去看老藥局特展。他們最想知道的是，館方如何取得那張照片，以及櫃子裡那瓶阿斯匹靈為什麼會出現在照片中。
en: Dad accompanied an acquaintance he had known for years to an exhibition about an old pharmacy. What they wanted to know most was how the museum acquired that photo and why a bottle of aspirin in the cabinet appeared in it.

zh: 哥哥自稱電玩成癮者，每個月第一週就把零用錢花光。等他調整預算，才發現自己還能去圖書館參加週五的免費桌遊之夜，多了一個選擇。
en: My brother calls himself a video game addict and spends all his allowance in the first week of every month. After he adjusted his budget, he found that he could also go to the library's free board game night on Fridays, which gave him another alternative.

zh: 那名好鬥的對手步步逼近時，隊長仍然保持警覺，在衝突爆發前把兩邊的球員帶開。她願意站出來的勇氣值得讚揚，也贏得了新隊員的欽佩。
en: When the aggressive opponent came closer and closer, the captain stayed alert and led the players on both sides apart before a fight broke out. Her courage to step forward was admirable, and it won the admiration of the new players.

zh: 學生會提議把週三的入場費減半，館長也願意試試這個做法。董事會正式批准後，館方就採納這項建議，學生會也把消息公布在校網上。
en: The student council proposed cutting the Wednesday admission fee in half, and the director was willing to try it. After the board gave its formal approval, the museum adopted the idea, and the student council posted the news on the school website.

zh: 旅行社派來的訂房專員讀完訂房信，才發現日期寫得含糊不清。他向已經抵達旅館的一家人致上歉意，隨即替他們找到當晚的空房。
en: After reading the booking letter, the agent sent by the travel agency found that the dates were ambiguous. He made an apology to the family who had already arrived at the hotel and found them an empty room for the night right away.

zh: 社團把兩瓶發酵果汁送去分析，想知道各自含有多少酒精。等同學分析完兩張圖表後，兩瓶之間的差異就很明顯了。
en: The club sent two bottles of fermented juice for analysis to find out how much alcohol each one contained. After the students analyzed the two charts, the difference between the bottles was apparent.

zh: 這位雄心勃勃的業餘演員打算用一人短劇逗樂整條街的孩子。由於前一天試音時喇叭惹惱了鄰居，他把正式演出搬到有隔音設備的活動中心。
en: This ambitious amateur actor planned to amuse the children on the whole street with a one-man show. Because the speakers annoyed the neighbors during a sound test the day before, he moved the real show to a community center with soundproofing.

zh: 我們家每年都辦一場聚餐，今年正好遇上老屋落成一百週年的紀念日。姑姑說，她一聞到廚房飄來的米香，就會把這間屋子和當年親手蓋它的祖先聯想在一起。
en: My family has an annual dinner, and this year it fell on the hundredth anniversary of our old house. My aunt said whenever she smells rice from the kitchen, she associates the house with the ancestors who built it with their own hands.

zh: 送出申請後，這位申請人一直在等博物館的回信。直到館方確認她與館長面談的預約排在下週一，她心裡的焦慮才慢慢消退。
en: After sending her application, the applicant kept waiting for the museum to reply. Her anxiety did not fade until the museum confirmed that her appointment with the director was next Monday.

zh: 籌備學生畫展時，我們先討論了有哪些藝術層面會受到燈光影響。等到色溫調整到適當的程度，我才更能欣賞畫家筆下那片灰藍色的大海。
en: While preparing the student art show, we first discussed which artistic aspects would be affected by the lighting. When the color of the light was adjusted to an appropriate level, I could better appreciate the gray-blue sea in the painting.

zh: 水族館最吸引遊客的地方，是一道由人工珊瑚圍成的拱門。我們正要走過去，人群中突然起了一陣歡呼聲，原來一隻小海龜剛游過拱門。
en: The aquarium's biggest attraction is an arch made of artificial coral. We were about to walk through it when cheers arose from the crowd. A little sea turtle had just swum through the arch.

zh: 我原先向同學保證展出的那些武器是真品，後來才知道，只有館長有權認定它們的真偽。我對自己隨口下結論感到羞愧，便回班上更正。
en: I had assured my classmates that the arms on display were authentic, but later I learned that only the museum director had the authority to decide whether they were real. I was ashamed of my careless conclusion, so I went back to class to correct it.

zh: 全校集會前，老師請負責引導的學生到側門集合，再把各班的工作分派下去。老師說，需要協助的人只要舉手，就會有人帶他到座位。
en: Before the school assembly, the teacher asked the student helpers to gather at the side door and then gave each class its assignment. She said anyone who needed assistance only had to raise a hand, and someone would take them to their seat.

zh: 地方體育協會答應出借運動器材，但教練還想得到一項保證。直到會長親自向他保證新跑道會在比賽前完工，他才替孩子們報名。
en: The local sports association agreed to lend us equipment, but the coach wanted one more assurance. Only after the head of the association personally assured him that the new track would be finished before the game did he sign the children up.

zh: 我們把語音說明的播放器固定在模型旁的架子上，讓看不清楚標籤的人也能聽懂。錄音先解釋什麼是原子，再介紹模型所呈現的原子結構。
en: We attached the audio player to the stand beside the model so that people who could not read the labels clearly could still understand. The recording first explains what an atom is and then describes the atomic structure that the model shows.

zh: 我買了一本舊自傳，翻開後才發現作者的親筆簽名。原書主還把簽書會當天的入場券貼在簽名旁邊。
en: I bought an old autobiography and found the author's autograph when I opened it. The previous owner had even stuck the admission ticket from the book signing next to the autograph.

zh: 讀到那位芭蕾舞者的傳記時，我才知道照片裡那位禿頭男子是他的老師。在舞者第一次演出前，這位老師曾蹲下來替他包紮磨破的腳。
en: When I read the biography of that ballet dancer, I learned that the bald man in the photo was his teacher. Before the dancer's first performance, this teacher had knelt down to put a bandage on his blistered foot.

zh: 阿姨的店破產以後，她一度身無分文，只好把銀手鐲賣掉。多年後她在老街又看到那只手鐲，這回她連價都沒討，就把它買回來了。
en: After my aunt's shop went bankrupt, she was broke for a while and had to sell her silver bracelet. Years later she saw the bracelet again on the old street, and this time she bought it back without even trying to bargain.

zh: 鎮公所的公告說，上游流域連夜下雨，河邊已架起路障。巡守員去換警示燈的電池時，發現夜釣的人都已經上岸了。
en: The town office's bulletin said that it had rained all night in the upper river basin, and barriers had been put up along the river. When the guard went to change the batteries in the warning lights, he found that the night fishermen had already come ashore.

zh: 排戲時，扮演夜賊的學生把借來的外套披在扮乞丐的同學身上。雖然導演原先要求夜賊舉止殘暴，這個溫柔的舉動卻打動了她，她決定保留這一幕。
en: During rehearsal, the student playing a burglar put a borrowed coat over the classmate playing a beggar. Although the director had asked for brutal behavior from the burglar, this gentle act moved her, and she decided to keep the scene.

zh: 爸爸從貯藏箱拿出一組新的果汁機刀片，換好後才把香蕉和牛奶攪打在一起。我拿掃帚掃掉拆包裝時落在地上的碎塑膠，等他把第一杯香蕉牛奶倒給我。
en: Dad took a new set of blades out of the storage bin, and after changing them, he blended the bananas and milk together. I swept up the plastic pieces from the packaging with a broom while I waited for him to pour me the first glass of banana milk.

zh: 生物學老師帶我們到山上觀察一種罕見品種的綿羊。雖然牧場裡的野花還沒開，入口那棵桃樹的枝頭卻已經開滿粉紅色的花。
en: Our biology teacher took us up the mountain to observe a rare breed of sheep. Although the wildflowers in the field had not bloomed yet, the peach tree at the entrance was already full of pink blossoms.

zh: 新郎讀到弟弟寫的祝福時，眨了幾下眼睛才把最後一句念完。雖然兄弟倆多年來住在不同城市，他們之間的感情一直很深。
en: When the groom read his brother's blessing, he had to blink a few times before he could finish the last line. Although the two brothers had lived in different cities for years, the bond between them was still strong.

zh: 哥哥誇口說，他能把球往地上一砸，讓它彈過工具房的屋頂。結果球沒飛過屋頂，卻撞上裝在屋頂上的小風車葉片，落回他的腳邊。
en: My brother boasted that he could slam the ball on the ground and make it bounce over the roof of the tool shed. Instead of flying over the roof, the ball hit a blade of the small windmill on top and fell back at his feet.

zh: 我從櫥櫃拿出裝餅乾的容器，照標籤計算自己剛吃了多少卡路里。妹妹看了一眼就發現，我的計算只算了一份，漏掉了我吃的第二份。
en: I took the cookie container out of the cabinet and used the label to calculate how many calories I had just eaten. My sister glanced at it and saw that my calculation only counted one serving, not the second one I ate.

zh: 里長候選人在競選活動中公布了改善社區照明的計畫。他請居民在公開信下方留言評論，並指出自己家附近有哪些路燈需要維修。
en: During his campaign, the candidate for neighborhood chief announced a plan to improve the community's lighting. He asked residents to comment below his open letter and point out which streetlights near their homes needed repair.

zh: 外公把我們撿回來的粗糙木頭磨平，在上面雕了一隻小鳥。直到現在，他出門仍帶著這根手杖，因為他珍愛我們一起做它的那段時光。
en: Grandpa sanded smooth the coarse piece of wood we had picked up and carved a little bird on it. He still takes this cane with him when he goes out, because he cherishes the time we spent making it together.

zh: 湖邊那家貨運業者只剩一艘獨木舟可以出航。船夫秤了這趟要運的貨物，再問我有沒有超過這艘船的載重量上限。
en: The carrier by the lake had only one canoe left that could go out. The boatman weighed the cargo for this trip and asked me whether it was over the boat's capacity.

zh: 商業課上，我們追蹤一件衣服在資本主義制度下如何被製造和販售。扮演資本家的同學介紹工廠生產一件衣服會消耗多少水，扮演消費者的人則追問價格裡包含了哪些成本。
en: In business class, we followed how a piece of clothing is made and sold under capitalism. The student playing a capitalist explained how much water a factory consumes to make one shirt, and the ones playing consumers asked which costs were included in the price.

zh: 舊圖書目錄把一本登山日記列在食譜類別，因為書名提到了炒飯。館員請我們先讀前兩頁，再決定怎麼將它分類，並說明採用這個分類的理由。
en: The old library catalogue listed a hiking diary in the cookbook category because its title mentioned fried rice. The librarian asked us to read the first two pages before deciding how to classify it and to explain the reason for our classification.

zh: 校隊奪得冠軍後，慶祝活動一直持續到傍晚。等歡呼聲停止，合唱團才開始唱那首由隊員投票選出的歌。
en: After the school team won the championship, the celebration went on until evening. When the cheering ceased, the chorus began to sing the song the players had voted for.

zh: 導覽員帶我們進入懸崖下的一間石室，指著牆上煮飯留下的煙痕。他說，這些痕跡記錄了當地平民的生活，讓我們看見課本很少描寫的古代文明面貌。
en: The guide took us into a stone chamber under the cliff and pointed at smoke marks on the wall left by cooking. He said these marks recorded the lives of ordinary civilians and showed us a side of ancient civilization that textbooks seldom describe.

zh: 在化學課上，我們把兩種材料塗在一張圓形紙卡上。當紙卡照到陽光、兩種材料一起變紫時，我們看到了這種組合最特別的性質。
en: In chemistry class, we painted two materials onto a circular paper card. When the card was in the sun and both materials turned purple together, we saw the most special characteristic of this combination.

zh: 慈善午餐會招待了許多處境困難的居民。當一位長者因為還沒嚼碎就吞下食物而噎住時，隔桌的人立刻叫來活動的救護員。
en: The charity lunch served many residents in difficult circumstances. When an old man choked because he swallowed his food before chewing it well, someone at the next table immediately called the event's first-aid worker.

zh: 關於校刊發行量的傳言在家長群組流傳了兩天。為了澄清各班究竟收到幾份，編輯把印刷廠的收據和各班實際領到的份數都貼了出來。
en: A rumor about the circulation of the school magazine circulated in the parents' group for two days. To clarify how many copies each class actually received, the editor posted the printer's receipt and the number of copies each class picked up.

zh: 第一次演布偶戲時，我笨拙的動作讓老鷹的爪子勾住一面銅鑼，把它撞向另一面。同伴聽見銅鑼的碰撞聲，立刻替老鷹加了一句台詞，觀眾還以為那是安排好的。
en: The first time I did a puppet show, my clumsy movement caught the eagle's claw on one gong and knocked it against another. When my partner heard the gongs clash, he quickly added a line for the eagle, and the audience thought it was planned.

zh: 演習假設唯一的橋已經倒塌，兩岸的通訊也中斷了。指揮官請大家用旗子以暗碼傳遞訊息，把對岸需要的物資記下來。
en: The drill assumed that the only bridge had collapsed and communication between the two banks had been cut off. The commander asked everyone to send messages in code with flags and write down the supplies the other side needed.

zh: 我和同事一起排演一齣由三個場景組成的喜劇。導演臨時加進了第二把鑰匙，和原本那把長得一模一樣，讓劇中原本單純的誤會變得更複雜。
en: My colleague and I rehearsed a comedy made up of three scenes. The director added a second key at the last minute that looked exactly like the first, which complicated the simple misunderstanding in the play.

zh: 沒有人看見我在畫展上破壞作品，但每次經過那幅被我塗掉署名的畫，我的良心就過意不去。最後我向老師坦白，並表示願意承擔後果。
en: No one saw me damage a painting at the art show, but every time I passed the picture whose signature I had covered, my conscience bothered me. In the end I confessed to the teacher and said I was willing to accept the consequences.

zh: 報名參加長跑比賽的選手個個好勝，直到最後一圈才分出勝負。比賽一結束，我就走過去祝賀那位在最後一圈超越我的對手。
en: All the runners in the long-distance race were competitive, and the winner was not decided until the last lap. As soon as the race ended, I walked over to congratulate the competitor who passed me on the last lap.

zh: 學校請那位年輕的作曲家寫一首曲子。他寫曲子時，還把末班車的煞車聲寫了進去。指揮第一次聽到這首作品時，還以為排練室外真的有車停下來。
en: The school asked a young composer to write a piece of music. While composing, he even included the sound of the last bus braking. When the conductor first heard the composition, he thought a bus had really stopped outside the rehearsal room.

zh: 為了克服上臺朗讀的恐懼，我每天都把注意力集中在一小段文字上。直到弟弟走進來跟我說話，我才發現自己的專注力和信心都比第一天進步了。
en: To conquer my fear of reading on stage, I concentrated on one short passage every day. When my brother came in to talk to me, I realized that my concentration and confidence had both improved since the first day.

zh: 在社區會議上，設計師提出了讓雨水留在校園裡的概念。聽眾臉上露出困惑的神情，直到他以操場旁的凹地為具體的例子，大家才聽懂。
en: At the community meeting, the designer presented the concept of keeping rainwater on campus. The listeners looked confused until he used the low ground beside the playground as a concrete example, and then everyone understood.

zh: 公民課的模擬國會正在討論一項提案。幾位立場保守的代表問，這項提案所要求的改動是否構成修憲。主席請大家先讀憲法條文，再決定是否支持提案。
en: The mock congress in civics class was discussing a proposal. Several conservative representatives asked whether the changes in the proposal would constitute a change to the constitution. The chair asked everyone to read the articles of the constitution before deciding whether to support it.

zh: 鎮上準備在車站旁建造一座天橋。為了處理施工和隨之而來的塞車問題，鎮公所聘了一位交通顧問。公所先和他商量，才公布公車改道的日期。
en: The town plans to construct a bridge over the road beside the station. To deal with the construction and the traffic jams that would follow, the town office hired a traffic consultant. The office consulted him before announcing the dates of the bus route changes.

zh: 第一次試講後，同學留下的評論很有建設性，連哪些投影片從後排看不清楚都寫了。第二次試講時，我特別確認圖表的顏色前後一致，讓後排的人也能一路看懂。
en: After my first practice talk, my classmates' comments were very constructive. They even noted which slides could not be seen clearly from the back row. For my second practice, I made sure the colors of the charts were consistent, so people in the back could follow all the way through.

zh: 演講比賽結束後，校刊把冠軍演說的完整內容和網路短片中的片段作了對照。讀過那段話的上下文後，我們才發現，短片傳達的意思跟她的原意相反。
en: After the speech contest, the school magazine compared the full content of the winning speech with a clip from an online video. After reading the context of that passage, we found that the video conveyed the opposite of what she meant.

zh: 搬進山上的小屋後，爺爺終於擺脫了以前在城裡接個不停的推銷電話。他說，現在只要坐在屋簷下，聽著綿延一整個鐘頭的雨聲，心裡就有一股滿足感。
en: After moving into the cottage on the mountain, Grandpa finally escaped the endless sales calls he used to get in the city. He says now, sitting under the roof and listening to an hour of continuous rain, he feels a deep contentment.

zh: 為了因應芭樂價格暴跌，農民決定和學校餐廳合作。農業合作社捐助紙箱，美術班則設計了方便手提的包裝。校刊報導這次合作的經過時，也特別提到了學生的貢獻。
en: To cope with the sudden drop in guava prices, the farmers decided to cooperate with the school cafeteria. The farm cooperative contributed boxes, and the art class designed easy-to-carry packaging. When the school magazine reported on this cooperation, it also mentioned the students' contributions.

zh: 青年作家大會往年都採用傳統的劇院式座位。今年主辦人考量與會者交談的便利性，改請大家圍著圓桌坐。一位剛投出第一篇作品的高中生就這樣和小說家聊了起來。
en: The young writers' convention used to use conventional theater seating. This year, for the convenience of people talking with each other, the organizer asked everyone to sit around round tables. That is how a high school student who had just sent in her first story ended up conversing with a novelist.

zh: 同學到市議會的服務櫃檯遞交連署書，想傳達居民對路口安全的擔憂。出於禮貌，他等議員說完才拿出現場照片，最後說服議員放學時來路口看看。
en: A classmate handed in a petition at the city council's service counter to convey residents' worries about safety at an intersection. Out of courtesy, he waited until the council member finished speaking before showing the photos, and in the end he convinced the council member to come and look at the intersection after school.

zh: 工藝課上，老師給每個人一小片銅和一條細繩，請我們做一件能掛在書包上的作品。阿榮的創作是一尾尾巴會擺動的魚。看到阿榮如何利用繩結讓魚尾活動，老師稱讚他很有創造力。
en: In craft class, the teacher gave each of us a small piece of copper and a thin cord and asked us to make something we could hang on our schoolbags. A-Rong's creation was a fish whose tail could swing. Seeing how A-Rong used knots to make the tail move, the teacher praised his creativity.

zh: 彩排時，造型師把我的頭髮捲起來，好讓我的女巫造型跟戲服草圖上的模樣相符。等燈光轉暗，我才看到輪到我的信號，舉手對偷走種子的人下了詛咒。
en: At the dress rehearsal, the stylist curled my hair so my witch look would correspond to the costume sketch. When the lights dimmed, I saw my cue, raised my hand, and put a curse on the person who stole the seeds.

zh: 兩個男生躡手躡腳地走到圍牆後，拍下有人拿石頭丟小狗的畫面。其中一人堅持要去找大人幫忙，同伴卻叫他懦夫。後來同伴才懂得，為了制止這種殘忍行為而站出來求助，其實很勇敢。
en: Two boys crept behind the wall and filmed someone throwing stones at a puppy. One of them insisted on getting help from an adult, but his friend called him a coward. Later the friend understood that standing up to ask for help to stop such cruelty is actually courageous.

zh: 影評人在專欄裡批評我們的短片，說他看不出主角為何在最後一刻折返。這句批評讓剪接師找回一個被剪掉的關鍵鏡頭，裡頭的女孩正從窗邊向主角求救。
en: In his column, a film critic criticized our short film, saying he could not see why the main character turned back at the last moment. This criticism made our editor find a critical scene that had been cut, in which a girl calls for help from a window.

zh: 妹妹把蘋果切成小方塊，我則用杯底把花生壓碎。我們先把蘋果拌進優格裡，等優格冰透了，要上桌前才撒上花生，這樣花生吃起來才香脆。
en: My sister cut the apples into small cubes, and I crushed the peanuts with the bottom of a cup. We mixed the apples into the yogurt first, and when the yogurt was cold, we sprinkled the peanuts on just before serving so they would stay crunchy.

zh: 出於好奇，我掀開坐墊，發現椅面上畫著一道曲線，末端指向牆上的裂縫。原來設計密室的那位狡猾店主，早把鑰匙藏在縫裡了。
en: Out of curiosity, I lifted the cushion and found a curve drawn on the seat, with its end pointing at a crack in the wall. It turned out that the cunning owner who designed the escape room had hidden the key in the crack.

zh: 校慶前一晚，才掛上去的紙花就被潮濕的海風吹軟了。班長宣布，更換入口裝飾的最後期限是隔天早上七點，住得近的同學便答應提早到校。
en: The night before the school anniversary, the damp sea wind softened the paper flowers we had just hung up. The class leader declared that the deadline for replacing the decorations at the entrance was seven the next morning, and the students living nearby promised to come early.

zh: 為了守住一分的領先，我們決定防守籃下，兩名後衛也退回防守位置。對方球員雖然閃過第一個人，我們的防守還是逼得他倉促出手，他投失後，我們就以一分之差擊敗了對方。
en: To defend our one-point lead, we decided to guard the basket, and our two guards moved back into defensive positions. Although the other player dodged the first defender, our defense forced him to shoot in a hurry. He missed, and we defeated them by one point.

zh: 兩位同學為照片的署名起了爭執，都要求社長給一個明確的答覆。社長起草新的署名規則時，也請雙方提供底片。她說，關於這張照片該署誰的名，她得做出有證據支持、站得住腳的決定。
en: Two students got into a dispute over the credit for a photo, and both demanded a definite answer from the club president. While she drafted new rules for credit, she asked both sides for the original files. She said her decision about whose name should go on the photo had to be defensible and supported by evidence.

zh: 師傅先示範如何把糖拉成纖細易碎的花瓣，又讓我們靠近看第二次示範。讓阿嬤欣喜的是，她第一次做的糖花就完整地立在盤子上。她說那是當天最愉快的一刻。
en: The master first demonstrated how to pull sugar into delicate, thin petals, and then let us come closer for a second demonstration. To Grandma's delight, her first sugar flower stood complete on the plate. She said it was the most delightful moment of the day.

zh: 草葉上還掛著露水，我們就已經站在站牌前等車了。昏昏欲睡的弟弟問司機幾點出發，司機指著前方的濃霧，說出發時間已經延後。
en: There was still dew on the grass, and we were already standing at the bus stop. My drowsy brother asked the driver what time we would depart, and the driver pointed at the dense fog ahead and said the departure had been delayed.

zh: 有視覺障礙的阿文說，走道堆滿紙箱讓他處於不利地位，每回去書架找書都得依賴別人。他希望走道能清出來，這樣他就能有尊嚴地自己挑書，也不用打擾正在讀書的同學。
en: A-Wen, who has a visual disability, said the boxes piled in the aisle put him at a disadvantage, and every time he went to the shelves for a book he had to be dependent on others. He hoped the aisle could be cleared so he could choose books by himself with dignity and not disturb classmates who were reading.

zh: 沒入選校隊讓小希很失望。她決定探討運動員面對的憂鬱症問題，為校刊寫篇報導。她自己非常渴望再比一次，教練也告訴她，他看得出她的決心，希望她別讓一次落選就把她嚇退。半年後，她用成績證明自己值得擁有先發位置。
en: Xiao-Xi was disappointed that she did not make the school team. She decided to write an article for the school magazine about depression among athletes. She was desperate to compete again, and her coach told her he could see her determination and hoped one failure would not discourage her. Half a year later, she proved with her results that she deserved a starting position.

zh: 儘管颱風已經離開，這場災害對山區道路造成的破壞仍清楚可見。志工先把熱食送到受災最重的地區，再請熟悉巷弄的居民分發餐盒。他們也逐戶做記號，以便追蹤物資的分配情形。
en: Despite the typhoon having left, the destruction it caused to the mountain roads was still clear. Volunteers first delivered hot food to the district hit hardest by the disaster and then asked residents who knew the lanes to distribute the lunch boxes. They also marked each house to track the distribution of supplies.

zh: 校慶推理劇裡，失物招領處一片混亂，偵探便假扮成工讀生調查。她發現主管偷走皮夾，還解雇了代客保管皮夾的員工。想到主管竟然栽贓給別人，她就感到厭惡。
en: In the school mystery play, the lost-and-found office was in disorder, so the detective went in disguised as a part-time worker. She discovered that the manager had stolen a wallet and dismissed the worker who had been keeping it for a customer. The thought that the manager had blamed someone else filled her with disgust.

zh: 兩組學生各自設計了一套自動澆水裝置，並畫了圖解說明水如何流進花盆。兩套設計的不同之處在於，一組靠數位計時器定時澆水，另一組則在泥土乾了才放水。
en: Two groups of students each devised an automatic watering device and drew a diagram showing how water flows into the pot. The two designs differ in that one waters on a schedule with a digital timer, while the other lets water out only when the soil is dry.

zh: 那位退休外交官把每個週末都奉獻給夜校，幫勤奮的學生練習寫作。畢業時，小玲捧著文憑向他道謝，他卻告訴她，那張文憑是她自己多年勤勉的成果。
en: The retired diplomat devotes every weekend to a night school, helping diligent students practice writing. At graduation, Xiao-Ling held up her diploma and thanked him, but he told her the diploma was the result of her own years of diligence.

words.zh: 外交官、有外交手腕的人

zh: 一位傑出的生物學家帶我們觀察兩種水生昆蟲，兩種各有鮮明的花紋。教會我們如何區分牠們後，他播放一段影片，解釋其中一種如何把消化液注入獵物體內，在自己的體外消化食物，再吸進液化的食物。
en: A distinguished biologist showed us two kinds of water insects, each with distinct patterns. After teaching us how to distinguish them, he played a video explaining how one kind puts digestive juices into its prey, digests the food outside its own body, and then sucks up the liquid food.

zh: 樂團成員的背景很多元，指揮也希望曲目能反映這份多樣性。她提醒大家，排練時要有紀律。即使鼓在這一段擔任主導角色，鼓手也不能讓鼓聲支配整首曲子。
en: The members of the band come from diverse backgrounds, and the conductor wants the music to reflect this diversity. She reminded everyone to have discipline during rehearsal. Even though the drums play a dominant role in this part, the drummer must not let them dominate the whole piece.

zh: 歷史老師讓我們操作一張動態地圖，看看每個朝代的疆界如何改變。有同學想知道古代的君王為什麼宣稱自己享有神授的統治權，老師便請他讀讀地圖旁的登基詔書。
en: Our history teacher let us use a dynamic map to see how the borders of each dynasty changed. A classmate wanted to know why ancient rulers claimed a divine right to rule, so the teacher asked him to read the announcement of the new emperor beside the map.

zh: 爸媽離婚後，我一直害怕別人問我週末要住哪裡。有天爸爸帶我去河邊，我們一起看著一片葉子順水漂去。他等到我自己開口問，才告訴我下個月的安排。
en: After my parents' divorce, I always dreaded being asked where I would stay on weekends. One day Dad took me to the river, and we watched a leaf drift away with the water. He waited until I asked him myself before telling me the plan for next month.

zh: 我們把閣樓上滿是灰塵的舊帆布洗乾淨，用剩下的染料把它染成深藍色。爺爺在兩根木把手上各鑽了幾個孔，好讓我把耐用的帆布縫在把手上，做成工具袋。
en: We washed the dusty old canvas from the attic and dyed it dark blue with leftover dye. Grandpa drilled holes in two wooden handles so I could sew the durable canvas onto them and make a tool bag.

zh: 外公帶著壞掉的單耳耳機來找我，神情誠懇地請我教他修理。我才上過一門初級電子學的課，便先和他一起照著課本查線路，直到找到斷線的地方才動手修。
en: Grandpa came to me with a broken earphone and earnestly asked me to teach him how to fix it. I had only taken an elementary electronics course, so I first checked the wires with him using the textbook. We did not start fixing it until we found the broken wire.

zh: 經濟學課請來一位經濟學者，帶我們討論物價上漲給家庭造成的經濟壓力。她問我們哪種午餐最省錢，又請我們試試集中備料能否提高廚房效率。最後，我們討論了這些家庭消費習慣的改變對整體經濟有什麼影響。
en: Our economics class invited an economist to discuss the economic pressure that rising prices put on families. She asked us which lunch was the most economical and asked us to see whether preparing ingredients at the same time could improve efficiency in the kitchen. Finally, we discussed how these changes in family spending affect the whole economy.

zh: 為了消除舞鞋容易滑落的問題，舞者拆下有彈性的帶子，把它改縫在鞋子別處。她試著轉了個身，發現帶子既能固定舞鞋，也不會妨礙她優雅的動作。
en: To eliminate the problem of her dance shoes slipping off, the dancer removed the elastic strap and sewed it elsewhere on the shoe. She tried a turn and found that the strap held the shoe in place without getting in the way of her elegant movements.

zh: 我們在國外旅行遇到難題時，哥哥陪我到大使館求助。承認自己把護照忘在車上讓我很難堪，但我還是跟他一起忍受漫長的等候，直到櫃檯叫到我們的號碼。
en: When we encountered a problem while traveling abroad, my brother went with me to the embassy for help. Admitting that I had left my passport in the car was an embarrassment, but I still endured the long wait with him until the counter called our number.

words.zh: 大使館、大使館全體人員

zh: 暑假工人開挖水管溝時，一段石板路從泥土下浮現。考古隊在工地四周圍起柵欄，說這條路建於羅馬帝國時代，路面上還看得到車輪留下的痕跡。
en: When workers dug a trench for water pipes during the summer, part of a stone road emerged from the dirt. The archaeologists enclosed the site with a fence and said the road was built in the time of the Roman Empire. You can still see marks left by wheels on its surface.

zh: 校門口的機車一度把人行道堵住，危及步行上學的孩子。家長會把重點放在交通規則的執行上，要求定期巡查，確保走路或使用輪椅的人都能順利通過。
en: Scooters at the school gate once blocked the sidewalk and endangered children walking to school. The parents' association put the emphasis on the enforcement of traffic rules and asked for regular checks to ensure that people walking or using wheelchairs could get through.

zh: 念土木工程的學姊把橋墩照片放大後，我們才看見一道原本看不清楚的裂痕。她請我們估計修補費用，再解釋為什麼換掉整座橋墩要花一筆巨款。
en: After my senior who studies civil engineering enlarged a photo of the bridge's support, we saw a crack that had not been clear before. She asked us to estimate the cost of repair and then explained why replacing the whole support would cost an enormous amount of money.

zh: 來自不同族群的同學用家鄉菜招待交換生，介紹拿手菜時的熱情讓走廊擠滿了圍觀的人。主辦人說，為了表達對各族群平等的重視，每組都有五分鐘介紹自己的菜。
en: Classmates from different ethnic groups entertained the exchange students with dishes from home, and their enthusiasm in introducing their best dishes filled the hallway with people watching. The organizer said that to show the importance of equality among all ethnic groups, every group had five minutes to introduce its dish.

zh: 學校成立女子壘球隊時，只借得到一支球棒。隊長列出練球必備的裝備，等到每位隊員都有了合身的手套和頭盔，才安排第一次打擊練習。
en: When the school established a girls' softball team, it could only borrow one bat. The captain listed the essential equipment for practice and did not plan the first batting practice until every player had gloves and a helmet that fit.

zh: 一開始，哪塊布最能阻擋陽光帶來的熱並不明顯，因此我們用溫度計評估每種布料的隔熱效果。最後勝出的白布看起來最薄，但連續七天的讀數為這次評估提供了充分的證據。
en: At first it was not evident which cloth blocked the sun's heat best, so we used a thermometer to evaluate each fabric. The white cloth that won looked the thinnest, but the readings from seven days in a row gave strong evidence for this evaluation.

zh: 攝影師說，為了拍到足以展出的照片，除了颱風天這個例外，他每天都扛著器材爬山。我原以為他誇大了那段路的難走程度，直到自己走了一趟，才知道長長的石階足以讓人精疲力盡。
en: The photographer said that to take photos good enough to exhibit, he carried his gear up the mountain every day, with the exception of typhoon days. I thought he was exaggerating how hard the path was, until I walked it myself and learned that the long stone steps can exhaust anyone.

zh: 木工社展示一張實驗性的桌子，把桌面展開就能多坐兩個人。聽完設計者的解說，我才明白，為什麼設計者把擴展桌面的機構裝在正中央，這樣連坐在桌腳旁的人也不會撞到膝蓋。
en: The woodworking club showed an experimental table that seats two more people when the top is pulled out. After the designer's explanation, I understood why the part that expands the table was put in the middle, so even people sitting by the table legs would not hit their knees.

zh: 我們到煙火倉庫採訪時，管理員說，讓爆炸物暴露在高溫下會增加爆炸的風險。他指著卸貨時間表，解釋他們如何安排貨車在清晨到達，縮短貨物在烈日下曝曬的時間。
en: When we interviewed people at a fireworks warehouse, the manager said exposing explosives to high heat increases the risk of an explosion. He pointed at the unloading schedule and explained how they arrange for trucks to arrive early in the morning to shorten the goods' exposure to the hot sun.

zh: 雨終於停了，巡山員先估計落石波及的範圍。園方原本打算當天重開步道，等巡查報告送到後，才決定把步道封閉的時間延長一週。
en: When the rain finally stopped, the rangers first estimated the extent of the falling rocks. The park had planned to reopen the trail that day, but after the report came in, they decided to extend the closure by a week.

zh: 這位作家以奇幻小說打響名聲，我也是他的忠實讀者之一。朗讀會上，他只用臉部表情就演出了書中的兩個角色。我最喜歡的精靈和石像竟然就在眼前吵架，感覺真奇妙。
en: This writer won fame with his fantasy novels, and I am one of his faithful readers. At the reading, he acted out two characters from the book using only his facial expressions. Seeing my favorite elf and stone statue arguing right in front of me felt fantastic.

zh: 天氣終於轉為適合航行，大家到碼頭向即將離開小島的教練告別。他上渡輪前又教我一次怎麼繫緊救生衣，提醒我在海上一次疏忽就足以致命。
en: When the weather finally became favorable for sailing, everyone went to the dock to say farewell to the coach who was leaving the island. Before boarding the ferry, he taught me again how to fasten my life jacket and reminded me that one careless moment at sea could be fatal.

zh: 學校的運動設施需要維修，其中一座球場連燈都不亮了。教練把估價單傳真給校友會，希望他們能資助維修工程。校友會看過晚自習後來練球的學生所寫的回饋，決定先換掉籃架旁那兩盞燈。
en: The school's sports facilities needed repairs, and the lights on one court did not even work. The coach faxed the price estimate to the alumni association, hoping they would help finance the repairs. After reading feedback from students who practiced after evening study, the association decided to replace the two lights beside the basketball hoop first.

zh: 一場猛烈的風暴過後，阿姨帶我們去看那塊肥沃的田裡還有哪些蔬菜可以收成。她叫我回家拿個大籃子來，說今晚要用這些菜辦一桌盛宴，款待幫忙清理農田的鄰居。
en: After a fierce storm, my aunt took us to see which vegetables in her fertile field could still be picked. She asked me to go home and fetch a big basket, saying she would make a feast with these vegetables tonight for the neighbors who helped clean up the field.

zh: 基金會的創辦人曾答應開設夜間閱讀班，讓輪夜班的工人也能參加。儘管財務吃緊，她仍履行承諾，讓工人依自己的班表彈性選擇上課時間。
en: The founder of the foundation once promised to start evening reading classes so that workers on night shifts could join. Despite tight finances, she fulfilled her promise and let the workers choose their class times flexibly according to their schedules.

zh: 葬禮前，我們把爺爺年輕時的照片裝框，放在壁爐上方。當年是他親自替這間客廳添置家具的，如今家人仍愛坐在他的舊椅子上說故事。
en: Before the funeral, we framed a photo of Grandpa when he was young and put it above the fireplace. He had furnished this living room himself, and the family still loves to sit in his old chair and tell stories.

zh: 外賓說我日語講得很流利，我臉都紅了。帶隊老師見我皺眉，就跟我說，那位客人是真心感謝我幫忙，沒打算奉承我。
en: When the foreign guest said my Japanese was fluent, my face flushed. When the teacher in charge saw me frown, she told me the guest was truly thankful for my help and was not trying to flatter me.

zh: 我正要把小狗身上有跳蚤的地方洗乾淨，牠卻頂著一頭泡沫逃出浴室。媽媽早就禁止牠上沙發，所以牠正要跳上去時，我一把抱住了牠。
en: I was about to wash the spot where the puppy had fleas, but it fled the bathroom covered in foam. Mom had long forbidden it to get on the sofa, so just as it was about to jump up, I grabbed it.

zh: 天氣預報說夜裡會變冷，清晨堡壘外的石階果然覆了一層霜。我們很幸運，守門人早在第一批遊客抵達前就鋪好了防滑墊。
en: The weather forecast said it would get cold at night, and sure enough, there was frost on the stone steps outside the fort early in the morning. We were fortunate that the gatekeeper had put down non-slip mats before the first visitors arrived.

zh: 老師先講解化石形成的基本原理，再讓我們看一片保存在石頭裡的葉子。那塊標本脆弱到不能拿起來，我們只能隔著玻璃看它的葉脈。
en: The teacher first explained the fundamental idea of how fossils form and then showed us a leaf kept in stone. The specimen was too fragile to pick up, so we could only look at its veins through glass.

zh: 那位大一新生照著公式算出廣播頻率，天線偏偏在家鄉電台開播前壞了，讓他十分懊惱。他壓下心中的挫折感，向隔壁寢室借來一支天線，總算在節目結束前聽到熟悉的聲音。
en: The freshman used a formula to work out the radio frequency, but the antenna broke just before his hometown radio station started its show, which frustrated him. He held back his frustration, borrowed an antenna from the room next door, and finally heard the familiar voice before the show ended.

zh: 領隊發現兩支手電筒的電池都被人拿走了，氣得不得了。她在報告中寫道，隊上必須配備兩支能正常使用的手電筒。此外，每次出發前都要有人把兩支手電筒打開測試。
en: The leader was furious to find that the batteries in both flashlights had been taken. In her report, she wrote that the team must be equipped with two functional flashlights. Furthermore, someone must turn on and test both of them before every trip.

zh: 我在畫廊門口瞥見畫裡有艘歪向一邊的小船，便走進去凝視那幅畫。我問這是不是畫家的真跡，館員才拿出畫家當年的草稿給我看。
en: At the door of the gallery I caught a glimpse of a small boat leaning to one side in a painting, so I went in and gazed at it. When I asked if it was a genuine work by the painter, the staff member took out the painter's original sketch to show me.

zh: 科展上有一座巨大的地球儀，底下裝了三個互相咬合的齒輪。原本圍著看的一群孩子見我妹妹轉動手把，地球竟往相反方向轉，都忍不住偷笑。
en: There was a gigantic globe at the science fair with three gears fitting together underneath. When my sister turned the handle and the earth turned the opposite way, the group of children watching could not help giggling.

zh: 我們把家中三個世代的資料按性別整理成圖表，畫出各組有多少人笑起來有酒窩。表弟想知道，只看這張圖能不能判斷他承襲了哪些基因。
en: We organized the information about three generations of our family by gender into a graph showing how many people in each group have dimples when they smile. My cousin wanted to know if this graph alone could tell him which genes he had inherited.

zh: 大家都叫小澄音樂天才，老師卻記得這個有天分的孩子當初連琴都得借。小澄一直很感激當年借琴給她的店主，便在獨奏會上演奏他最愛的曲子，向他表達對這份慷慨的謝意。
en: Everyone calls Xiao-Cheng a musical genius, but the teacher remembers that this gifted child once had to borrow a piano. Xiao-Cheng has always been grateful to the shop owner who lent her the piano, so at her recital she played his favorite piece to thank him for his generosity.

zh: 阿婆先教我洗手，免得把病菌帶到食材上。等我把生薑磨成泥，她才教我用它調醬，讓油膩的煎肉吃起來更清爽。
en: Grandma first taught me to wash my hands so I would not get germs on the food. After I had ground the fresh ginger, she taught me to use it in a sauce so the greasy fried meat would taste lighter.

zh: 販賣手工商品的攤販天還沒亮就沿著海灣搭好了棚子。等到第一道陽光照上船帆，他們都放下手邊的工作，一起欣賞這壯麗的景色。
en: The sellers of handmade goods set up their stalls along the gulf before dawn. When the first rays of sunlight hit the sails, they all stopped working to enjoy the glorious view together.

zh: 畢業典禮那天，我的長袍被椅腳勾住，一位親切的同學蹲下來幫我解開。看她起身時的動作那麼優美，我也試著帶著同樣的優雅走上台。
en: On graduation day, my gown got caught on a chair leg, and a gracious classmate knelt down to free it for me. Seeing how graceful she was when she stood up, I tried to walk onto the stage with the same grace.

zh: 為了替交換生寫一句自然的問候語，我把整本文法書翻了一遍。姐姐讀過後說，那句話雖然合乎文法，朋友之間卻很少這麼客氣。
en: To write a natural greeting for the exchange student, I went through my whole grammar book. After reading it, my sister said the sentence was grammatical, but friends are rarely that polite with each other.

zh: 清明那天，從小擔任我監護人的姑姑帶我去看父親的墓。她知道我還沉浸在悲痛之中，就陪我種下一棵桂花樹，靜靜等我開口。
en: On Tomb-Sweeping Day, my aunt, who has been my guardian since I was little, took me to my father's grave. She knew I was still deep in grief, so she planted a sweet osmanthus tree with me and quietly waited for me to speak.

zh: 店員原本敢保證被指認的人有罪，因為錄影畫面裡的人和他穿著同色外套。直到第二段影片被播放出來，店員才明白，光憑外套顏色無法證明一個人有罪。
en: The clerk was ready to guarantee that the man pointed out was guilty because the person in the video wore a jacket of the same color. Not until a second video was played did the clerk understand that the color of a jacket alone could not prove someone's guilt.

zh: 我認得外婆的筆跡，也熟悉她信末習慣性畫下的那片小葉子。即使剛離開家鄉時歷經困苦，她在寫給家人的信裡也從未提起那些挨餓的日子。
en: I recognize my grandmother's handwriting and the little leaf she habitually drew at the end of her letters. Even though she suffered hardship when she first left her homeland, she never mentioned those hungry days in her letters to her family.

zh: 爸爸匆忙之中忘了帶便當，我便趕緊走向行人穿越道，想把便當拿給他。看見一輛車正要轉彎，我毫不猶豫地退回人行道，等車完全停住才過街。
en: In his haste, Dad forgot his lunch box, so I hurried toward the crosswalk to take it to him. When I saw a car about to turn, I stepped back onto the sidewalk without hesitation and waited until the car came to a complete halt before crossing.

zh: 老師帶來一盒五金零件，請我們想想，花園裡那條老是絆倒人的澆水軟管可以收在哪裡。我把兩個掛鉤鎖在牆上，讓學弟用完軟管後能把它掛起來。
en: The teacher brought a box of hardware and asked us where we could store the garden hose that kept tripping people. I screwed two hooks onto the wall so the younger students could hang up the hose after using it.

zh: 戲裡兩個村子彼此仇恨多年，孩子們連隔著河說句話都會受到嚴厲的責罵。一場洪水過後，村民把毛毯分給對岸的人，孩子們從中看見人性善良的一面，也第一次懂得和諧相處是什麼意思。
en: In the play, the two villages have felt hatred for each other for years, and the children receive harsh scolding even for talking across the river. After a flood, the villagers share blankets with the people on the other side. The children see the kind side of humanity and understand for the first time what living in harmony means.

zh: 地平線上那個黑點愈飛愈近，我原以為是巡山的直升機。直到牠展翅飛過牛群上方，我才看清楚那是一隻鷹。
en: The black dot on the horizon flew closer and closer, and I thought it was a ranger's helicopter. Not until it spread its wings over the herd of cattle did I see clearly that it was a hawk.

zh: 度蜜月的第一晚，新婚夫妻想打開山屋的窗戶吹吹風。窗框外竟掛著一個比籃球還大的蜂巢，把兩人嚇壞了。他們趕緊關上窗，跑去櫃檯問能不能換房間。
en: On the first night of their honeymoon, the newly married couple wanted to open the cabin window for some air. To their horror, there was a hive bigger than a basketball hanging outside the window frame. They quickly closed the window and ran to the front desk to ask if they could change rooms.

zh: 最近濕度很高，曬出去的衣服到了晚上仍是濕的。我們家每一個人都得分擔家務，所以弟弟提議，誰輪到收衣服，誰就順便把除濕機打開。
en: The humidity has been high lately, and the clothes we hang outside are still wet at night. Everyone in our household has to share the housework, so my brother suggested that whoever brings in the clothes should also turn on the dehumidifier.

zh: 新聞剛播報颶風登陸，學校實驗室就停了電。討論著該怎麼收集氫氣的學生一下子全安靜了，四周一片寂靜，只聽得見雨聲。
en: The news had just reported that the hurricane had made landfall when the power went out in the school lab. The students who had been discussing how to collect hydrogen fell silent at once. A hush fell over the room, and only the sound of the rain could be heard.

zh: 為了釐清昨天拿錯雨傘的事件，老師請我們辨認哪一把是自己的。兩把傘看起來完全相同，直到有人發現傘柄上的刻痕，辨識工作才變得容易。
en: To clear up yesterday's incident of someone taking the wrong umbrella, the teacher asked us to identify which one was ours. The two umbrellas looked identical, and identification only became easy when someone noticed a mark on one handle.

zh: 我們在車站閒著沒事，小宇就模仿起他的偶像。他連那位演員說錯成語時的表情都學得一模一樣，這段模仿把等車的人全逗笑了。
en: We were idle at the station, so Xiao-Yu started to imitate his idol. He even copied the actor's face when he used an idiom wrong, and this imitation made everyone waiting for the train laugh.

zh: 我對回收流程一無所知，還以為油膩的紙盒也能丟進紙類回收桶。志工用一小桶變色的紙漿說明油脂會造成什麼影響，我才看懂講義上的插圖。這堂內容充實的課讓我意識到自己的無知。
en: I was ignorant of the recycling process and thought greasy paper boxes could go in the paper recycling bin. Only after a volunteer used a small bucket of discolored paper pulp to show the impact of grease did I understand the illustration on the handout. This informative class made me aware of my own ignorance.

words.zh: 提供訊息的、見聞廣博的

zh: 妹妹憑著孩子的天真，問我魚上學時要把腳踏車停在哪裡。這句話成了我畫一座虛構海底城市的靈感，也啟發我替魚設計腳踏車架。老師說停滿魚用腳踏車的街景很有想像力。
en: With a child's innocence, my sister asked me where fish park their bikes when they go to school. This question became the inspiration for my painting of an imaginary underwater city, and it also inspired me to design bike racks for fish. The teacher said the street full of fish bikes was very imaginative.

words.zh: 靈感、鼓舞人心的人或物

zh: 外公年輕時移居加拿大，沒想到新移民要花那麼久才能適應當地的冬天。我替學校做移民專題時，他給我看一只當年從台灣帶去、裝滿夏衣的行李箱，讓我印象特別深。
en: Grandpa immigrated to Canada when he was young and did not expect it would take new immigrants so long to get used to the winters there. When I did a school project on immigration, he showed me a suitcase full of summer clothes that he had brought from Taiwan, and it left a deep impression on me.

zh: 通貨膨脹對巷口的豆花店造成衝擊，連最基本的原料黃豆也漲價了。老闆擔心突然漲價會加重熟客的負擔，所以先把進貨單貼在牆上，讓大家看看他的成本漲了多少。
en: Inflation has had an impact on the tofu pudding shop at the end of the lane, and even soybeans, the most basic ingredient, have gone up in price. The owner worried that a sudden price rise would impose a burden on his regular customers, so he first put his purchase list on the wall to show how much his costs had increased.

zh: 新人原本擔心沒人來看比賽，隊長卻向他暗示，那兩位受傷的學長已經在號召隊友來觀賽。包括兩名受傷學長在內，全隊都到場加油，新人直說令人難以置信。這也清楚顯示，那兩位學長在隊上有多大的影響力。
en: The new player was worried that no one would come to watch the game, but the captain implied that the two injured seniors were already calling on teammates to come. The whole team, including the two injured seniors, came to cheer, and the new player said it was incredible. It was also a clear indication of how influential those two seniors are on the team.

zh: 嬰兒感染後，醫院暫時把他和其他孩子隔離開來。在隔離期間，哥哥每天都帶著一張新畫來，請護理師貼在弟弟看得見的地方。
en: After the infant got an infection, the hospital isolated him from the other children for a while. During his isolation, his brother brought a new drawing every day and asked the nurse to put it where the baby could see it.

zh: 工程師裝好自助借書機後，請我在初次檢查時照螢幕上的指示操作。我插入借書證、輸入密碼，才發現螢幕上列出的書名全是上一位讀者借的。
en: After the engineer installed the self-service book machine, he asked me to follow the instructions on the screen during the initial inspection. I inserted my library card and input my password, and then I found that all the book titles on the screen had been borrowed by the last reader.

words.zh: 插入、把(人造衛星)射入(軌道)

zh: 我們正在地面練習繩結時，攀岩教練過來檢查我們的進度。她指示我們拉緊繩子，並告訴我們，第一次站上高處時，人的第一個本能反應常是抓緊繩子。下課前我問清楚了，如果有人在練習中受傷，課程的保險會給付哪些費用。
en: While we were practicing knots on the ground, the climbing instructor came to check our progress. She instructed us to pull the rope tight and told us that the first instinct of people standing up high for the first time is often to grab the rope. Before the class ended, I asked what the course's insurance would pay if someone was injured during practice.

zh: 阿傑在眾人面前提起只有親密朋友才知道的小名，我聽了覺得受到侮辱。他原本打算逗我開心，並無讓我難堪的意圖。知道我很難受後，他就親自來道歉。
en: When A-Jie mentioned in front of everyone a nickname that only intimate friends knew, I felt insulted. He had intended to make me laugh and had no intention of embarrassing me. When he learned how upset I was, he came to apologize in person.

zh: 我們在科展上讓孩子跟人工智慧互動，觀察它如何回答他們的問題。大家都覺得設計這項活動是個智力上的挑戰，但最讓我們費心的，其實是怎麼讓每一次互動都充滿樂趣。
en: At the science fair we let children interact with artificial intelligence and watched how it answered their questions. Everyone thought designing this activity was an intellectual challenge, but what took the most effort was making every interaction fun.

zh: 中級班的選手參加三天的密集訓練，第一天就感受到強烈的競爭壓力。教練發現原本跑在前頭的幾個人已經快跟不上了，便在第二天調低練習強度。
en: The intermediate players joined three days of intensive training and felt the intense pressure of competition on the first day. The coach noticed that a few runners who had been in front could hardly keep up, so he lowered the intensity of practice on the second day.

zh: 我替來訪的作家口譯時，正跟她說故事的阿嬤忽然停了下來。直覺告訴我，這次中斷跟語言無關，所以我請家人先別干涉，讓阿嬤自己決定還要不要說下去。
en: While I was interpreting for a visiting writer, Grandma, who was telling her a story, suddenly stopped. My intuition told me this interruption had nothing to do with language, so I asked my family not to interfere and let Grandma decide whether to go on.

zh: 外來的螞蟻入侵菜園後，阿姨才發現這場入侵已經波及整排育苗盆。鄰居給她看了一項新發明，可用來防止螞蟻爬上盆架。她決定先投資一組，等看過效果再買。
en: After foreign ants invaded the vegetable garden, my aunt found that the invasion had spread to a whole row of seedling pots. A neighbor showed her a new invention that keeps ants from climbing onto the pot stands. She decided to invest in one set first and buy more after seeing how well it worked.

zh: 最新一期校刊有一頁空白，編輯展開調查，才知道這件事牽涉到兩篇誤用舊版本的稿件。原作者主動參與核對之後，編輯部當天就發行了更正版。
en: There was a blank page in the latest school magazine, so the editors started an investigation and found that the problem involved two articles that had used old versions by mistake. After the original writers offered to get involved in checking, the editors issued a corrected edition that same day.

zh: 同桌拿到最後一張演唱會門票時，我心裡一陣嫉妒。後來我才知道，她多排了兩個小時，是為了替坐輪椅的妹妹找到合適的位子。
en: I felt a stab of jealousy when the classmate next to me got the last concert ticket. Later I learned that she had waited in line two extra hours to find a suitable seat for her sister, who uses a wheelchair.

zh: 弟弟的觀察力很敏銳，一眼就發現放水壺的櫃子掉了顆螺絲。他跪下來，一手扶住櫃門上的圓形把手，一手把螺絲鎖回去。
en: My brother has keen eyes and saw at a glance that a screw was missing from the cabinet where the kettle is kept. He knelt down, held the round knob on the cabinet door with one hand, and screwed the screw back in with the other.

zh: 我們發起校園菜園計畫後，整地的進度始終落後。這主要是因為我們原本低估了搬土需要多少體力勞動，後來連老師也加入了週末的工作行列。
en: After we launched the campus garden project, our progress in clearing the land kept lagging behind. This was largely because we had underestimated how much physical labor moving soil would take, and later even the teacher joined the weekend work.

zh: 那位學識淵博的講師到學校演講時，帶來幾塊在紫外光下會發亮的礦石。演講一結束，我們就跟著她走進實驗室，看她如何在關燈之後辨認石頭。
en: When the learned lecturer gave a lecture at our school, she brought some minerals that glow under ultraviolet light. As soon as the lecture ended, we followed her into the laboratory to see how she identified stones with the lights off.

zh: 沿著河岸悠閒地散步時，我們看見一棵靠在石牆上的老榕樹。它是當地的地標，許多畫家畫這一帶的風景時都畫過它。阿公還說了一段與它有關的傳說。
en: While taking a leisurely walk along the river, we saw an old banyan tree leaning against a stone wall. It is a local landmark, and many painters have included it in their landscapes of this area. Grandpa also told us a legend about it.

zh: 實習救生員先向主管確認，自己的執照有哪些限制。他把海灘地圖攤開來問，在哪些區域單獨執勤才合法，主管便把那些區域圈給他看。
en: The trainee lifeguard first checked with his supervisor what limitations his license had. He spread out a map of the beach and asked in which areas it was lawful for him to work alone, and the supervisor circled those areas for him.

zh: 圖書館員打算延長週五的開放時間，讓讀書會能讀完這部台灣文學作品。即使裡頭有些文學用語很難懂，大家還是捨不得跳過他們最喜歡的那一章。
en: The librarian plans to lengthen the library's Friday hours so the book club can finish this work of Taiwanese literature. Even though some of the literary language is hard to understand, everyone was unwilling to skip their favorite chapter.

zh: 姐姐把口紅掉在借來的亞麻桌巾上，一開始卻說那個紅印本來就在。她不願被朋友當成騙子，最後還是帶著洗好的桌巾去跟朋友說明經過。
en: My sister dropped her lipstick on a borrowed linen tablecloth, but at first she said the red mark had been there before. She did not want her friend to see her as a liar, so in the end she brought the washed tablecloth back and explained what happened.

zh: 阿姨用第一筆貸款買了水槽，讓客人自己挑活龍蝦。她還把叔叔釀的烈酒加進醬汁裡，客人吃完都想知道那股香氣是從哪裡來的。
en: My aunt used her first loan to buy a water tank so customers could choose live lobsters themselves. She also added the liquor my uncle made to the sauce, and every customer wanted to know where that smell came from.

zh: 偵探故事裡的管家雖然對主人很忠心，我還是請妹妹解釋她推論的邏輯：為什麼他的忠誠就能證明他是清白的？她重新讀了一遍管家的證詞，找到一個更合理的解釋。
en: Although the butler in the detective story is very loyal to his master, I asked my sister to explain the logic of her reasoning: why does his loyalty prove he is innocent? She read the butler's statement again and found a more logical explanation.

zh: 我們擠在糟透了的旅館房間裡住了三晚，最後一天才搬進一家豪華飯店。我一鬆開鞋帶、躺上床，就發現光是能把雙腿伸直，竟然也是一種奢侈。
en: We were squeezed into a lousy hotel room for three nights and only moved into a luxurious hotel on the last day. As soon as I loosened my shoelaces and lay on the bed, I found that even being able to stretch out my legs was a luxury.

zh: 這家製造商用老機械製造自行車零件。修理機械的師傅指著操作手冊裡的圖，教我怎麼用有磁性的工具把掉進縫裡的螺絲吸出來。
en: This manufacturer uses old machinery to manufacture bicycle parts. The mechanic who repairs the machines pointed at a picture in the manual and taught me how to use a magnetic tool to pull out a screw that had fallen into a gap.

zh: 梳妝台亂成一團，她借我一面小鏡子，讓我在開演前把臉上的妝補好。當布幕升起，眼前那座壯麗的宮殿布景讓我忘了緊張，那也成了我最難忘的一次演出。
en: The dressing table was messy, so she lent me a small mirror so I could fix my makeup before the show. When the curtain rose, the magnificent palace set in front of me made me forget my nerves, and it became my most memorable performance.

zh: 爸爸報名馬拉松後，教練要他先用適中的速度跑，並用手錶監測自己的心跳。我問她每週里程增加的上限是多少，以及練了一個月，會有哪些能測量的進步。
en: After Dad signed up for a marathon, the coach asked him to run at a moderate pace first and monitor his heart rate with his watch. I asked her what the maximum increase in weekly distance was and what measurable progress he would make after a month of training.

zh: 那位賣布的商人說，扣掉成本後，他賣布的利潤率只有百分之五。我問他到夜市擺攤有什麼好處，他說，客人可以當場摸摸布料再決定要不要買。
en: The cloth merchant said that after costs, his profit margin was only five percent. When I asked him about the merit of setting up a stall at the night market, he said customers could feel the cloth on the spot before deciding whether to buy.

zh: 弟弟承認路牌是他調換的，原本只想出於淘氣逗同學玩，卻誤導了第一次來的客人。我原以為他想嫁禍給我，聽他向每個人解釋才知道自己誤會了他。願意回頭把客人帶到正確的地方，讓我看見了他的成熟。
en: My brother admitted that he had switched the road signs. He only meant to play a trick on his classmates out of mischief, but he misled guests who were coming for the first time. I thought he was trying to blame me, but when I heard him explain to everyone, I realized I had misunderstood him. His willingness to go back and lead the guests to the right place showed me his maturity.

zh: 公車技工在檢查煞車時發現了機械故障，立刻把車留在車庫。他告訴新同事，安全措施列的是最低要求，即使有人在等車，每一項也都得做到。
en: While checking the brakes, the bus mechanic found a mechanical problem and kept the bus in the garage at once. He told his new colleague that the safety measures list only the minimum requirements, and every one must be done even if people are waiting for the bus.

zh: 山腳下的紀念碑上刻著當年罹難礦工的名字。紀念儀式開始時，弟弟早已把曾祖父的名字和那一行的位置背熟了，因為他想親自指給奶奶看。
en: The names of the miners who died long ago are carved on the memorial at the foot of the mountain. When the memorial service began, my brother had already memorized our great-grandfather's name and where it was on the stone, because he wanted to point it out to Grandma himself.

zh: 戲裡的送信人在途中遭遇不幸，過河時連行李都被沖走了。他渾身溼透，模樣十分淒慘，守城的士兵動了惻隱之心，讓他進來烘乾那封信。
en: In the play, the messenger meets with misfortune on the way, and even his bag is washed away while he crosses the river. Soaking wet, he looked so miserable that the soldiers guarding the city showed mercy and let him in to dry the letter.

zh: 老師以溫和的口氣問我，有沒有看見那塊礦物裡細細的裂紋。直到她把薄片放在顯微鏡下，我才發現裂紋從邊緣一路伸到了中央。
en: In a mild voice, the teacher asked me if I could see the thin cracks in the mineral. Not until she put a thin slice under the microscope did I find that the cracks ran from the edge all the way to the center.

zh: 村裡有位百萬富翁出錢修復了河畔的磨坊，卻只請人掛上一塊樸素的小木牌。開幕那天，他把功勞全給了木工，連一向很少稱讚別人的爺爺都佩服他的謙遜。
en: A millionaire in the village paid to restore the mill by the river but only asked for a modest little wooden sign. On the opening day, he gave all the credit to the carpenters, and even Grandpa, who seldom praises others, admired his modesty.

zh: 交通部收到多份陳情書後，部長親自搭上了那班即將停駛的公車。學生告訴他，這是放學後唯一能回家的車，此外，也有上晚班的人得靠它去工作。
en: After the Ministry of Transportation received many letters, the minister himself rode the bus that was about to stop running. The students told him it was the only bus home after school. Moreover, people working night shifts depend on it to get to work.

zh: 在那個多山的地區，只有騾子能馱著書走過雨後泥濘的小路。我問送書人，是什麼激勵他一次又一次上山，他說孩子在門前等他的模樣，就是他繼續走下去的動力。
en: In that mountainous area, only mules can carry books along the muddy paths after rain. I asked the man who delivers the books what motivated him to go up the mountain again and again. He said the sight of the children waiting at their doors was his motivation to keep going.

zh: 小說裡的兩位偵探收到一封神祕的信，才發現他們正在追查同一名謀殺犯。雖然兩人仍對分工低聲抱怨，他們知道，只有相互信任才能查清寄信人的身分。
en: The two detectives in the novel received a mysterious letter and found that they were chasing the same murderer. Although the two still murmured complaints about how they divided the work, they knew that only mutual trust could help them find out who sent the letter.

zh: 這項補助開放給兩類有需要的人，也就是家裡付不起午餐費的學生和失去工作的家長。志工提醒我，若只憑國籍決定誰能申請，就會忽略一些真正貧困的家庭。
en: This aid is open to two groups of needy people, namely students whose families cannot pay for lunch and parents who have lost their jobs. A volunteer reminded me that deciding who can apply by nationality alone would neglect some truly poor families.

zh: 有人提議把社區球場免費借給孩子練球，店主卻說這想法是胡說八道。大家都知道目標雖然崇高，租金仍得有人付。儘管如此，隊長還是去找店主協商，最後談成了只在週末借場地。
en: Someone suggested lending the community court to the children for free, but the shop owner said the idea was nonsense. Everyone knew that although the goal was noble, someone still had to pay the rent. Nevertheless, the captain went to negotiate with the owner and finally got the court on weekends only.

zh: 阿姨說，她小時候讀到核能電廠事故的新聞後，連做了好幾夜惡夢。如今她拿出當年收藏的眾多剪報，讓我們看不同報紙怎麼記錄同一天的事。
en: My aunt said that after reading news about an accident at a nuclear power plant when she was little, she had nightmares for several nights. Nowadays she takes out the numerous newspaper clippings she kept back then and shows us how different papers recorded the same day.

zh: 托兒所的孩子輪流幫忙洗菜，廚師再把洗好的菜煮進湯裡。我的妹妹原先挑食，現在卻會指著自己的碗，告訴我今天吃了哪些有營養的食物。
en: The children at the nursery take turns helping wash the vegetables, and then the cook puts them in the soup. My little sister used to be a picky eater, but now she points at her bowl and tells me which nutritious foods she ate today.

zh: 訓練員問我們，如果一隻聽話的狗在路口拒絕前進，我們會不會提出異議。當她指向迎面轉彎的貨車，我才明白訓練的目標是讓人安全抵達，光靠服從還不夠。
en: The trainer asked us whether we would raise an objection if an obedient dog refused to go forward at an intersection. When she pointed at a truck turning toward us, I understood that the objective of the training was to get people there safely, and obedience alone was not enough.

zh: 我們獲得進入保護區的許可後，便開始記錄夜間的觀察結果。最大的障礙是樹叢太密，得靠偶爾傳來的叫聲，才能辨認躲在裡頭的鳥。
en: After we obtained permission to enter the nature reserve, we began recording our night observations. The biggest obstacle was that the bushes were so thick that we had to rely on occasional calls to identify the birds hiding inside.

zh: 以前每逢表格上問到職業，外婆總是填「裁縫師」。她的縫紉機至今還占著閣樓裡最靠窗的位置，從那扇窗可以俯瞰市場。她以前一看見攤販收傘，就知道該下樓煮飯了。
en: Whenever a form asked for her occupation, Grandma always wrote "tailor." Her sewing machine still occupies the spot nearest the window in the attic, and from that window you can overlook the market. Whenever she saw the sellers closing their umbrellas, she knew it was time to go downstairs and cook.

zh: 我擔心那句拿口音開玩笑的話會冒犯新同學，就在班刊送印前把它刪了。他後來說，自己當時並未覺得受冒犯，但也很高興我們願意思考，什麼樣的玩笑會讓人覺得無禮。
en: I was worried that a joke about accents would offend the new student, so I deleted it before the class newsletter was printed. He later said he had not taken offense, but he was glad we were willing to think about what kinds of jokes people find offensive.

zh: 新生訓練那天，我坐在管弦樂團後方，聽大家為下個月的歌劇排練。學姊告訴我，除了報名演奏，我還有另一個選擇，就是坐在台下替聽不清楚的歌詞做記號。
en: On the day of orientation, I sat behind the orchestra and listened to them rehearse for next month's opera. A senior told me that besides signing up to play, I had another option: sitting in the audience and marking lyrics that were hard to hear.

zh: 劇中那位成了孤兒的小裁縫，原本只想找回父親的剪刀。當他得知國王下令禁止窮人進城，他才站出來反對，並和城裡的人一同推翻了國王的統治。
en: In the play, the little tailor who became an orphan only wanted to get his father's scissors back. When he learned that the king had banned poor people from the city, he stood up to oppose him and joined the people of the city in overthrowing the king.

zh: 弟弟把鐵絲彎成橢圓形，再讓一顆藍色珠子沿著它繞太陽運行。我提醒他接頭一定要夾緊，否則評審轉動模型時，珠子就會掉到地上。
en: My brother bent a wire into an oval and made a blue bead orbit the sun along it. I reminded him that the joint must be clamped tight; otherwise, the bead would fall to the ground when the judges turned the model.

zh: 比賽結果公布前，我摸到大衣口袋裡那張寫滿鼓勵的紙條。即使我當天未能克服上台的緊張，評審仍說我的劇本很傑出，希望明年能再看到我的作品。
en: Before the results were announced, I felt the note full of encouragement in my overcoat pocket. Even though I did not overcome my nerves on stage that day, the judges said my script was outstanding and hoped to see my work again next year.

zh: 園丁讓幫浦運轉了一整夜，好讓空氣持續打進魚池裡。隔天早上我們測量水裡的氧氣含量時，他問我，這次的讀數跟他前一晚測得的數字相比有什麼變化。
en: The gardener ran the pump overnight to keep pumping air into the fish pond. When we measured the oxygen level in the water the next morning, he asked me how the reading compared with the number he got the night before.

zh: 降落傘一打開，我便看見岸邊的醫師正在等我們。著陸後，他先問我身體上有沒有不舒服，才放慢步伐，陪我走回休息區。
en: As soon as my parachute opened, I saw the physician waiting for us on the shore. After we landed, he first asked if I felt any physical discomfort and then slowed his pace to walk with me back to the rest area.

zh: 我向專家小組做口頭簡報時，才發現投影幕上只顯示了地圖的一部分。幸好報告最後一段寫得很清楚，即使資訊不完整，聽眾也能知道洪水從哪裡流進村子。
en: While giving my presentation to the panel of experts, I found that the screen only showed part of the map. Luckily, the last paragraph of my report was clear, so even with partial information, the audience could tell where the flood entered the village.

zh: 以前我在同儕之間總是很被動，連討論校外教學都等別人先開口。直到我們班和隔壁班建立合作關係，我被推舉為主持人，才明白每個人的參與都能影響最後選定的路線。
en: I used to be passive among my peers and always waited for others to speak first, even when we discussed field trips. When our class formed a partnership with the class next door and I was chosen as the host, I finally understood that everyone's participation could affect the route we chose.

zh: 夏天正值產季，市場上的李子多得很，阿姨便切了一盤給來家裡吃飯的交換生。他也做了自己的拿手菜，把醃黃瓜切碎，拌進煮熟放涼的義大利麵裡。
en: Summer is plum season, and plums were plentiful at the market, so my aunt cut up a plate for the exchange student who came to dinner. He also made his best dish, chopping pickles and mixing them into cooked, cooled pasta.

zh: 貓把一隻爪子伸進半掩的門，把地板上的瓶蓋撥到另一邊。我從門縫偷看，才知道那股奇特的氣味是從妹妹打翻的香水瓶裡飄出來的。
en: The cat put one paw through the half-open door and pushed a bottle cap on the floor to the other side. When I peeped through the gap, I learned that the peculiar smell came from the bottle of perfume my sister had knocked over.

zh: 在已填答問卷的居民中，百分之六十贊成對無證占用無障礙車位的人提高罰款。記者問，參加抗議的人占全體居民的百分比是多少，里長說他還在等最後兩條街的回覆。
en: Among the residents who answered the survey, sixty percent supported a higher penalty for people who park in disabled parking spaces without a permit. A reporter asked what percentage of all residents took part in the protest, and the neighborhood chief said he was still waiting for replies from the last two streets.

zh: 提琴師把琴身擦亮後，用可攜式燈具照著琴面，直到最細的刮痕也看得清楚。我以為他在追求完美，他卻指著一道淺痕說，那是祖父練琴留下的，應當保留。
en: After polishing the violin, the violin maker shone a portable lamp on it until even the finest scratch could be seen. I thought he was pursuing perfection, but he pointed at a light scratch and said it was left by his grandfather's practice and should be kept.

zh: 原本我很悲觀，以為臨時雨棚一拆，等公車的人又得淋雨了。居民再三勸說，還提出一份很有說服力的乘車人數調查，公所這才同意興建永久的候車亭。
en: At first I was pessimistic and thought that once the temporary rain shelter was taken down, people waiting for the bus would get wet again. After residents' repeated persuasion and a persuasive survey of the number of riders, the town office agreed to build a permanent bus shelter.

zh: 菜園裡的葉子一夜之間多了好多小洞，老師問我們怎麼解釋這個現象。我翻過葉片找到害蟲後，她才帶我們架起防蟲網，說預防蟲害可以從這裡做起，毋須在校園裡使用有毒的藥劑。
en: Overnight, the leaves in the vegetable garden got many small holes, and the teacher asked us how to explain this phenomenon. After I turned over a leaf and found the pests, she helped us put up insect nets and said pest prevention could start here, without using poisonous chemicals on campus.

words.zh: 令人討厭之物、有害之物

zh: 讀書會上，一位研究哲學的學姊講起古代哲學家提出的問題。當她問我們人數不同的兩桌該怎麼分一塊蛋糕，原本抽象的哲學問題突然變得很切身。
en: At the book club, a senior who studies philosophy talked about questions raised by ancient philosophers. When she asked us how two tables with different numbers of people should share one cake, the abstract philosophical question suddenly felt very personal.

zh: 物理課結束後，那位來訪的物理學家留下來陪我們看幾張早期照片。她說，這些攝影術的先驅得先弄清楚每張照片要曝光多久，才能拍下如今掛在牆上的街景。
en: After physics class, the visiting physicist stayed to look at some early photos with us. She said these pioneers of photography first had to work out how long each photo needed to be exposed before they could capture the street scenes now hanging on the wall.

words.zh: 物理學家、機械唯物論者

zh: 社區劇團請附近的水管工來飾演一位密謀偷走珠寶的守衛。我原先擔心他會忘詞，直到他用一個眼神刻畫出守衛的貪心，才發現他很有演戲的潛力。
en: The community theater asked a plumber nearby to play a guard who plots to steal jewels. I was worried he would forget his lines, until he portrayed the guard's greed with a single look, and I saw that he had real potential as an actor.

zh: 這套漫畫越來越受歡迎，朋友聽說我擁有第一冊，便寫信向我借。他說願意負擔來回郵資，因為他知道，那是我最珍惜的一件私人物品。
en: This comic series is getting more and more popular. When my friend heard that I possess the first volume, he wrote to ask if he could borrow it. He said he was willing to pay the postage both ways because he knew it was my most treasured possession.

zh: 球賽開始前，姐姐要我預測第一滴雨會在幾點落下。我的預測離實際時間差了十分鐘，她卻笑著說，只憑遠方的一朵雲，很難說出精確的時間。
en: Before the game, my sister asked me to predict what time the first drop of rain would fall. My prediction was ten minutes off, but she laughed and said it was hard to give a precise time based only on a distant cloud.

zh: 懷孕的姊姊回家吃飯時，媽媽準備了她喜歡的豆腐和蛋。姊姊告訴我，這兩樣食物都含有蛋白質，還翻開手冊給我看她在懷孕期間寫下的飲食紀錄。
en: When my pregnant sister came home for dinner, Mom made the tofu and eggs she likes. My sister told me both foods contain protein and opened her notebook to show me the food records she kept during her pregnancy.

zh: 導覽員指著幾件原始的石器，說這間展室最重要的任務，是讓這些工具能被完整保存。我問他文物保存還有哪些工作，他便打開櫃門，讓我們看見記錄濕度的小儀器。
en: The guide pointed at some primitive stone tools and said the main job of this room was to make sure these tools could be preserved whole. When I asked what other work preservation involved, he opened a cabinet to show us a small device that records humidity.

zh: 我到診所實習的第一天，護理長先教我報到的程序。她說病人的隱私要擺在優先位置，穿上制服也沒有自由進出診間的特權。等病人同意後，我才開始記錄。
en: On my first day of training at the clinic, the head nurse taught me the check-in procedure. She said patients' privacy must be a priority, and wearing a uniform did not give me the privilege of going in and out of exam rooms freely. Only after the patient agreed did I proceed to take notes.

zh: 烘焙是叔叔選擇的職業，成為專業烘焙師之後，他仍每天和學徒一起揉麵。他重新安排烤爐的使用順序，讓早班的生產效率提高，也讓原本虧本的店有利可圖。他因此獲得了升遷。
en: Baking is the profession my uncle chose, and after becoming a professional baker, he still kneads dough with his apprentices every day. He rearranged the order of using the ovens, which made the morning shift more productive and turned the shop, which had been losing money, profitable. As a result, he got a promotion.

words.zh: 能生產的、有生產價值的

zh: 來訪的知名主播請那位很有前途的學生念一段新聞稿。每當他卡在一個地名的發音，她就把第一個音寫在板子上提示他，讓他自己把句子念完。
en: The famous news anchor visiting our school asked a promising student to read a news report. Whenever he got stuck on the pronunciation of a place name, she wrote the first sound on a board as a prompt and let him finish the sentence by himself.

zh: 從前這是個繁榮的港口，魚市場的興旺養活了整條街。幾個回鄉青年提出讓閒置攤位成為共用廚房的計畫，希望市場能再次繁榮起來。
en: This used to be a prosperous port, and the prosperity of the fish market supported the whole street. Some young people who came back home made a proposal to turn the empty stalls into a shared kitchen, hoping the market would prosper again.

zh: 來學校演講的心理學家問隊長，當全場都等他投最後一球時，他會感受到什麼心理壓力。那天我才發現，研究心理學也能從籃球場上一個短短的瞬間開始。
en: The psychologist who came to give a talk asked our captain what psychological pressure he felt when everyone was waiting for him to take the last shot. That day I realized that studying psychology can start from one short moment on a basketball court.

zh: 地方誌快要出版時，編輯請我們核對受訪者的姓名。等我們把每個名字都核對過，出版商才答應出書。我們沒有經費做宣傳，只好到書裡寫到的每一家店，親手貼上海報。
en: When the local history book was about to be published, the editor asked us to check the names of the people interviewed. Only after we had checked every name did the publisher agree to publish it. We had no money for publicity, so we went to every shop mentioned in the book and put up posters ourselves.

zh: 電影裡，警察騎上腳踏車追趕那個抱走畫框的男人。這場追逐在三條街外結束，這時警察才知道，畫框裡夾著一封他急著送回去給家人的信。
en: In the movie, a police officer jumped on a bike to pursue the man who ran off with a picture frame. The pursuit ended three streets away, and only then did the officer learn that there was a letter in the frame that the man was hurrying to take back to his family.

zh: 姊姊和我為了誰能帶走外婆縫的被子吵了一架。後來我們讀到媽媽抄在卡片上的一段引文，出自外婆的日記，才知道外婆早就決定把被子留給快出生的小表妹。
en: My sister and I had a quarrel over who could take the quilt Grandma had sewn. Later we read a quotation from Grandma's diary that Mom had copied onto a card, and we learned that Grandma had long ago decided to leave the quilt to our little cousin who was about to be born.

zh: 暴風雨在山區肆虐，管理員看了雷達圖，說得等降雨量減少以後才能下山。我們把僅剩的燕麥煮成一鍋粥，再把口袋裡那包葡萄乾分給大家。
en: The storm was raging in the mountains. The ranger looked at the radar map and said we could not go down until the rainfall decreased. We cooked the last of the oats into a pot of porridge and shared the bag of raisins from my pocket with everyone.

zh: 我想把外婆得過獎的食譜換算成一人份。她起初不情願，嚐過成品之後才改變心意。她評論說，對獨居的人來說，做一人份更切合實際，而且味道好得出奇。
en: I wanted to change Grandma's prize-winning recipe into one serving. She was reluctant at first but changed her mind after tasting it. She remarked that cooking for one is more realistic for people who live alone, and it tasted remarkably good.

zh: 歷史劇裡，年輕的農夫為了反抗國王而加入革命。飾演革命者的同學讀過農夫的信才明白，當初為什麼連最溫和的土地改革都遭到貴族的抵制。
en: In the history play, a young farmer joins the revolution to rebel against the king. After reading the farmer's letters, the classmate playing the revolutionary understood why even the mildest land reform met with resistance from the nobles.

zh: 在同學會的接待處，一位老同學拿畢業照給我看。他指著照片裡並肩站著的我們，我才想起他的名字。我叫出他的名字，他一看我認出他了，就笑了。
en: At the reception desk of the class reunion, an old classmate showed me our graduation photo. He pointed at the two of us standing side by side, and then I recalled his name. When I said his name, he smiled at the recognition.

zh: 哥哥養傷期間最愛的消遣，是坐在門口跟鄰居下棋。醫師說，短程散步有助於減輕哥哥的煩悶，於是我們開始到公園散步放鬆心情。
en: While my brother was recovering from his injury, his favorite recreation was playing chess with the neighbors at the door. The doctor said short walks would help relieve his boredom and aid his recovery, so we started walking in the park for relaxation.

zh: 為了規範攤販使用一次性杯子的方式，主辦單位訂了一條新規定，要求攤販回收自己發出去的杯子。活動結束後，清潔隊統計了垃圾量的減少幅度，才決定明年要準備多少垃圾車。
en: To regulate how vendors use disposable cups, the organizers made a new regulation requiring vendors to recycle the cups they hand out. After the event, the cleaning team measured the reduction in trash before deciding how many garbage trucks to prepare next year.

zh: 一位研究員到班上談他對河床的研究，請我們參考他拍的照片。我的報告原本列了十篇參考文獻，聽完他解釋石頭如何移動之後，我只留下與問題有關的三篇。
